1.label: Rosh Hashanah 11a
1.rest: — "Rabbi Yehoshua says: From where do we know that the Avos were born in Nissan? For it says, 'And it was in the four hundred and eightieth year… in the month of Ziv' (I Melachim 6:1) — in the month in which the radiant ones (zivtanei) of the world were born."

2.label: Rashi, Rosh Hashanah 11a (s.v. shenoldu)
2.rest: — "'In the month of Ziv' — this is Iyar. 'In which the radiant ones of the world were born' — when Iyar began, they had already been born in Nissan. Alternatively: sometimes the solar Nissan extends into the lunar Iyar."

3.label: Chagigah 12a
3.rest: — "It is a dispute of Tannaim: the light the Holy One, blessed be He, created on the first day — Adam could gaze by it from one end of the world to the other; these are the words of Rabbi Yaakov. And the Sages say: These are the very luminaries that were created on the first day, but they were not hung in place until the fourth day."

4.label: Targum Yonasan, Yeshayahu 30:26
4.rest: — "And the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun is destined to shine three hundred and forty-three times over, like the light of the seven days [of Creation]."

5.label: Zohar II, 166b
5.rest: — “The Holy One, blessed be He, sowed this light in His Garden of Eden, making it row upon row through that righteous one who is the garden's gardener. He takes this light, sows it as a seed of truth, and makes it row upon row in the garden; it gives birth, sprouts, and makes fruit, from which the world is nourished. This is 'Light is sown for the righteous.' ... These are the seeds of the first light, continually sown: now they give birth and make fruit, and now they are being sown. Before the world eats this fruit, that seed already gives birth and yields further fruit, without ceasing.” The gardener receives and plants the primordial light, rather than originating it. This is the precise connection with Yosef transmitting illumination to Malchus.

6.label: Rosh Hashanah 11a
6.rest: — "And the other view? Is it not written 'in the month of Ziv'? — That is the month that has radiance (ziva) for the trees, as Rav Yehudah said: One who goes out in the days of Nissan and sees the trees blossoming says: Blessed is He Who left nothing lacking in His world and created in it good creatures and good trees."

7.label: Rosh Hashanah 11a
7.rest: — "And the other view? Is it not written 'in the month of the Eisanim' (I Melachim 8:2)? — There, it means that they are mighty (takifei) in mitzvos."

8.label: Tanchuma, Yisro 8
8.rest: — "When Israel left Egypt there were among them people with blemishes from the crushing labor… The Holy One, blessed be He, said: Is it right that I give My Torah to people with blemishes? He signaled to the ministering angels, and they came down and healed them. From where do we know there were no blind among them? 'And all the people saw the sounds' (Shemos 20:15). And no deaf? For they said, 'We will do and we will hear.'"

9.label: Chagigah 27a
9.rest: — "Rabbi Abbahu said: The fire of Gehinnom has no power over Torah scholars. It is a kal vachomer from the salamander: if one who anoints himself with the blood of the salamander, which is a creature of fire, is not harmed by fire, then Torah scholars, whose whole body is fire — as it is written, 'Is not My word like fire, says Hashem?' (Yirmeyahu 23:29) — all the more so."

10.label: Taanis 4a
10.rest: — "Rava said: A young Torah scholar who boils with anger — it is his Torah that heats him up, as it is said, 'Is not My word like fire, says Hashem?' (Yirmeyahu 23:29)."

11.label: Pesachim 36b
11.rest: — "Rav Chanan bar Abba said: Eshpar is one sixth of a bull; ashishah is one sixth of an eifah. And this disagrees with Shmuel, for Shmuel said: Ashishah is a jug of wine, as it is written, 'and they love jugs (ashishei) of grapes' (Hoshea 3:1)."

12.label: Zohar III 40a (Shemini)
12.rest: — "The ashishah brings in the wine; the apple draws out the wine and directs the will. Therefore 'with ashishos and apples': ashishos — to be sated with wine; apples — to direct the will, so that the wine should do no harm. And all this, why? 'For I am lovesick' — in exile."

13.label: Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5
13.rest: — "'Sustain me with ashishos' (Shir HaShirim 2:5): with two fires (ishos) — the Written Torah and the Oral Torah… Another explanation: these are the well-founded (me'ushashos) halachos; 'spread apples around me' — these are the aggados, whose fragrance and taste are like apples."

14.label: Zohar III 271b, Eikev (Ra’aya Mehemna)
14.rest: — “‘Come, eat of my bread’ — this is the Written Torah; ‘and drink of the wine I mixed’ — this is the wine of the Oral Torah.”

15.label: Zohar I 103b (Vayera)
15.rest: — "'Her husband is known in the gates': this is the Holy One, Who is known and grasped according to what each one measures (meshaer) in his heart, as much as he can cleave to the spirit of wisdom… But to know Him as He truly is — no one can."

16.label: Sifrei, Eikev 49
16.rest: — "The expounders of aggados say: If you wish to recognize the One Who spoke and the world came into being, learn aggadah, for through it you come to recognize the One Who spoke and the world came into being, and to cleave to His ways."

17.label: Zohar III 40a (Shemini)
17.rest: — "'Sustain me with ashishos' (Shir HaShirim 2:5): these are the Avos, who are filled first from that good wine that is preserved; and when they are filled, blessings are found for her [Knesses Yisrael] through one level, which is the Tzaddik."

18.label: Zohar III 40a (Shemini)
18.rest: — "And with what? 'With ashishos' — these are the Avos, who are filled first from that good wine that is preserved; and when they are filled, blessings are found for her through one level, which is the Tzaddik."

19.label: Zohar III, 2a
19.rest: — “‘Ask for yourself a sign’—an actual letter, for all was carried through the mystery of letters. Of Rachav it says, ‘Give me a true sign’: This is the letter Vav, which is called the letter of truth. Are the other letters not truth? They are, but this letter is called the letter of truth.” The maamar joins the designation of Vav with “Give truth to Yaakov,” identifying the patriarchal quality within the letter.

20.label: Berachos 5b
20.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

21.label: Zohar III 122b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
21.rest: — "Two letters awaken a person to Torah and mitzvah. Yud is fear: it rests upon a person's head, and from it fear enters his heart to fear the Holy One, blessed be He… Hei is love… And Vav rests upon a person's head, and from it there enter into his mouth words with which to study Torah."

22.label: Bava Basra 164b
22.rest: — "Rav Amram said in the name of Rav: Three transgressions no person escapes each day: thoughts of sin, iyun tefillah [expecting one's prayer to be answered], and lashon hara."

23.label: Chullin 37b
23.rest: — "'Behold, my soul has not been defiled' (Yechezkel 4:14) — I never entertained thoughts by day that would bring me to defilement at night." Yechezkel counts this among his great merits.

24.label: Tosafos, Bava Basra 164b (s.v. iyun tefillah)
24.rest: — "Iyun tefillah": that one does not direct his heart in his prayer, as it says in the Yerushalmi (Berachos 2:4): Rabbi Chiya Rabbah said, "In all my days I never concentrated [fully] except once; I wanted to concentrate, and I found myself thinking, Who goes up first before the king — the arkafta or the Reish Galusa?"

25.label: Yerushalmi, Berachos 2:4
25.rest: — "Rabbi Chiya Rabbah said: In all my days I never concentrated [in prayer]; once I wished to concentrate, and I thought in my heart: who goes in first before the king, the arkafta or the reish galusa? Shmuel said: I counted birds. Rabbi Bun bar Chiya said: I counted the rows of the building. Rabbi Masnia said: I am grateful to my head, for when it reaches Modim it bows by itself."

26.label: Berachos 61a
26.rest: — "Two kidneys are in a person: one advises him for good and one advises him for bad. It stands to reason that the good one is at his right and the bad one at his left, as it is written, 'A wise man's heart is at his right, and a fool's heart at his left.'" Rashi (later on the amud): the kidneys advise the heart.

27.label: Zohar III 35b (end of Tzav)
27.rest: — "'For You have done wonders (pele), counsels from afar' (Yeshayahu 25:1): pele, as it is written, 'And his name shall be called Pele (Wonder)' (Yeshayahu 9:5); 'counsels,' as it says, 'Counselor (Yo'etz)'; 'from afar,' as it is written, 'From afar Hashem appeared to me' (Yirmiyahu 31:2)."

28.label: Yoma 72b
28.rest: — "Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonasan: What is meant by 'Why is there a price in the hand of a fool to acquire wisdom, when he has no heart?' (Mishlei 17:16)? Woe to Torah scholars who occupy themselves with Torah but have no fear of Heaven."

29.label: Taanis 15a
29.rest: — “Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: I too say that not all are destined for light and not all for joy. The righteous are destined for light, and the upright for joy. The righteous for light, as it is written: 'Light is sown for the righteous'; and the upright for joy, as it is written: 'And for the upright in heart, joy.'” The two clauses are from Psalms 97:11. Rav Tzadok develops the special association of uprightness with the heart's joy.

30.label: Tanchuma, Vayechi 15
30.rest: — "'All these are the tribes of Israel, twelve' (Bereishis 49:28)… These tribes follow the order of the world: twelve hours in the day and twelve hours at night, and so too the constellations and the months, and the twelve stones of the Ephod."

31.label: Kesubos 112a
31.rest: — "'In the council (sod) of My people they shall not be' (Yechezkel 13:9) — this is the secret (sod) of intercalation; 'and in the writing of the house of Israel they shall not be written' — this is semichah; 'and to the land of Israel they shall not come' — as it sounds."

32.label: Rashi, Kesubos 111a (s.v. veshelo yegalu es hasod)
32.rest: — "Some say: the secret of intercalation; and some say: the secret of the reasons of the Torah."

33.label: Shabbos 75a
33.rest: — "From where do we know that it is a mitzvah for a person to calculate the seasons and the constellations? For it says, 'Keep them and do them, for it is your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the nations' (Devarim 4:6). Which wisdom and understanding is in the eyes of the nations? This is the calculation of seasons and constellations."

34.label: Rosh Hashanah 20a
34.rest: — “Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said: They put pressure on witnesses concerning a moon seen at its expected time in order to make the month full, but do not put pressure on witnesses concerning a moon not seen at its expected time in order to sanctify it. Is that so? Rabbi Yehudah Nesi’ah sent Rabbi Ami: ‘Know that throughout Rabbi Yochanan’s life he taught us: They put pressure on witnesses concerning a moon not seen at its expected time in order to sanctify it; although they did not see it, they say, ‘We saw it.’’ Abaye said: There is no difficulty: one case concerns Nisan and Tishrei, and the other concerns the remaining months.” The sugya gives distinctions and variant reports; Rav Dimi of Nehardea subsequently transmits the rule in the reverse form. Rav Tzadok invokes the striking formulation in his explanation of the court’s access to the divine will, rather than erasing the surrounding discussion’s qualifications.

35.label: Rosh Hashanah 25a
35.rest: — "'Which you shall proclaim, osam' (Vayikra 23:2) — read it atem, 'you': you, even if you erred unwittingly; you, even if deliberately; you, even if misled." Rashi: unwittingly — they themselves thought the month should be extended, and erred; misled — through false witnesses.

36.label: Berachos 59a
36.rest: — "Rabbi Alexandri said in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi: Thunder was created only to straighten the crookedness of the heart, as it says, 'And God has made it so that they should fear Him' (Koheles 3:14)."

37.label: Zohar III 193b (Balak)
37.rest: — "'Counsels from afar' (Yeshayahu 25:1) — what are they? The two willow branches, for all the counsel of the prophets comes from there; they are called 'counsels from afar.'"

38.label: Rosh Hashanah 11a
38.rest: — "Rabbi Yehoshua says: From where do we know that the Avos were born in Nissan? For it says, 'And it was in the four hundred and eightieth year… in the month of Ziv' (I Melachim 6:1) — in the month in which the radiant ones (zivtanei) of the world were born."

39.label: Rashi, Rosh Hashanah 11a, s.v. shenoldu
39.rest: — "When Iyar began, they had already been born, in Nissan. Alternatively: sometimes the Nissan of the solar season extends into the lunar month of Iyar."

40.label: Berachos 5b
40.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

41.label: Berachos 58a
41.rest: — "It was taught in a baraisa in the name of Rabbi Akiva: 'Yours, Hashem, is the greatness' (I Divrei HaYamim 29:11) — this is the splitting of the Sea; 'and the might' — the plague of the firstborn; 'and the tiferes' — the giving of the Torah; 'and the netzach' — Yerushalayim; 'and the hod' — the Beis HaMikdash."

42.label: Zohar I 207a (Vayigash)
42.rest: — "What is 'heaven'? This is the secret of the Avos, and the secret of the Avos is Yaakov, who is their totality; for Yaakov is the glory of the Avos, and he stands to illuminate the world."

43.label: Zohar I 182b (Vayeshev)
43.rest: — “Yaakov’s whole image was in Yosef… and both go together as one, and this is the secret of the letter Vav.”

44.label: Zohar II 14b–15a (Shemos)
44.rest: — "He made Avraham in the secret of Chochmah, Yitzchak in the secret of Tevunah, and Yaakov in the secret of Da'as."

45.label: Zohar III 58a (Acharei Mos)
45.rest: — "Rabbi Abba said: There are times before the Holy One, blessed be He, when favor is found and blessings are found and requests are granted, and times when favor is not found… There are times in the year when favor is found, and times in the year when judgment is found…; there are times in the months when favor is found."

46.label: Megillah 6b
46.rest: — "Rabbi Tavi said: The reason of Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel [who places Purim in the second Adar] is that juxtaposing redemption to redemption is preferable."

47.label: Pri Etz Chaim, Shaar Chag HaMatzos 1
47.rest: — On the first night of Pesach all [the mochin] entered at once, unlike any other time, "for then it was necessary to do this in that moment, not in the way of nature, in order to bring them out from slavery to freedom; and after they went out that was no longer needed, and the matter returned to its first nature, to enter like the other levels, until the festival of Shavuos."

48.label: Pesikta Rabbasi 15 (Parshas HaChodesh)
48.rest: — "Rabbi Berechyah and Rabbi Chiya said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: The Holy One, blessed be He, wrapped Himself in a tallis with tzitzis, stood Moshe on one side and Aharon on the other, called Michael and Gavriel and made them the messengers of the month, and said to them: On which side did you see it?"

49.label: Bereishis Rabbah 68:6
49.rest: — "'And Yaakov went out' (Bereishis 28:10) — did no one leave from there but he? How many donkey drivers and camel drivers left! Rather: when the tzaddik is in the city, he is its radiance, he is its splendor; when he leaves, its radiance departs, its splendor departs. Similarly, 'And she went out from the place where she was' (Rus 1:7)."

50.label: Bereishis Rabbah 63:3
50.rest: — Avraham is called Yisrael, and Yitzchak too is called Yisrael, as it says, "And these are the names of the Children of Israel who came to Egypt: Yaakov…" — and Yitzchak is called Avraham, as it says, "These are the generations of Yitzchak son of Avraham — Avraham."

51.label: Pri Etz Chaim, Shaar Sefiras HaOmer 7
51.rest: — In these days the Gulgalta of Arich Anpin, called "omer naki" (pure wool), is aroused; and my master said that omer (עמר) has the numerical value of keri (קרי).

52.label: Niddah 13b
52.rest: — "[Those who 'sport with children'] — shall we say this means relations with males? They are liable to stoning! Rather, it means by way of limbs: they are like the generation of the Flood." Rashi: that is, wasting seed.

53.label: Midrash Tehillim 114:4
53.rest: — "'The sea saw and fled' (Tehillim 114:3): the sea saw Israel contending with one another to sanctify His Name… Another explanation: it saw the coffin of Yosef descending into the sea. The Holy One, blessed be He, said: Let it flee before the one who fled, as it is written, 'and he fled and went outside' (Bereishis 39:12)."

54.label: Zohar II 49a (Beshalach)
54.rest: — "'The sea saw and fled' (Tehillim 114:3) — what did the sea see? It saw the coffin of Yosef, and fled before it. Why? Because it is written of him, 'And he fled (vayanos) and went outside' (Bereishis 39:12); therefore 'the sea saw and fled (vayanos).'"

55.label: Taanis 5b
55.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Yaakov Avinu did not die. He was asked: Was it for nothing that the eulogizers eulogized, the embalmers embalmed and the buriers buried? He answered: I am expounding a verse, as it says, 'And you, fear not, My servant Yaakov… for behold, I save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity' (Yirmeyahu 30:10) — it compares him to his seed: just as his seed is alive, so too he is alive." Rashi: he lives forever; they embalmed him because they thought he had died.

56.label: Chullin 37b
56.rest: — "'Behold, my soul has not been defiled' (Yechezkel 4:14) — I never entertained thoughts by day that would bring me to defilement at night." Yechezkel counts this among his great merits.

57.label: Sotah 14a (Mishnah)
57.rest: — "All meal-offerings come from wheat, but this one [the sotah's] comes from barley… Rabban Gamliel says: Just as her deed was the deed of a beast, so her offering is animal food." Rashi: that the Omer offering comes from barley is derived from verses in Menachos (68b).

58.label: Chagigah 16a
58.rest: — "Six things were said of human beings: in three they are like the ministering angels and in three like animals… In three they are like animals: they eat and drink like animals, they are fruitful and multiply like animals, and they relieve themselves like animals."

59.label: Bava Basra 16a
59.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: He is the Satan, he is the evil inclination, he is the Angel of Death. He is the Satan, as it is written, 'And the Satan went out from before Hashem' (Iyov 2:7); he is the evil inclination, as it is written there, 'only evil all day' (Bereishis 6:5)…; he is the Angel of Death, as it is written, 'only guard his soul' (Iyov 2:6)."

60.label: Eruvin 41a
60.rest: — “After Rabban Gamliel died, Rabbi Yehoshua entered to overturn his ruling. Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri stood and said: I see that the body follows the head! Throughout Rabban Gamliel's life we established the law according to him; now you wish to overturn his words? Yehoshua, we do not heed you, for the law has already been established according to Rabban Gamliel, and no one disputed the matter.” The proverb occurs in a dispute about maintaining an established ruling after a leader's death. Rav Tzadok applies its image to Rosh Chodesh as the head that directs the month.

61.label: Tanchuma, Noach 3
61.rest: — "'According to (al pi) these words' (Shemos 34:27) — this is the Oral Torah, which is hard to learn and involves great suffering, and it is likened to darkness, as it says, 'The people who walk in darkness have seen a great light' (Yeshayahu 9:1): these are the masters of the Talmud, who have seen a great light, for the Holy One, blessed be He, illuminates their eyes in what is forbidden and permitted, impure and pure."

62.label: Zohar II 166b
62.rest: — "This light the Holy One, blessed is He, sowed in His Garden of Eden, and made it into rows upon rows through this Tzaddik, who is the gardener of the Garden. He took this light and sowed it as a seed of truth… and it brought forth and sprouted and produced fruit, from which the world is nourished. This is 'Light is sown for the righteous.'"

63.label: Zohar II (Terumah)
63.rest: — "This light the Holy One sowed in the garden of His delight, and set it in rows upon rows through this Tzaddik, who is the gardener of the garden; he takes this light and sows it as a seed of truth, and it bears fruit, and from it the world is nourished — 'Light is sown for the tzaddik' (Tehillim 97:11)."

64.label: Zohar III, Bamidbar
64.rest: — "'From Tziyon, the perfection of beauty, God shone forth (hofia)' (Tehillim 50:2): hofia means 'shone,' as you say, 'He shone forth from Mount Paran' (Devarim 33:2). And this is the light of the world."

65.label: Zohar III 281b (Ki Seitzei, Raaya Mehemna)
65.rest: — The moon is good and evil: good in its fullness and evil in its waning; "and because it is composed of good and evil, Israel count by it and the children of Yishmael count by it." When it is eclipsed at its fullness it is a bad sign for Israel; when eclipsed in its waning, a bad sign for the Ishmaelites.

66.label: Zohar III, Bamidbar
66.rest: — "And when this light is aroused, all is in companionship, all in affection, all in love, all in wholeness; then there is peace for all, peace above and below, as it is written, 'May there be peace within your ramparts' (Tehillim 122:7)."

67.label: Zohar II 11b (Shemos)
67.rest: — "'She hid him three months' (Shemos 2:2). Rabbi Yehudah said: It is an allusion that Moshe was not recognized in the supernal radiance until three months, as it is written, 'In the third month' (Shemos 19:1), for then the Torah was given through him and the Shechinah was revealed and rested upon him before the eyes of all."

68.label: Berachos 58a
68.rest: — "It was taught in a baraisa in the name of Rabbi Akiva: 'Yours, Hashem, is the greatness' (I Divrei HaYamim 29:11) — this is the splitting of the Sea; 'and the might' — the plague of the firstborn; 'and the tiferes' — the giving of the Torah; 'and the netzach' — Yerushalayim; 'and the hod' — the Beis HaMikdash."

69.label: Avodah Zarah 20b
69.rest: — "Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair said: Torah leads to watchfulness, watchfulness to alacrity, alacrity to cleanliness, cleanliness to separation, separation to purity, purity to piety, piety to humility, humility to fear of sin, fear of sin to holiness, holiness to ruach hakodesh, and ruach hakodesh to the resurrection of the dead."

70.label: Yerushalmi, Shekalim 3:3 (so too Avodah Zarah 20b)
70.rest: — "Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair says: Torah leads to watchfulness, watchfulness to alacrity, alacrity to cleanliness, cleanliness to separation, separation to purity… purity leads to holiness" — as it says, "And he shall purify it and sanctify it" (Vayikra 16:19).

71.label: Zohar II 121a (Mishpatim)
71.rest: — “The Torah emerged from Chochmah, from the place called Kodesh.”

72.label: Zohar II 11b (Shemos)
72.rest: — "And if you say that the angel appointed over the spirits of the righteous is called 'Night,' and you said he is Gavriel — so it certainly is, for he comes from the left side, and whoever comes from the left side is called thus."

73.label: Rashi, Rosh Hashanah 11a, s.v. shenoldu
73.rest: — "When Iyar began, they had already been born, in Nissan. Alternatively: sometimes the Nissan of the solar season extends into the lunar month of Iyar."

74.label: Rosh Hashanah 11a
74.rest: — "On Pesach Yitzchak was born. From where? As it is written, 'At the appointed time I will return to you' (Bereishis 18:14). When was this said?… It was said on Sukkos, and he told her: in Nissan." Rashi: "at the appointed time" means at the next festival.

75.label: Berachos 5b
75.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

76.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 11b
76.rest: — "When it was taken from Chesed it was called the Written Torah, given from the right, as it is written, 'From His right hand, a fiery law for them' (Devarim 33:2); and when it was taken from Gevurah it was called the Oral Torah… From there 'the mighty stand in the breach,' and none can stand in it but one mighty in the battle of Torah, mighty over his inclination."

77.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 21, 50a
77.rest: — "From the right the Written Torah was given, and from the left the Oral Torah was given, which is the feminine."

78.label: Zohar I 142a (Toldos)
78.rest: — "Therefore it is written, 'And Avraham was old, advanced in days' (Bereishis 24:1), in those lights that shine… And therefore, 'God called the light Day' — this is Avraham; 'and the darkness He called Night' (Bereishis 1:5) — this is Yitzchak, who is darkness and goes to receive the night within him."

79.label: Zohar II 14b–15a (Shemos)
79.rest: — "He made Avraham in the secret of Chochmah, Yitzchak in the secret of Tevunah, and Yaakov in the secret of Da'as."

80.label: Tanchuma, Noach 3
80.rest: — "The Holy One, blessed be He, brought them out twelve years before the destruction of Yerushalayim with their Torah and Talmud, as it is written, 'And he exiled all Yerushalayim… and all the mighty men of valor' (II Melachim 24:14). What might is there in people who go into exile? Rather, these are the mighty ones of Torah, as it is said of it, 'Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of Hashem' (Bamidbar 21:14)."

81.label: Rosh Hashanah 11a
81.rest: — "And the other view? Is it not written 'in the month of Ziv'? — That is the month that has radiance (ziva) for the trees, as Rav Yehudah said: One who goes out in the days of Nissan and sees the trees blossoming says: Blessed is He Who left nothing lacking in His world and created in it good creatures and good trees."

82.label: Rosh Hashanah 11a
82.rest: — "Rabbi Eliezer says: From where do we know that the Avos were born in Tishrei? For it says, 'And all the men of Israel assembled to King Shlomo in the month of the Eisanim, on the festival' (I Melachim 8:2) — the month in which the mighty ones (eisanei) of the world were born."

83.label: Rosh Hashanah 27a
83.rest: — "Like whom do we pray today, 'This day is the beginning of Your works, a remembrance of the first day'? Like Rabbi Eliezer, who said the world was created in Tishrei." Tosafos there (s.v. kemaan) explain that both views are the words of the living God: in Tishrei it arose in thought to create, and it was not created until Nissan.

84.label: Pirkei D'Rabbi Eliezer 29
84.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: All gentiles who join Israel are circumcised of their own good will and desire, out of fear of Heaven; even so, gentiles are not trusted until seven generations, so that the waters do not return to their source. But slaves are circumcised not of their own good will or desire, and there is no trust in slaves. So too, all the slaves who were circumcised with Avraham our father did not endure in Israel, neither they nor their descendants."

85.label: Rashi, Genesis 1:1, s.v. Bereishis Bara
85.rest: — “As our Sages expounded: For the sake of the Torah, which is called 'the beginning of His way,' and for the sake of Israel, who are called 'the beginning of His produce.'” Rashi's two readings of bereishis underlie the claim that Creation's purpose is bound to Torah and Israel. The Sinai condition discussed in Shabbos 88a then gives that purpose its explicit covenantal form.

86.label: Zohar II 14b–15a (Shemos)
86.rest: — "The world was created with ten utterances, and when you look closely they are three: 'with wisdom, with understanding and with knowledge' (Shemos 31:3)… When He wished to establish the world, He made Avraham in the secret of Chochmah, Yitzchak in the secret of Tevunah, and Yaakov in the secret of Da'as."

87.label: Zohar II 64a (Beshalach)
87.rest: — "'Who can tell the mighty deeds (gevuros) of Hashem' (Tehillim 106:2): what are 'the gevuros of Hashem'? To include the supernal Mother of all; for although she is not judgment, from her side gevurah is found."

88.label: Rashi, Shemos 31:3
88.rest: — "'With wisdom' — what a person hears from others and learns; 'and with understanding' — that he understands a matter from his own heart, from what he has learned; 'and with knowledge' — ruach hakodesh."

89.label: Bava Basra 12a
89.rest: — "Amemar said: And a sage is greater than a prophet, as it says, 'And a prophet (nevi) has a heart of wisdom' (Tehillim 90:12) — who depends on whom? The lesser on the greater." The Ramban there explains that the Sages' wisdom is a form of ruach hakodesh.

90.label: Zohar III 61a (Acharei Mos)
90.rest: — "We learned before our master: What is Kodesh? The perfection of all, which is called Supernal Chochmah. From this place flows the oil of holy anointing… and when this [lower] one is blessed from the place above, called Kodesh and called Chochmah, they call it Ruach HaKodesh — a spirit from that Kodesh above."

91.label: Megillah 14b
91.rest: — "'And Esther donned royalty (malchus)' (Esther 5:1) — it should have said 'royal garments'! Rather, ruach hakodesh clothed her: it is written here 'donned,' and there, 'And the spirit clothed Amasai' (I Divrei HaYamim 12:19)."

92.label: Zohar III, 169b (Shelach)
92.rest: — “‘On the third day Esther clothed herself in royalty’—she clothed herself in that likeness of the other world. Royalty is the holy spirit, for the kingdom of heaven sends forth a spirit from the air of that world, and Esther clothed herself in it. When she entered before King Achashverosh and he saw that garment of light, her appearance seemed like an angel of God, and his soul departed from him for a moment. Mordechai was likewise, as it is written, ‘Mordechai went out from before the king in royal clothing’: royal clothing indeed, the likeness of that world. Therefore it is written, ‘The fear of Mordechai fell upon them’—the fear of Mordechai, and not the fear of Achashverosh.”

93.label: Sotah 12a
93.rest: — “When Moshe was born, the whole house was filled with light.”

94.label: Pesachim 49b
94.rest: — "Rabbi Akiva said: When I was an am ha'aretz I said, 'Who will give me a Torah scholar, and I will bite him like a donkey!' His students said to him: Rebbi, say 'like a dog'! He said: This one bites and breaks the bone; that one bites and does not break the bone."

95.label: Shabbos 147b
95.rest: — "Shmuel said: All potions from Pesach until Shavuos are beneficial."

96.label: Berachos 20b (Mishnah 3:4)
96.rest: — "A ba'al keri contemplates [the Shema] in his heart (mehaher belibo), and does not recite the blessings, neither before it nor after it."

97.label: Zohar I 172a, Vayishlach
97.rest: — “‘At the pace of the work’—what is the work? This is the mirror that does not shine, through which the work of the world is performed. ‘Which is before me’—this is what is meant everywhere by ‘from before Hashem.’ ‘And at the pace of the children’—this is the mystery of the cherubs, to show the mystery of faith to which he cleaved.” The interpretation is of Yaakov’s words in Bereishis 33:14. The non-shining mirror receives rather than originating its light; Rav Tzadok connects this receptive aspect with the divine action within creation. The preceding chapter 9 carries 172a.

98.label: Zohar I 151a (Vayetzei)
98.rest: — "'Shall be the house of Elokim' (Bereishis 28:22) — it should have said 'the house of Hashem'! Rather, it is the place of the court, from two upper sides: from the side of the Yovel, which is Elokim Chaim (the Living God), and from the side of Yitzchak, Elokim."

99.label: Zohar I 5b (Introduction)
99.rest: — "One Shabbos remained unmentioned and was ashamed. She said: Master of the world, since the day You made me I am called Shabbos, but there is no day without night! He said: My daughter, you are Shabbos… but I crown you with a higher crown. He proclaimed, 'My Sanctuary you shall fear' (Vayikra 19:30) — this is the Shabbos of Erev Shabbos, which is fear, and fear dwells in her."

100.label: Yoma 72b
100.rest: — "Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonasan: What is meant by 'Why is there a price in the hand of a fool to acquire wisdom, when he has no heart?' (Mishlei 17:16)? Woe to Torah scholars who occupy themselves with Torah but have no fear of Heaven."

101.label: Tikkunei Zohar 48, 85a
101.rest: — “Fortunate is one who makes them a dwelling on Shabbos in the two chambers of the heart, and the evil inclination, which is the desecration of Shabbos, is cleared from there.”

102.label: Berachos 61a
102.rest: — "Rav said: The evil inclination resembles a fly and sits between the two openings of the heart, as it says, 'Dead flies make the perfumer's oil putrid' (Koheles 10:1). Shmuel said: It resembles a kind of wheat (chitah), as it says, 'Sin (chatas) crouches at the door' (Bereishis 4:7)."

103.label: Sukkah 52b
103.rest: — “A person’s inclination overpowers him every day and seeks to kill him … and were it not that the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him, he could not overcome it, as it says: Hashem will not abandon him into his hand.”

104.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 48, 85a
104.rest: — "Fortunate is he who makes them a dwelling on Shabbos in the two chambers of the heart, so that the evil inclination, which is the desecration of Shabbos, is cleared out from there."

105.label: Zohar III 2a (beginning of Vayikra)
105.rest: — "And so with Rachav, what is written? 'Give me a true sign (os emes)' (Yehoshua 2:12) — this is the letter vav, which is called the sign of truth. And if you say the other letters are not truth — they are, but this letter is called 'the sign of truth.'"

106.label: Tanchuma Beshalach 1
106.rest: — "The Holy One said: If I lead them by the direct way, each will now take hold of his field and vineyard and neglect the Torah. Rather, I will lead them by way of the wilderness, and they will eat the manna and drink the water of the well, and the Torah will settle in their bodies."

107.label: Seder Olam Rabbah 5
107.rest: — "On the first day of the week, the twenty-third of Iyar, they journeyed from Alush and came to Refidim; there the well was given to them, and they fought with Amalek."

108.label: Zohar III 160a, Shelach
108.rest: — “Furthermore, ‘Amalek dwells in the land of the Negev.’ If a person says that despite all this he will attain it: ‘Amalek dwells in the land of the Negev’—this is the evil inclination, the accuser, who accuses a person and is constantly found in the body. ‘The Hittite and the Amorite’—how many accusers are found there, so that a person cannot enter that world at all. Who will merit it, and who will enter it? With these words ‘they disheartened the children of Israel,’ for they brought out an evil report about it.” The Zohar first portrays the discouraging accusation, then answers it with sincere will and guarding the covenant. This exact context supports Rav Tzadok's identification of Amalek as the accusing root of the inclination.

109.label: Sukkah 52b
109.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish said: A person's inclination overpowers him every day and seeks to kill him, as it says, 'The wicked one watches the righteous and seeks to kill him' (Tehillim 37:32); and were it not that the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him, he could not overcome it, as it says, 'Hashem will not abandon him into his hand' (Tehillim 37:33)."

110.label: Berachos 61a
110.rest: — "A person has two kidneys: one counsels him for good and one counsels him for evil. It stands to reason that the good one is at his right and the evil one at his left, as it is written, 'The heart of a wise man is at his right, and the heart of a fool at his left' (Koheles 10:2)."

111.label: Sefer Yetzirah 5
111.rest: — "He made the letter vav king over thought (hirhur), bound a crown to it, combined them one with another, and formed with them Taurus in the world, Iyar in the year, and the right kidney in the soul."

112.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 48, 85a
112.rest: — "Fortunate is one who guards a dwelling for Shabbos, which is the heart, so that there does not approach it the sadness of the spleen and the anger of the gall, which is the fire of Gehinnom, of which it is said, 'You shall not kindle fire in all your dwellings on the Shabbos day' (Shemos 35:3)."

113.label: Zohar II 182b (Tetzaveh)
113.rest: — "The anger of Torah scholars is good in every respect, for the Torah is fire and the Torah heats him up… the anger of scholars over words of Torah, to give honor to the Torah — all of it is service of the Holy One."

114.label: Berachos 5a
114.rest: — "Rabbi Levi bar Chama said in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish: A person should always incite the good inclination against the evil inclination, as it says, 'Tremble and do not sin' (Tehillim 4:5). If he defeats it, good; if not, let him occupy himself with Torah…; if not, let him recite Shema…; if not, let him remember the day of death."

115.label: Taanis 4a
115.rest: — “Rava said: A young Torah scholar who becomes heated—it is the Torah that makes him heated, as it is said, ‘Is not My word like fire, says Hashem?’ Rav Ashi said: Any Torah scholar who is not hard as iron is not a Torah scholar, as it is said, ‘Like a hammer that shatters rock.’ ... Ravina said: Even so, a person must train himself in gentleness, as it is said, ‘Remove anger from your heart.’” The fire describes Torah’s force. The Gemara’s concluding qualification requires gentleness; its teaching does not make ordinary anger a virtue.

116.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a (Pesach Eliyahu)
116.rest: — "They are called in this arrangement: Chesed, the right arm; Gevurah, the left arm; Tiferes, the body; Netzach and Hod, the two thighs; Yesod, the completion of the body, the sign of the holy covenant; Malchus, the mouth — we call it the Oral Torah."

117.label: Zohar II 175b (Terumah)
117.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon said: I have seen that Chochmah includes everything: supernal Chesed issues from Chochmah, and Gevurah, which is severe judgment, issues from Binah; Yaakov completes the two sides, and the Avos include everything."

118.label: Avodah Zarah 20b
118.rest: — "Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair said: Torah leads to watchfulness, watchfulness to alacrity, alacrity to cleanliness, cleanliness to separation, separation to purity, purity to piety, piety to humility, humility to fear of sin, fear of sin to holiness, holiness to ruach hakodesh, and ruach hakodesh to the resurrection of the dead."

119.label: Yerushalmi, Shabbos 1:3
119.rest: — "Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair says: Alacrity leads to cleanliness, cleanliness to purity, purity to holiness… as it says, 'And he shall purify it and sanctify it' (Vayikra 16:19)."

120.label: Zohar II 60a–b, Beshalach 26:3–4
120.rest: — “While they were walking in the wilderness, another domain, that of the other nations, was revealed against them—the power that rules in the wilderness—and they encountered it there. Israel saw that their King’s glorious radiance was no longer there. ... Why ‘for they were bitter’? Their souls were no longer delighted as before; furthermore, it came to accuse them. ... ‘The Lord showed him a tree’: a tree means Torah, as it is written, ‘She is a tree of life to those who hold fast to her.’ ... When the radiance of their King’s glory was revealed to them, then ‘he cast it into the water, and the water became sweet.’ What is meant by ‘the water became sweet’? The accuser became an advocate.” The bitterness and its sweetening continue the account of the hidden and restored radiance.

121.label: Pri Etz Chaim, Shaar HaShabbos 17
121.rest: — On Shabbos night one says, "This is the meal of the Field of Holy Apples…"; and this meal is Yitzchak's, who is its master. At the morning meal one says, "This is the meal of Atika Kaddisha…," and it corresponds to Avraham, the elder, the chassid.

122.label: Bava Basra 16a
122.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: He is the Satan, he is the evil inclination, he is the Angel of Death. He is the Satan, as it is written, 'And the Satan went out from before Hashem' (Iyov 2:7); he is the evil inclination, as it is written there, 'only evil all day' (Bereishis 6:5)…; he is the Angel of Death, as it is written, 'only guard his soul' (Iyov 2:6)."

123.label: Avodah Zarah 5a
123.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: Let us be grateful to our forefathers, for had they not sinned we would not have come into the world, as it says, 'I said: you are angels (elohim), all of you children of the Most High' — you corrupted your deeds — 'therefore like men you shall die' (Tehillim 82:6–7)."

124.label: Zohar III 258a (Raaya Mehemna, Pinchas)
124.rest: — "'Hashem with wisdom founded the earth' (Mishlei 3:19): Abba founded the daughter; the hei — Imma Ila'ah, a crown upon the vav, which is the son; and this is 'He established the heavens with understanding' — with Imma He established the son."

125.label: Sanhedrin 38a
125.rest: — "'Wisdom has built her house' (Mishlei 9:1) — this is the attribute of the Holy One, blessed be He, Who created the whole world with wisdom; 'she has hewn out her seven pillars' — these are the seven days of Creation; 'she has slaughtered her meat, mixed her wine, and also set her table' — these are the seas and rivers and all the needs of the world."

126.label: Zohar II 37b (Bo)
126.rest: — "This crown, which is called zos, is called 'woman,' as you say, 'This (zos) shall be called woman' (Bereishis 2:23). Why? 'For from man (ish) she was taken.' Who is ish? The one called zeh, and he is the male, as you say, 'For this (zeh) Moshe, the man'; and zos was taken from zeh, who is called male."

127.label: Taanis 31a, on Yeshayahu 25:9
127.rest: — “Ulla of Bira said in Rabbi Elazar’s name: In the future the Holy One, blessed be He, will make a circle for the righteous, and He will sit among them in the Garden of Eden. Each one will point with his finger, as it says: ‘It will be said on that day: Behold, this is our God; we hoped for Him and He saved us. This is Hashem, for whom we hoped; let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.’”

128.label: Mechilta, Beshalach, Shirah 3
128.rest: — "'This is my God and I will glorify Him' (Shemos 15:2). Rabbi Eliezer says: From where do you say that a maidservant saw at the Sea what Yeshayahu and Yechezkel did not see? For it says, 'and through the prophets I was imaged' (Hoshea 12:11)… When the Holy One, blessed be He, was revealed at the Sea, no one needed to ask, 'Which is the King?'"

129.label: Zohar I 5b (Introduction)
129.rest: — "One Shabbos remained unmentioned and was ashamed. She said: Master of the world, since the day You made me I am called Shabbos, but there is no day without night! He said: My daughter, you are Shabbos… but I crown you with a higher crown. He proclaimed, 'My Sanctuary you shall fear' (Vayikra 19:30) — this is the Shabbos of Erev Shabbos, which is fear, and fear dwells in her."

130.label: Zohar III, Pinchas (Ra'aya Meheimna)
130.rest: — "The Holy One, blessed be He, is hidden in the secrets of the Torah. How is He known? Through the mitzvos, which are His Shechinah, His image: as He is humble, His Shechinah is humility; He is pious and she is piety…; He is truth (emes) and she is faith (emunah); He is righteous and she is righteousness; He is King and she is kingship."

131.label: Zohar II 186a (Tetzaveh)
131.rest: — "Your month is ordered by the sequence of the letters: Aviv — Alef-Beis-Gimel… But the seventh month, Mine, is from the end of the letters (Tishrei). Why? You are from below upward, and I from above downward."

132.label: Sotah 5a
132.rest: — "'With the crushed and lowly of spirit' (Yeshayahu 57:15): Rav Huna and Rav Chisda — one says, 'With Me is the crushed,' and the other says, 'I am with the crushed.'" Rashi: "With Me is the crushed" — I raise him up until he dwells beside Me; "I am with the crushed" — I lower My Shechinah to be beside him.

133.label: Zohar II 54a, Beshalach
133.rest: — “Rabbi Abba said: I considered all the praises with which they praised the Holy One, blessed be He, and all began with ‘Then’: ‘Then Solomon said’; ‘Then Joshua spoke’; ‘Then Israel sang.’ Why? All the miracles and mighty deeds done for Israel occur when the light of the Holy Ancient One shines in His crowns, engraved and marked in az—in the alef. The alef pierces the darkness and illumines every side. When the alef's illumination joins and reaches the zayin—what is the zayin? 'Hashem's sword is filled with blood'—then He performs miracles and mighty deeds, because alef has joined with zayin. This is song, song on every side; this is 'Then Moshe sang.'” The Zohar reads az, 'then,' through its letters, alef and zayin. Rav Tzadok applies the same joining of supernal illumination with the lower levels to the future 'Then our mouth shall be filled with laughter.'

134.label: Rosh Hashanah 11a
134.rest: — "And the other view? Is it not written 'in the month of the Eisanim' (I Melachim 8:2)? — There, it means that they are mighty (takifei) in mitzvos."

135.label: Berachos 61a
135.rest: — "Two kidneys are in a person: one advises him for good and one advises him for bad. It stands to reason that the good one is at his right and the bad one at his left, as it is written, 'A wise man's heart is at his right, and a fool's heart at his left.'" Rashi (later on the amud): the kidneys advise the heart.

136.label: Shabbos 88b
136.rest: — "This is what Rava said: For those who go to its right, it is an elixir of life; for those who go to its left, an elixir of death."

137.label: Megillah 32a
137.rest: — "Rabbi Shefatyah said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: From where do we know that one may make use of a bas kol? For it says, 'And your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying' (Yeshayahu 30:21). This applies when one hears a man's voice in the city or a woman's voice in the field."

138.label: Yerushalmi, Shabbos 6:9
138.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: One follows the hearing of a bas kol. What is the reason? 'And your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying: This is the way, walk in it' (Yeshayahu 30:21)." The Yerushalmi then tells how Rabbi Lazar relied on the words of a Roman, Abtiona, and was saved.

139.label: Megillah 14b
139.rest: — “Esther—for it is written, 'On the third day Esther clothed herself in royalty.' Should it not have said 'royal garments'? Rather, Divine inspiration clothed her. Here it is written 'clothed,' and there it is written 'A spirit clothed Amasai.'” The source makes malchus, royalty, a manifestation of ruach hakodesh in Esther's action. It thus gives Rav Tzadok a direct Purim example for the link among Malchus, inspired apprehension, and its expression.

140.label: Zohar III 61a (Acharei Mos)
140.rest: — “They call it ruach hakodesh, that is, a spirit from that kodesh above.”

141.label: Bava Basra 12a
141.rest: — "Amemar said: And a sage is greater than a prophet, as it says, 'And a prophet (nevi) has a heart of wisdom' (Tehillim 90:12) — who depends on whom? The lesser on the greater." The Ramban there explains that the Sages' wisdom is a form of ruach hakodesh.

142.label: Raaya Mehemna, Zohar III 223a (Pinchas)
142.rest: — "'I, I am He' (Devarim 32:39) … I am Hashem, I am He and no other; and this 'I' (ani) is from Adnus, and Havayah is the middle pillar."

143.label: Berachos 6b
143.rest: — "Rabbi Chelbo said in the name of Rav Huna: Any person who has fear of Heaven, his words are heard (Rashi: his prayer is accepted), as it says, 'The end of the matter, all having been heard: fear God' (Koheles 12:13)."

144.label: Zohar I, Mikeitz 202a
144.rest: — “We learned: A person should always rouse the good inclination against the evil inclination and strive against it. If it departs from him, well; if not, he should occupy himself with Torah, for there is nothing that breaks the evil inclination except Torah. If it departs, good; if not, let him remind it of the day of death in order to break it.” The Zohar gives a sequence of active resistance, Torah and remembrance of death. Rav Tzadok emphasizes the Oral Torah's lived study as the means of transforming the inward enemy.

145.label: Sukkah 52b
145.rest: — “A person’s inclination overpowers him every day and seeks to kill him … and were it not that the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him, he could not overcome it, as it says: Hashem will not abandon him into his hand.”

146.label: Raaya Mehemna, Zohar III 258a (Pinchas)
146.rest: — "The tefillin of the Master of the world are Keser. And what is the Keser of the Master of the world? Havayah: yud is Chochmah, hei is Binah, vav is Tiferes, comprising six sefiros, and hei is Malchus." The four letters span the nine middos, and Keser above them is alluded to only in the upper tip of the yud.

147.label: Berachos 17a
147.rest: — "Rava used to say: The goal of wisdom is teshuvah and good deeds, so that a person should not read and learn and then kick at his father and mother and his teacher… as it says, 'The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem; good understanding to all who do them' (Tehillim 111:10). It does not say 'to those who do' but 'to those who do them': to those who do them for their own sake."

148.label: Zohar III 65b (Acharei Mos)
148.rest: — "Come and see: the yud at first is the sum of all, hidden on every side, its paths not opened, the sum of male and female; the upper crownlet (kotza) of the yud alludes to Ayin (Nothingness). Afterwards the yud brings forth that river which flows and goes out from it… 'And a river goes out from Eden' (Bereishis 2:10)."

149.label: Zohar II 175b (Terumah)
149.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon said: I have seen that Chochmah includes everything: supernal Chesed issues from Chochmah, and Gevurah, which is severe judgment, issues from Binah; Yaakov completes the two sides, and the Avos include everything."

150.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 48 (85a)
150.rest: — "'Le-dorosam' (written defectively) — what is le-dorosam? Rather: fortunate is he who makes a dwelling (dirah) for them [the upper and lower Shechinah] on Shabbos in the two chambers of the heart, and the evil inclination, which is desecration of Shabbos, is cleared out from there." Similarly Tikkun 6 (22b): "Fortunate is he who prepares for her a fine dwelling in his heart."

151.label: Zohar III 152b (Behaaloscha)
151.rest: — "And if you say that he stands on a higher level in the second month — it is not so. For Israel, the holy seed, who made the Pesach in its time, took the moon and the sun as one, and whoever takes the foundation first takes the building."

152.label: Zohar III 152b (Behaaloscha)
152.rest: — "'A man, a man (ish ish), if he be impure' (Bamidbar 9:10) — why 'man' twice? Because this is a man who is a man, fit to receive the supernal neshamah, and he blemished himself so that the Shechinah does not rest upon him, for he defiled himself."

153.label: Niddah 30b
153.rest: — "And a lamp is lit for him above his head, and he gazes and looks from one end of the world to the other, as it says, 'When His lamp shone above my head, by His light I walked through darkness' (Iyov 29:3)."

154.label: Chagigah 12a
154.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: The light the Holy One, blessed be He, created on the first day — Adam could gaze by it from one end of the world to the other. When the Holy One looked at the generation of the Flood and the generation of the Dispersion and saw that their deeds were corrupt, He arose and hid it from them, as it says, 'And from the wicked their light is withheld' (Iyov 38:15)."

155.label: Sanhedrin 91b
155.rest: — "Antoninus said to Rebbi: From when does the evil inclination hold sway over a person — from the time of formation or from the time of emergence? He said: From formation. He said: If so, it would kick in its mother's womb and come out! Rather, from emergence. Rebbi said: Antoninus taught me this, and a verse supports him: 'Sin crouches at the door' (Bereishis 4:7)."

156.label: Sanhedrin 91b
156.rest: — "Antoninus said to Rebbi: From when is the soul placed in a person — from the time of conception (pekidah) or from the time of formation?… Rather, from conception. Rebbi said: Antoninus taught me this, and a verse supports him: 'And Your providence (pekudascha) preserved my spirit' (Iyov 10:12)."

157.label: Zohar I 60a (Noach)
157.rest: — "Rabbi Yehudah opened: 'Good is the man who is gracious and lends' (Tehillim 112:5). 'Good is the man' — this is the Holy One, blessed be He, who is called 'good,' as it is written, 'Hashem is good to all' (Tehillim 145:9), and it is written, 'Hashem is a man of war' (Shemos 15:3)."

158.label: Zohar I 176b (Vayishlach)
158.rest: — "Therefore the Shechinah is bound to Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov; and Yaakov and Yosef are as one and have a single image, as it is written, 'These are the generations of Yaakov: Yosef' (Bereishis 37:2)."

159.label: Berachos 54b
159.rest: — "It was taught: stones that stood still for the sake of a man and came down for the sake of a man. They stood still for a man — this is Moshe, as it is written, 'And the man Moshe was very humble' (Bamidbar 12:3), and it is written, 'and the thunder and the hail ceased' (Shemos 9:33). They came down for a man — this is Yehoshua, as it is written, 'Take Yehoshua bin Nun, a man in whom there is spirit' (Bamidbar 27:18)."

160.label: Shabbos 88a
160.rest: — "When Israel put 'we will do' before 'we will hear,' sixty myriads of ministering angels came and tied two crowns on each one of Israel… When they sinned, they were taken off… R. Yochanan said: Moshe merited them all and took them, for next to it is written, 'And Moshe would take the tent.'" Rashi: crowns from the radiance of the Shechinah; ohel in the sense of "when His lamp shone (b'hilo)," the radiance of Moshe's face.

161.label: Shabbos 88a
161.rest: — "One hundred twenty myriads of destroying angels came down and removed [the crowns] from them, as it says, 'And the Children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments from Mount Chorev' (Shemos 33:6)… Rabbi Yochanan said: Moshe merited all of them and took them, as the next verse says, 'And Moshe would take the tent.'" Rashi: the two crowns were of the radiance of the Shechinah.

162.label: Sanhedrin 31b
162.rest: — They sent a letter to Mar Ukva: "To the one whose radiance is like that of the son of Bisyah [Moshe], peace!"

163.label: Sanhedrin 31b
163.rest: — "They sent to Mar Ukva: 'To the one whose face shines like the son of Basya — peace!'" Rashi: like Moshe, whom Basya the daughter of Pharaoh raised, the skin of whose face shone; alternatively, "like the son of the house," of whom it is written, "In all My house he is trusted" (Bamidbar 12:7).

164.label: Tosafos, Shabbos 56b (s.v. detzutzisa)
164.rest: — "Rabbeinu Tam says: for it is said in the Midrash that a lamp was burning above his head."

165.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13 (31b)
165.rest: — "From the side of the middle pillar is the Shechinah, a vision while awake, and Moshe on her side, of whom it is written, 'Mouth to mouth I speak with him, in a vision and not in riddles, and he beholds the image of Hashem' (Bamidbar 12:8)."

166.label: Sifrei, Pinchas 140
166.rest: — "'A man in whom there is spirit' (Bamidbar 27:18) — one who is able to go along with the spirit of each and every one."

167.label: Nedarim 22b
167.rest: — “Had Yisrael not sinned, they would have been given only the five books of the Torah and the book of Yehoshua alone, for it contains the arrangement of Eretz Yisrael.”

168.label: Raaya Mehemna, Zohar III 243b (Pinchas)
168.rest: — "The Shechinah is called the land (eretz) of the Holy One, as it is written, 'And the earth is My footstool' (Yeshayahu 66:1). From the side of Chesed she is called water, from the side of Gevurah fire, from the side of the middle pillar air; and she is the earth, the ground of them all."

169.label: Shabbos 88a
169.rest: — “Rabbi Simai expounded: When Israel placed 'We will do' before 'We will hear,' six hundred thousand ministering angels came, and tied two crowns to each individual of Israel, one corresponding to 'We will do' and one to 'We will hear.' When Israel sinned, twelve hundred thousand destructive angels descended and removed them, as it says: 'The children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments from Mount Chorev.' Rabbi Yochanan said: Moshe merited them all and took them. Reish Lakish said: In the future the Holy One, blessed be He, will return them to us, as it says: 'Those redeemed by Hashem will return and come to Zion with song, with everlasting joy upon their heads'—the joy that had been upon their heads from of old. Rabbi Elazar said: When Israel placed 'We will do' before 'We will hear,' a heavenly voice went forth: 'Who revealed to My children this secret used by the ministering angels?' For it is written: 'Bless Hashem, His angels, mighty in strength, who perform His word, to hear the voice of His word'—first performing, and afterward hearing.” This is the source both for the two crowns and for the angelic precedence of doing over hearing. Its account of Moshe receiving the lost crowns and their eventual restoration also underlies the ensuing discussion.

170.label: Zohar III 89a (Emor)
170.rest: — "'And for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has not been a man's' (Vayikra 21:3) — for she is not the portion of Esav, nor was she in the lot of the one of whom it is written, 'a man who knows hunting, a man of the field' (Bereishis 25:27)."

171.label: Pesachim 93a
171.rest: — "A convert who converted between the two Pesachs, and likewise a minor who came of age between the two Pesachs, is obligated to make Pesach Sheni — the words of Rebbi. Rabbi Nasan says: Whoever is obligated in the first is obligated in the second; whoever is not obligated in the first is not obligated in the second."

172.label: Berachos 34b
172.rest: — "Rabbi Abahu said: In the place where baalei teshuvah stand, perfect tzaddikim cannot stand, as it says, 'Peace, peace to the far and to the near' (Yeshayahu 57:19) — first to the far, and then to the near."

173.label: Bava Basra 75a
173.rest: — "'And you shall put of your splendor upon him' (Bamidbar 27:20) — but not all of your splendor. The elders of that generation said: The face of Moshe was like the face of the sun; the face of Yehoshua, like the face of the moon. Woe for that shame, woe for that disgrace!"

174.label: Sefer HaBahir 190
174.rest: — "'The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone' (Tehillim 118:22): the stone that Avraham and Yitzchak, who built the world, rejected has now become the cornerstone."

175.label: Pesachim 95b
175.rest: — "R. Yochanan said in the name of R. Shimon ben Yehotzadak: Scripture says, 'You shall have a song as on the night when a festival is sanctified' (Yeshayahu 30:29): a night sanctified for a festival requires Hallel; a night not sanctified for a festival does not." Rashi: there is no festival night that calls for song except the night of Pesach, over its eating.

176.label: Tanchuma, Beshalach 10
176.rest: — Of the ten songs, the first was said in Egypt, as it says, "The song shall be for you as in the night when a festival is sanctified" (Yeshayahu 30:29).

177.label: Zohar III 152b (Behaaloscha)
177.rest: — "Rabbi Yehudah said: Certainly one takes everything even in the second month, but not like one who takes it in its time. One who brings the Pesach in its time takes from below to above and does not descend, for we raise in holiness and do not lower; and one who takes it after its time descends from above to below."

178.label: Zohar II 186a (Tetzaveh)
178.rest: — "Your month is ordered by the sequence of the letters: Aviv, which is Alef-Beis-Gimel — Yud-Beis is the secret of the letter Gimel. But the seventh month, Mine, is from the end of the letters (Tishrei) [Tav-Shin-Reish]. Why? You are from below upward, and I from above downward."

179.label: Sotah 5a
179.rest: — "'With the crushed and lowly of spirit' (Yeshayahu 57:15): Rav Huna and Rav Chisda — one says, 'With Me is the crushed,' and the other says, 'I am with the crushed.'" Rashi: "With Me is the crushed" — I raise him up until he dwells beside Me; "I am with the crushed" — I lower My Shechinah to be beside him.

180.label: Pirkei D'Rabbi Eliezer 19
180.rest: — "'It is good to give thanks (lehodos) to Hashem' (Tehillim 92:2): Adam HaRishon said: From me all generations will learn that whoever confesses his sins and forsakes them is saved from the judgment of Gehinnom."

181.label: Zohar III 152b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
181.rest: — "The mitzvah to make Pesach Sheni for those who could not, or who were impure… If the secret of Pesach, the secret of the faith that Israel enter, holds sway in Nissan, and that is the time of joy, how can those who could not, or were impure, make it in the second month, when the time has passed?"

182.label: Shabbos 88a
182.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: When Israel put 'we will do' before 'we will hear,' a heavenly voice went forth and said: Who revealed to My children this secret which the ministering angels use, as it is written, 'mighty in strength, who do His word, to hearken to the voice of His word' (Tehillim 103:20)? Rabbi Chama son of Rabbi Chanina said: Why are Israel likened to an apple tree (Shir HaShirim 2:3)? Just as the apple's fruit comes before its leaves, so Israel put 'we will do' before 'we will hear.'"

183.label: Sukkah 25a–b
183.rest: — "'And there were men who were impure through a human corpse' (Bamidbar 9:6) — who were those men? They were the bearers of Yosef's coffin; these are the words of Rabbi Yosi HaGelili. Rabbi Akiva says: They were Mishael and Eltzafan, who were occupied with Nadav and Avihu."

184.label: Berachos 26b
184.rest: — "Avraham instituted the morning prayer, as it says, 'And Avraham rose early in the morning to the place where he had stood' (Bereishis 19:27), and 'standing' means only prayer, as it says, 'And Pinchas stood and prayed' (Tehillim 106:30)."

185.label: Shabbos 89b
185.rest: — “If your sins are like these years, which are arranged and come from the six days of creation until now, they will be made white as snow.”

186.label: Nedarim 22b
186.rest: — “Rav Adda son of Rabbi Chanina said: Had Israel not sinned, they would have been given only the five books of the Torah and the book of Yehoshua, because it describes the division of the Land of Israel. What is the reason? For with much wisdom comes much vexation.” The Gemara also includes the book of Yehoshua; Rav Tzadok abbreviates the quotation while focusing on the Torah's original sufficiency. His explanation of later oral development should be read with that full source context.

187.label: Avodah Zarah 9a
187.rest: — "It was taught in the school of Eliyahu: The world is to exist for six thousand years: two thousand years of tohu, two thousand years of Torah, two thousand years the days of Mashiach." The Gemara reckons the two thousand years of Torah from Avraham's time in Charan.

188.label: Berachos 5b
188.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

189.label: Sanhedrin 102a
189.rest: — "What is 'and the two of them were alone in the field' (I Melachim 11:29)? Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav: That all Torah scholars were like the grass of the field before them. And some say: That all the reasons of the Torah were revealed to them like a field."

190.label: Zohar I 129b (Chayei Sarah)
190.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi said: We learned: the place where the masters of teshuvah stand in that world, perfect tzaddikim have no permission to stand, for they are closer to the King than all, and they draw upon themselves with greater desire of the heart and with great strength to come close to the King."

191.label: Berachos 34b
191.rest: — "Rabbi Abahu said: In the place where baalei teshuvah stand, perfect tzaddikim cannot stand, as it says, 'Peace, peace to the far and to the near' (Yeshayahu 57:19) — first to the far, and then to the near."

192.label: Berachos 34b
192.rest: — "Rabbi Chiya bar Abba said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: All the prophets prophesied only for baalei teshuvah; but as for perfect tzaddikim — 'No eye has seen, O God, except You' (Yeshayahu 64:3)."

193.label: Menachos 29b
193.rest: — "Why was this world created with a hei? Because it resembles a portico: whoever wishes to go out may go out. And why is its leg left hanging? So that if he returns in teshuvah, he is brought back in." Rashi: brought in through the upper opening, between the inner leg and the roof.

194.label: Menachos 29b
194.rest: — "Why was this world created with the letter hei? Because it is like an open portico: whoever wishes to go out may go out. And why is its leg suspended? So that if he returns in teshuvah, he is brought back in [through the upper opening]."

195.label: Eruvin 18b
195.rest: — “Rabbi Yirmiyah ben Elazar said: During all the years that Adam was under a ban he begot spirits, demons and lilin, as it says, ‘Adam lived one hundred and thirty years and begot in his likeness, after his image’—implying that until then he had not begotten after his image. Rabbi Meir said: Adam was greatly pious. When he saw that death had been decreed through him, he fasted for one hundred and thirty years, separated from his wife for one hundred and thirty years, and wore a belt of fig branches for one hundred and thirty years.” The Gemara reconciles the accounts by explaining that the former refers to involuntary emission. Its description of the 130 years is the background here; the connection with the sale of Yosef is Rav Tzadok’s further interpretation.

196.label: Taanis 5b
196.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Yaakov Avinu did not die. He was asked: Was it for nothing that the eulogizers eulogized, the embalmers embalmed and the buriers buried? He answered: I am expounding a verse, as it says, 'And you, fear not, My servant Yaakov… for behold, I save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity' (Yirmeyahu 30:10) — it compares him to his seed: just as his seed is alive, so too he is alive." Rashi: he lives forever; they embalmed him because they thought he had died.

197.label: Zohar I 137b (Toldos)
197.rest: — "'And I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh' (Yechezkel 36:26). What is a heart of flesh? Rabbi Yehudah said: A heart to bring forth flesh."

198.label: Rosh Hashanah 32a
198.rest: — "The 'And He said's of the Creation account are nine! — 'Bereishis' is also an utterance, as it is written, 'By the word of Hashem the heavens were made' (Tehillim 33:6)." Rashi: although "and He said" is not written there, it is as though it were, for heaven too was created by speech and not by hand.

199.label: Zohar III 152b (Behaaloscha)
199.rest: — "'Or on a distant road' (Bamidbar 9:10)… What is 'a distant road'? A person who defiles himself is defiled above; once they defile him above, he is on a distant road from that place and that path to which the seed of Israel is bound."

200.label: Zohar III (Behaaloscha)
200.rest: — "'Or on a distant road' (Bamidbar 9:10) — what is 'a distant road'? A person who defiles himself is defiled from above; and once he is defiled above, he is on a road far from that place and path to which the seed of Israel is bound."

201.label: Arachin 16a
201.rest: — "Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: Nega'im come because of seven things: lashon hara, bloodshed, a false oath, forbidden relations, haughtiness, theft, and stinginess."

202.label: Sukkah 25a–b
202.rest: — "'And there were men who were impure through a human corpse' (Bamidbar 9:6) — who were those men? They were the bearers of Yosef's coffin; these are the words of Rabbi Yosi HaGelili. Rabbi Akiva says: They were Mishael and Eltzafan, who were occupied with Nadav and Avihu."

203.label: Pesachim 66b
203.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: The verse says, 'Any man (ish ish) who is impure through a corpse' (Bamidbar 9:10) — an individual is deferred to Pesach Sheni, but a community is not deferred to Pesach Sheni; rather, they perform it in impurity."

204.label: Zohar III 152b (Behaaloscha)
204.rest: — "Rabbi Yehudah said: Certainly one takes everything even in the second month, but not like one who takes it in its time. One who brings the Pesach in its time takes from below to above and does not descend, for we raise in holiness and do not lower; and one who takes it after its time descends from above to below."

205.label: Sotah 5a
205.rest: — "'With the crushed and lowly of spirit' (Yeshayahu 57:15): Rav Huna and Rav Chisda — one says, 'With Me is the crushed,' and the other says, 'I am with the crushed.'" Rashi: "With Me is the crushed" — I raise him up until he dwells beside Me; "I am with the crushed" — I lower My Shechinah to be beside him.

206.label: Zohar III 152b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
206.rest: — "All those thirty days from the day Israel went out, from Pesach, the Matronita sits in her crown and all the host is in joy; whoever wishes to see the Matronita may see her. The herald proclaims: Whoever could not see the Matronita, let him come and see before the gates are closed. When? On the fourteenth of the second month; from then, for seven days, the gates are open."

207.label: Kiddushin 38a
207.rest: — "'And the children of Israel ate the manna forty years' (Shemos 16:35): did they eat it forty years? They ate it forty years less thirty days! Rather, this tells you that the cakes they took out of Egypt — they tasted in them the taste of manna." Rashi: for they ate of that dough from the fifteenth of Nisan until the sixteenth of Iyar, when the manna first fell.

208.label: Berachos 17a
208.rest: — "Master of the worlds, it is revealed and known before You that our will is to do Your will. And who prevents us? The leaven in the dough and the subjugation to the kingdoms." Rashi: the leaven in the dough is the evil inclination in our hearts, which sours us.

209.label: Bava Metzia 84a
209.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: I have remained of the beautiful men of Yerushalayim. Whoever wishes to see the beauty of Rabbi Yochanan should bring a silver goblet fresh from the smith, fill it with seeds of red pomegranate, set a garland of red roses about its rim, and place it between sun and shade: that radiance is a glimpse of Rabbi Yochanan's beauty."

210.label: Berachos 20a
210.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan would sit at the gates of the mikveh. He said: When the daughters of Israel come up from immersion, let them look at me, so that they will have children as beautiful as I. The Rabbis said: Is the master not afraid of the evil eye? He said: I come from the seed of Yosef, over whom the evil eye has no power, as it is written, 'Yosef is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by the eye' (Bereishis 49:22)."

211.label: Zohar III 117b–118a (Bamidbar)
211.rest: — "No counting of Israel blessed them like this counting… They were counted in the place from which blessings issue, as it is written, 'on the first of the second month' — which is the radiance (ziva) of the blessings of the world, from which radiance goes out to the world; therefore it is called the month of Ziv, for the radiance of all goes out from it."

212.label: Gittin 67a
212.rest: — "And so Rabbi Shimon said to his students: My sons, learn my measures, for my measures are the choicest of the choicest of the measures of Rabbi Akiva." Rashi: "my measures" — my Torah; "the choicest" — I selected them from the essence of his teaching.

213.label: Zohar Chadash, Toldos
213.rest: — Corresponding to the seven supernal days, He created on earth seven true tzaddikim, each corresponding to his day, the fathers of the world: Avraham, Yitzchak, Yaakov, Yosef, Moshe, Aharon and David; they are called "the ancient mountains," for they depend on those seven supernal days — the six days of Bereishis and the seventh that stands before them; as it says, "And the house of David shall be like God" (Zecharyah 12:8).

214.label: Zohar III 152b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
214.rest: — "The Shechinah is the first Pesach from the right and the second Pesach from the left: the first Pesach from the right, where Chochmah is; the second Pesach from the left, where Binah is. And because in Gevurah all foreign fires, which are like straw and chaff before the fire of Gevurah, are consumed, the impure are deferred to the second Pesach."

215.label: Menachos 29b
215.rest: — "He said: Master of the world, show him to me. He said: Turn around. He went and sat at the end of eight rows and did not understand what they were saying, and his strength waned. When they reached a certain matter, his students said to him: Rebbi, from where do you know this? He said: It is a halachah to Moshe from Sinai — and Moshe's mind was settled." Rashi: since it was said in his name.

216.label: Tanchuma, Chukas 8
216.rest: — "Things that were not revealed to Moshe were revealed to Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues; 'and every precious thing his eye beheld' (Iyov 28:10) — this is Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues."

217.label: Megillah 16b
217.rest: — “'The Jews had light, joy, gladness, and honor.' Rav Yehudah said: 'Light' is Torah, as it is said, 'For a commandment is a lamp and Torah is light.' 'Joy' is the festival, as it is said, 'You shall rejoice in your festival.' 'Gladness' is circumcision, as it is said, 'I rejoice over Your word.'” The next line identifies 'honor' with tefillin, specifically the tefillin of the head. The Gemara establishes the Torah meaning of light; the feminine form orah as an allusion to the Oral Torah is Rav Tzadok's reading.

218.label: Menachos 29b
218.rest: — "Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav: When Moshe ascended on high, he found the Holy One, blessed be He, sitting and tying crowns to the letters. He said: Master of the world, who holds You back? He said: There is a man who will be at the end of many generations, Akiva ben Yosef is his name, who will expound upon each and every crownlet heaps upon heaps of halachos."

219.label: Sukkah 52a
219.rest: — "This eulogy — over what is it? Rabbi Dosa and the Rabbis disagree: one says, over Mashiach ben Yosef, who will be killed; the other says, over the evil inclination, which will be killed."

220.label: Kiddushin 38a
220.rest: — "From where do we know that Moshe was born on the seventh of Adar? For it says, 'I am a hundred and twenty years old today' (Devarim 31:2): 'today' teaches that the Holy One, blessed be He, sits and fills the years of the righteous from day to day and from month to month, as it says, 'The number of your days I will fill' (Shemos 23:26)."

221.label: Yerushalmi, Sanhedrin 1:2
221.rest: — Rabbi Akiva ordained Rabbi Meir and Rabbi Shimon; he said, "Let Rabbi Meir sit first," and Rabbi Shimon's face fell. Rabbi Akiva said to him: "It is enough for you that I and your Creator know your strength."

222.label: Nedarim 22b
222.rest: — “Had Israel not sinned, they would have been given only the five books of the Torah and the book of Yehoshua … as it says: For in much wisdom is much anger.”

223.label: Rema, Orach Chaim 1:1
223.rest: — "When a person takes to heart that the great King, the Holy One, blessed be He, whose glory fills the whole earth, stands over him and sees his deeds, as it says, 'Can a man hide in secret places that I shall not see him? says Hashem' (Yirmeyahu 23:24) — immediately awe and submission will come upon him, in dread of Hashem Yisbarach, and he will be ashamed before Him constantly."

224.label: Bava Basra 8a
224.rest: — "'Though they study (yisnu) among the nations, now I will gather them; and they shall be relieved a little from the burden of king and princes' (Hoshea 8:10). Ulla said: This verse was said in Aramaic: if they all study, now I will gather them; and if only a few of them, they will be relieved of the burden of king and princes."

225.label: Chagigah 5b
225.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan went out to the study hall and expounded: 'Yet Me they seek day by day' (Yeshayahu 58:2) — do they seek Him by day and not by night? Rather, to tell you: whoever occupies himself with Torah even one day a year, Scripture regards him as if he occupied himself the whole year."

226.label: Avodah Zarah 20b
226.rest: — "Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair said: Torah leads to watchfulness, watchfulness to alacrity, alacrity to cleanliness, cleanliness to separation, separation to purity, purity to piety, piety to humility, humility to fear of sin, fear of sin to holiness, holiness to ruach hakodesh, and ruach hakodesh to the resurrection of the dead."

227.label: Yerushalmi, Shekalim 3:3 (so too Avodah Zarah 20b)
227.rest: — "Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair says: Torah leads to watchfulness, watchfulness to alacrity, alacrity to cleanliness, cleanliness to separation, separation to purity… purity leads to holiness" — as it says, "And he shall purify it and sanctify it" (Vayikra 16:19).

228.label: Berachos 4b
228.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Who is a ben Olam Haba? One who joins redemption (geulah) to the evening prayer." There too: "Whoever says Tehillah L'David (Tehillim 145) three times each day is assured that he is a ben Olam Haba."

229.label: Taanis 22a
229.rest: — "Rabbi Beroka Choza'ah was often in the market of Bei Lefet, and Eliyahu would appear to him. He said to him: Is there anyone in this market who is a ben Olam Haba? He said: No. Meanwhile he saw a man wearing black shoes, without a thread of techeiles on his garment. He said: This one is a ben Olam Haba."

230.label: Kesubos 103b
230.rest: — "On the day of Rebbi's passing a heavenly voice went forth and said: Whoever was present at Rebbi's passing is destined for the life of Olam Haba. A certain launderer used to come before him every day; that day he did not come. When he heard this he went up to a roof, fell to the ground and died. A heavenly voice went forth: That launderer too is destined for the life of Olam Haba."

231.label: Sotah 5a
231.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: Any person who has haughtiness of spirit — his dust will not be stirred up, as it says, 'Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust' (Yeshayahu 26:19). It does not say 'who lie in the dust' but 'who dwell (shochnei) in the dust' — one who became a neighbor of the dust in his lifetime."

232.label: Sotah 21a
232.rest: — “‘When you lie down it shall guard you’—this is death; ‘and when you awake it shall speak with you’—in the World to Come.”

233.label: Sanhedrin 92b
233.rest: — "And Shmuel said: [The dead whom Yechezkel revived] were people who denied the resurrection of the dead, as it says, 'Behold, they say: Our bones are dried up and our hope is lost' (Yechezkel 37:11)." Rashi: these bones are a sign for all Israel that the resurrection awaits them.

234.label: Berachos 26b
234.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi son of Rabbi Chanina said: The prayers were instituted by the Avos. Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said: The prayers were instituted corresponding to the daily offerings (temidin)."

235.label: Rashbam, Pesachim 119a (s.v. mashui shelosh me'os)
235.rest: — "Not precisely; and so too every 'three hundred' in Shas."

236.label: Zohar I 123b (Chayei Sarah)
