But the holy spirit cries: Though he makes his voice gracious, do not believe him, for seven abominations are in his heart.” Esau’s performance imitates Torah devotion in speech. This is the precedent for the apparent equivalence Rav Tzadok sees in the offerings of Bilam and the money of Haman.

470.label: Kiddushin 30b
470.rest: — "I created the evil inclination; I created Torah as its antidote… The school of Rabbi Yishmael taught: My son, if this repulsive one accosts you, drag him to the beis midrash: if he is stone, he will melt; if he is iron, he will shatter, as it says, 'Is not My word like fire, says Hashem, and like a hammer that shatters rock?' (Yirmeyahu 23:29)." Rashi: "this repulsive one" is the evil inclination provoking you.

471.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a
471.rest: — “You brought forth ten arrangements, and we call them ten sefirot, through which to direct concealed worlds that are not revealed and worlds that are revealed. ... Malkhut is the mouth: we call it Oral Torah.” The specific formula “Malkhut is the mouth, Oral Torah” is found in the introduction to Tikkunei Zohar, in Patach Eliyahu. It complements the preceding Zohar passage about the seventh day.

472.label: Zohar I 47b (Bereishis)
472.rest: — “‘And God finished on the seventh day’: this is Torah she'b'al peh, which is the seventh day.”

473.label: Zohar I 137a–138a (Midrash HaNe'elam, Toldos)
473.rest: — "'The sister of Lavan' — the sister of the evil inclination. At first, when it was disgraced with sins in this world, it was called Lot; in the time to come, when it will no longer be disgraced as before, like one who bathes and immerses himself from his impurity, it is called Lavan (white)."

474.label: Pesikta d'Rav Kahana 12:18
474.rest: — "Rabbi Aibu said: 'The month has come.' When the Holy One, blessed be He, revealed Himself to Moshe, He stipulated with him: 'When you bring the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God upon this mountain' (Shemos 3:12). Moshe kept waiting: When will it come? When the time arrived, the Holy One said to him: The month you were waiting for has come — 'in the third month' (Shemos 19:1)."

475.label: Shemos Rabbah 3:4
475.rest: — "'When you bring the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God upon this mountain' (Shemos 3:12): as for what you asked, 'In what merit shall I bring them out of Egypt?' — know that it is in the merit of the Torah that they are destined to receive through you on this mountain that they go out from there."

476.label: Zohar III 281b (Ki Seitzei, Ra'aya Meheimna)
476.rest: — "May it be His will that my deeds be reckoned before the Holy One and His Shechinah as those of a son who exerts himself for his father and mother, whom he loves more than himself… and although I know that all is in His power, the Merciful One desires the heart."

477.label: Rema, Orach Chaim 1:1
477.rest: — "When a person takes to heart that the great King, the Holy One, blessed be He, whose glory fills the whole earth, stands over him and sees his deeds, as it says, 'Can a man hide in secret places that I shall not see him? says Hashem' (Yirmeyahu 23:24) — immediately awe and submission will come upon him, in dread of Hashem Yisbarach, and he will be ashamed before Him constantly."

478.label: Pesikta d'Rav Kahana 12:21
478.rest: — "'On this day they came to the wilderness of Sinai' (Shemos 19:1) — did they come on this day? Rather: when you learn My words, let them not be old in your eyes, but as though the Torah were given today. It does not say 'on that day' but 'on this day.'"

479.label: Eruvin 54a
479.rest: — "Rav Masna said: What is meant by 'And from the wilderness, Mattanah' (Bamidbar 21:18)? If a person makes himself like a wilderness on which all tread, his learning endures in his hand; and if not, his learning does not endure in his hand."

480.label: Tanchuma, Bamidbar 6
480.rest: — "'In the wilderness of Sinai' — why in the wilderness of Sinai? Rather: whoever does not make himself ownerless (hefker) like a wilderness cannot acquire the Torah."

481.label: Tanchuma, Noach 3
481.rest: — Israel accepted the Written Torah willingly, but not the Oral Torah, which requires toil and suffering; and for it the Holy One held the mountain over them like a barrel. The Oral Torah is not found with one who seeks the pleasures of the world.

482.label: Shabbos 88a
482.rest: — “Rabbi Simai expounded: When Israel placed 'We will do' before 'We will hear,' six hundred thousand ministering angels came, and tied two crowns to each individual of Israel, one corresponding to 'We will do' and one to 'We will hear.' When Israel sinned, twelve hundred thousand destructive angels descended and removed them, as it says: 'The children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments from Mount Chorev.' Rabbi Yochanan said: Moshe merited them all and took them. Reish Lakish said: In the future the Holy One, blessed be He, will return them to us, as it says: 'Those redeemed by Hashem will return and come to Zion with song, with everlasting joy upon their heads'—the joy that had been upon their heads from of old. Rabbi Elazar said: When Israel placed 'We will do' before 'We will hear,' a heavenly voice went forth: 'Who revealed to My children this secret used by the ministering angels?' For it is written: 'Bless Hashem, His angels, mighty in strength, who perform His word, to hear the voice of His word'—first performing, and afterward hearing.” This is the source both for the two crowns and for the angelic precedence of doing over hearing. Its account of Moshe receiving the lost crowns and their eventual restoration also underlies the ensuing discussion.

483.label: Mechilta, Yisro, Bachodesh 1
483.rest: — "'And Israel encamped there' (Shemos 19:2): wherever it says 'they journeyed… and they encamped,' they journeyed in dissension and encamped in dissension; but here it says 'And Israel encamped there' — they all became equal, of one heart."

484.label: Pesikta D'Rav Kahana 12:19
484.rest: — "It does not say 'in the third yerach,' as it calls the other months — 'in the yerach of Ziv,' 'in the yerach of Bul,' 'in the yerach of Eisanim' — but 'in the third chodesh': Rabbi Yehudah bar Rabbi Simon said: The Holy One said to them, I am doing a new thing (chiddush) and renewing you."

485.label: Bava Basra 121a
485.rest: — "He said to him: The festivals of Hashem require sanctification by beis din; the Shabbos of Creation does not require sanctification by beis din." The Rashbam explains that beis din sanctified the months, and the festivals followed from them.

486.label: Eruvin 41a
486.rest: — “After Rabban Gamliel died, Rabbi Yehoshua entered to overturn his ruling. Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri stood and said: I see that the body follows the head! Throughout Rabban Gamliel's life we established the law according to him; now you wish to overturn his words? Yehoshua, we do not heed you, for the law has already been established according to Rabban Gamliel, and no one disputed the matter.” The proverb occurs in a dispute about maintaining an established ruling after a leader's death. Rav Tzadok applies its image to Rosh Chodesh as the head that directs the month.

487.label: Taanis 11b
487.rest: — "…as though the Holy One dwells within his innards, as it says, 'In your midst is the Holy One' (Hoshea 11:9)."

488.label: Tanchuma, Vayechi 15
488.rest: — "'All these are the tribes of Israel, twelve' (Bereishis 49:28)… These tribes follow the order of the world: twelve hours in the day and twelve hours at night, and so too the constellations and the months, and the twelve stones of the Ephod."

489.label: Zohar III 2a (beginning of Vayikra)
489.rest: — "And so with Rachav, what is written? 'Give me a true sign (os emes)' (Yehoshua 2:12) — this is the letter vav, which is called the sign of truth. And if you say the other letters are not truth — they are, but this letter is called 'the sign of truth.'"

490.label: Berachos 5b
490.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

491.label: Zohar III 122b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
491.rest: — "Two letters awaken a person to Torah and mitzvah. Yud is fear: it rests upon a person's head, and from it fear enters his heart to fear the Holy One, blessed be He… Hei is love… And Vav rests upon a person's head, and from it there enter into his mouth words with which to study Torah."

492.label: Zohar II 54a, Beshalach
492.rest: — “Rabbi Abba said: I considered all the praises with which they praised the Holy One, blessed be He, and all began with ‘Then’: ‘Then Solomon said’; ‘Then Joshua spoke’; ‘Then Israel sang.’ Why? All the miracles and mighty deeds done for Israel occur when the light of the Holy Ancient One shines in His crowns, engraved and marked in az—in the alef. The alef pierces the darkness and illumines every side. When the alef's illumination joins and reaches the zayin—what is the zayin? 'Hashem's sword is filled with blood'—then He performs miracles and mighty deeds, because alef has joined with zayin. This is song, song on every side; this is 'Then Moshe sang.'” The Zohar reads az, 'then,' through its letters, alef and zayin. Rav Tzadok applies the same joining of supernal illumination with the lower levels to the future 'Then our mouth shall be filled with laughter.'

493.label: Zohar II 51a (Beshalach)
493.rest: — "So the Holy One, from His great affection and love for Knesses Yisrael, gave everything into her authority. … The King sent out a proclamation: all the King's affairs are given into the hand of the Matronita; He entrusted into her hand all His weapons — spears, swords, bows…"

494.label: Berachos 30b
494.rest: — "Rabbi Yirmeyah was sitting before Rabbi Zeira, who saw that he was very cheerful. He said to him: It is written, 'In all sorrow there will be profit' (Mishlei 14:23)! He said to him: I am wearing tefillin."

495.label: Taanis 15a
495.rest: — "Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: I too say: not all are for light and not all are for gladness. The righteous are for light, and the upright for gladness: the righteous for light, as it is written, 'Light is sown for the righteous' (Tehillim 97:11); and the upright for gladness, as it is written, 'and for the upright of heart, gladness.'"

496.label: Megillah 6a
496.rest: — "Zevulun said before the Holy One: Master of the world, to my brothers You gave fields and vineyards, and to me mountains and hills; to my brothers lands, and to me seas and rivers. He said: All will need you because of the chilazon, as it says, 'They shall call peoples to the mountain… the hidden treasures of the sand' (Devarim 33:19)." Rashi: from all the tribes they will gather to your mountain to buy.

497.label: Sefer Yetzirah 5
497.rest: — "He made the letter vav king over thought (hirhur), bound a crown to it, combined them one with another, and formed with them Taurus in the world, Iyar in the year, and the right kidney in the soul."

498.label: Zohar I 202a (Miketz)
498.rest: — “There is nothing that breaks the evil inclination except Torah.”

499.label: Rambam, Hilchos Issurei Biah 22:21
499.rest: — "Greater than all this, they said: Let him turn himself and his thoughts to words of Torah and broaden his mind with wisdom, for thoughts of forbidden relations overpower only a heart empty of wisdom; and of wisdom it says, 'A loving hind and a graceful doe… with her love be ravished always' (Mishlei 5:19)."

500.label: Berachos 11a
500.rest: — "Beis Hillel say: 'And when you walk on the way' (Devarim 6:7) — in your own walking," that is, in one's ordinary going about, not only at set times.

501.label: Zohar II 54a, Beshalach
501.rest: — “Rabbi Abba said: I considered all the praises with which they praised the Holy One, blessed be He, and all began with ‘Then’: ‘Then Solomon said’; ‘Then Joshua spoke’; ‘Then Israel sang.’ Why? All the miracles and mighty deeds done for Israel occur when the light of the Holy Ancient One shines in His crowns, engraved and marked in az—in the alef. The alef pierces the darkness and illumines every side. When the alef's illumination joins and reaches the zayin—what is the zayin? 'Hashem's sword is filled with blood'—then He performs miracles and mighty deeds, because alef has joined with zayin. This is song, song on every side; this is 'Then Moshe sang.'” The Zohar reads az, 'then,' through its letters, alef and zayin. Rav Tzadok applies the same joining of supernal illumination with the lower levels to the future 'Then our mouth shall be filled with laughter.'

502.label: Zohar II 51a
502.rest: — "So the Holy One, blessed is He, out of His great love for Knesses Yisrael, placed everything in her domain… The King issued a proclamation: From now on all the King's affairs are handed to the Queen. He placed in her hand all His weapons: spears, swords, bows, arrows and blades…"

503.label: Zohar III 274b (Shoftim)
503.rest: — "The sheath of the sword is Adnus; there judgment is found. In Krias Shema, Havayah is the sword of the Holy One, blessed be He, of which it is said, 'Exaltations of God in their throat, and a double-edged sword in their hand' (Tehillim 149:6)."

504.label: Sukkah 52a
504.rest: — “Rabbi Avira expounded—or some say Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi: The evil inclination has seven names. The Holy One, blessed be He, called it Evil, as it says, 'The inclination of a person's heart is evil from his youth.' Moshe called it Uncircumcised, as it says, 'Circumcise the foreskin of your hearts.' David called it Impure, as it says, 'Create a pure heart for me, God,' implying that an impure heart exists.” Rav Tzadok singles out the Divine name 'Evil' and relates it to the desire described in the Flood generation. The Gemara itself supplies the citation of Genesis 8:21.

505.label: Shabbos 89b
505.rest: — "The wilderness of Sinai — from which hatred (sinah) descended upon the nations of the world. And what is its name? Chorev is its name. And this disagrees with Rabbi Abahu, for Rabbi Abahu said: Mount Sinai is its name; and why is it called Mount Chorev? Because destruction (churbah) descended upon the nations of the world from it."

506.label: Avodah Zarah 5a
506.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: Let us be grateful to our forefathers, for had they not sinned we would not have come into the world, as it says, 'I said: you are angels (elohim), all of you children of the Most High' — you corrupted your deeds — 'therefore like men you shall die' (Tehillim 82:6–7)."

507.label: Zohar II 36a (Bo)
507.rest: — "Rabbi Chizkiyah taught: It is written, 'And Hashem will strike Egypt, striking and healing' (Yeshayahu 19:22) — striking for Egypt and healing for Israel. What is the healing? That they were circumcised and needed healing."

508.label: Mechilta, Beshalach, Shirah 3
508.rest: — "'This is my God and I will glorify Him' (Shemos 15:2). Rabbi Eliezer says: From where do you say that a maidservant saw at the Sea what Yeshayahu and Yechezkel did not see? For it says, 'and through the prophets I was imaged' (Hoshea 12:11)… When the Holy One, blessed be He, was revealed at the Sea, no one needed to ask, 'Which is the King?'"

509.label: Zohar II 60a, Beshalach
509.rest: — “What is ‘the wilderness of Shur’? A wilderness where they wished to gaze at the radiance of the glory of the holy King.”

510.label: Zohar II 82a (Yisro)
510.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi son of Rabbi Yehudah said: Israel saw here what Yechezkel ben Buzi did not see, and all of them cleaved to the precious supernal wisdom."

511.label: Sanhedrin 59a
511.rest: — “Rabbi Yochanan said: A gentile who occupies himself with Torah is liable to death, as it is said: 'Moshe commanded us the Torah, an inheritance'—it is our inheritance, not theirs.” The same discussion cites Rabbi Meir: a gentile who studies Torah is like a High Priest, and explains that statement as referring to the seven commandments incumbent upon them. The passage therefore distinguishes Israel's covenantal Torah inheritance from the study appropriate to the nations' own obligations; it does not exclude that study.

512.label: Bava Metzia 33b
512.rest: — “‘And to the house of Yaakov their sins’ (Yeshayah 58:1) — these are the amei ha’aretz, whose deliberate sins are counted for them as unwitting ones.”

513.label: Tanchuma, Tzav 2
513.rest: — "In the World to Come, when the Holy One, blessed be He, exacts retribution from Esav, what does Esav do? He wraps himself in his tallis like an elder and comes and sits beside Yaakov… as it is written, 'Though you set your nest among the stars' (Ovadiah 1:4) — and the stars are none other than Israel."

514.label: Taanis 26b (Mishnah)
514.rest: — "'On the day of his wedding and on the day of the joy of his heart' (Shir HaShirim 3:11): 'the day of his wedding' — this is the Giving of the Torah." Rashi: this is Yom Kippur, on which the last tablets were given.

515.label: Eruvin 54a
515.rest: — "Rabbi Eliezer said: What is meant by 'engraved (charus) on the tablets' (Shemos 32:16)? Had the first tablets not been broken, the Torah would never have been forgotten from Israel." Rashi: through the tablets Israel were free men (cheirus).

516.label: Bava Basra 16a
516.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: He is the Satan, he is the evil inclination, he is the Angel of Death. He is the Satan, as it is written, 'And the Satan went out from before Hashem' (Iyov 2:7); he is the evil inclination, as it is written there, 'only evil all day' (Bereishis 6:5)…; he is the Angel of Death, as it is written, 'only guard his soul' (Iyov 2:6)."

517.label: Zohar II 82b (Yisro)
517.rest: — "We learned: six hundred and thirteen kinds of counsel (zinei eitin) the Torah gave to a person, to be whole with his Master, for his Master wishes to do him good in this world and in the World to Come."

518.label: Zohar III 272a (Eikev)
518.rest: — "Whoever recites Krias Shema on his bed is as though he holds a double-edged sword, as it is written, 'Exaltations of God in their throat, and a double-edged sword in their hand' (Tehillim 149:6)… The vav is the body of the sword, the yud the tip of the sword, the two hei's its two edges, and the sheath of the sword is Adnus."

519.label: Zohar III, 2a
519.rest: — “‘Ask for yourself a sign’—an actual letter, for all was carried through the mystery of letters. Of Rachav it says, ‘Give me a true sign’: This is the letter Vav, which is called the letter of truth. Are the other letters not truth? They are, but this letter is called the letter of truth.” The maamar joins the designation of Vav with “Give truth to Yaakov,” identifying the patriarchal quality within the letter.

520.label: Berachos 5b
520.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

521.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a
521.rest: — “You brought forth ten arrangements, and we call them ten sefirot, through which to direct concealed worlds that are not revealed and worlds that are revealed. ... Malkhut is the mouth: we call it Oral Torah.” The specific formula “Malkhut is the mouth, Oral Torah” is found in the introduction to Tikkunei Zohar, in Patach Eliyahu. It complements the preceding Zohar passage about the seventh day.

522.label: Sukkah 52b
522.rest: — “If this repulsive one encounters you, drag him to the beis midrash.”

523.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 48 (85a)
523.rest: — “Twice Shabbos is mentioned here, corresponding to the upper and lower Shechinah. ‘For their generations’: fortunate is he who makes them a dwelling on Shabbos in the two chambers of the heart.”

524.label: Taanis 31a
524.rest: — "Ulla of Bira said in the name of Rabbi Elazar: In the future the Holy One, blessed be He, will make a circle dance for the righteous, and He will sit among them in Gan Eden, and each one will point with his finger, as it says, 'And it shall be said on that day: Behold, this is our God; we hoped to Him and He saved us… let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation' (Yeshayahu 25:9)."

525.label: Pesikta d'Rav Kahana 12:21
525.rest: — "'On this day they came to the wilderness of Sinai' (Shemos 19:1) — did they come on this day? Rather: when you learn My words, let them not be old in your eyes, but as though the Torah were given today. It does not say 'on that day' but 'on this day.'"

526.label: Shabbos 89b
526.rest: — "The wilderness of Sinai — from which hatred (sinah) descended upon the nations of the world. And what is its name? Chorev is its name. And this disagrees with Rabbi Abahu, for Rabbi Abahu said: Mount Sinai is its name; and why is it called Mount Chorev? Because destruction (churbah) descended upon the nations of the world from it."

527.label: Tikkunei Zohar 13, 29a
527.rest: — “Yaakov is the image of the central pillar from the outside. But was not Moshe there? Rather, he was from the inner side: this one from the body, that one from the soul.”

528.label: Taanis 5b
528.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Yaakov Avinu did not die. He was asked: Was it for nothing that the eulogizers eulogized, the embalmers embalmed and the buriers buried? He answered: I am expounding a verse, as it says, 'And you, fear not, My servant Yaakov… for behold, I save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity' (Yirmeyahu 30:10) — it compares him to his seed: just as his seed is alive, so too he is alive." Rashi: he lives forever; they embalmed him because they thought he had died.

529.label: Sotah 13b
529.rest: — "Rabbi Eliezer HaGadol says: Over twelve mil by twelve mil, corresponding to the camp of Israel, a heavenly voice proclaimed, 'And Moshe died' — the great scribe of Israel. And some say: Moshe did not die. It is written here, 'And Moshe died there' (Devarim 34:5), and there, 'And he was there with Hashem' (Shemos 34:28): just as there he stood and served, so here he stands and serves."

530.label: Berachos 64a
530.rest: — "R. Chiya bar Ashi said in the name of Rav: Torah scholars have no rest, neither in this world nor in the World to Come, as it says, 'They go from strength to strength; [each] appears before God in Tzion.'" Rashi: they go from yeshivah to yeshivah and from midrash to midrash.

531.label: Berachos 64a
531.rest: — "Torah scholars have no rest, neither in this world nor in the World to Come, as it says, 'They go from strength to strength; each one appears before God in Tziyon' (Tehillim 84:8)." Rashi: from yeshivah to yeshivah and from beis midrash to beis midrash.

532.label: Tanchuma, Behaaloscha 5
532.rest: — "All the nesi'im brought offerings except the nasi of Levi. And who was the nasi of Levi? Aharon, as it says, 'And write Aharon's name upon the staff of Levi' (Bamidbar 17:18). Aharon did not bring with the nesi'im, and said: Woe is me, perhaps because of me the tribe of Levi is not accepted."

533.label: Tanchuma, Bamidbar 17
533.rest: — "'Count the sons of Levi' — this tribe was beloved before the Holy One more than all the tribes, as it says, 'And I chose him from all the tribes of Israel to be My Kohen' (I Shmuel 2:28). The Holy One created days and chose one of them, as it says, 'Days were fashioned, and to Him is one among them' (Tehillim 139:16). Which is it? Rabbi Levi said: The day of Shabbos."

534.label: Zohar III 20a (Ra'aya Meheimna)
534.rest: — "Seventy of the Great Sanhedrin with Moshe over them, and seventy of the Small Sanhedrin with Aharon over them. Therefore the masters of the Mishnah said: Moshe was the groomsman of the King, which is Tiferes, from where the Great Sanhedrin is; Aharon the groomsman of the Matronita, which is Malchus."

535.label: Kerisos 6b
535.rest: — "Rav Chana bar Bizna said in the name of Rabbi Shimon Chasida: Any fast that does not include some of the transgressors of Israel is not a fast; for galbanum has a foul smell, and yet the verse counted it among the spices of the incense."

536.label: Eruvin 21b
536.rest: — “‘The mandrakes give forth fragrance’ … these and those will in the future give forth fragrance.”

537.label: Sefer Yetzirah 5
537.rest: — "He made the letter zayin king over walking, bound a crown to it, combined them one with another, and formed with them Gemini in the world, Sivan in the year, and the left foot in the soul."

538.label: Zohar II 78b (Yisro)
538.rest: — "Because Yaakov is Twins (te'omim), the Torah was given to his children in the month of Twins — the Torah in the secret of Twins: the Written Torah and the Oral Torah; in the third month, to a threefold people, in threefold levels; a threefold Torah — Torah, Prophets and Writings — and all is one."

539.label: Rosh, Kiddushin 1:41
539.rest: — The order of Pidyon HaBen instituted by the Geonim: the Kohen blesses, "Blessed are You… Who sanctified the fetus in its mother's womb, and on the fortieth day apportioned its two hundred forty-eight limbs, and breathed into it a soul…" — on which the Rosh raises his question, since the sanctity of the firstborn depends on "opening the womb."

540.label: Shabbos 146a
540.rest: — "When the serpent came upon Chavah it cast filth (zuhama) into her; Israel, who stood at Mount Sinai — their filth ceased… Rabbi Abba bar Kahana said: For three generations the filth did not cease from our fathers: Avraham fathered Yishmael, Yitzchak fathered Esav; Yaakov fathered twelve tribes in whom there was no blemish at all." Rashi: the serpent came upon her when it advised her to eat from the tree.

541.label: Shabbos 146a: the serpent's contamination left our forefathers only after three generations
541.rest: — Avraham fathered Yishmael, Yitzchak Esav, Yaakov twelve flawless tribes. The opposing view (“they disagree”) is R. Yochanan's just before it: “Israel, who stood at Mount Sinai — their contamination ceased” — the “until the giving of the Torah” of the next line, which Rav Tzadok reconciles with this one.

542.label: Sanhedrin 91b
542.rest: — "Antoninus said to Rebbi: From when does the evil inclination hold sway over a person — from the time of formation or from the time of emergence? He said: From formation. He said: If so, it would kick in its mother's womb and come out! Rather, from emergence. Rebbi said: Antoninus taught me this, and a verse supports him: 'Sin crouches at the door' (Bereishis 4:7)."

543.label: Niddah 30b
543.rest: — "And a lamp is lit for him above his head, and he gazes and looks from one end of the world to the other, as it says, 'When His lamp shone above my head, by His light I walked through darkness' (Iyov 29:3)."

544.label: Chagigah 12a
544.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: The light the Holy One, blessed be He, created on the first day — Adam could gaze by it from one end of the world to the other. When the Holy One looked at the generation of the Flood and the generation of the Dispersion and saw that their deeds were corrupt, He arose and hid it from them, as it says, 'And from the wicked their light is withheld' (Iyov 38:15)."

545.label: Zohar II 11b (Shemos)
545.rest: — "'She hid him three months' (Shemos 2:2). Rabbi Yehudah said: It is an allusion that Moshe was not recognized in the supernal radiance until three months, as it is written, 'In the third month' (Shemos 19:1), for then the Torah was given through him and the Shechinah was revealed and rested upon him before the eyes of all."

546.label: Zohar I 142a (Toldos)
546.rest: — "'Light' is from the right side, the light of the first day, of which it is said, 'Let there be light' — this is Avraham; 'darkness' is from the left side, said of Yitzchak, 'and his eyes were dim from seeing' (Bereishis 27:1) — 'and the darkness He called night'; and Yaakov is clothed in both."

547.label: Yoma 28b
547.rest: — "Rav said: Avraham Avinu fulfilled the entire Torah, as it says, 'Because Avraham listened to My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes and My Torahs' (Bereishis 26:5). Rav Shimi bar Chiya said to Rav: Perhaps only the seven mitzvos? — There was milah too! — Perhaps seven and milah? — If so, why 'My commandments and My Torahs'?"

548.label: Sanhedrin 59a
548.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: An idolater who occupies himself with Torah is liable to death, as it says, 'Moshe commanded us the Torah, an inheritance (morashah) of the congregation of Yaakov' (Devarim 33:4) — an inheritance for us and not for them." The Gemara also reads it me'orasah, "betrothed."

549.label: Zohar I 104a (Vayera)
549.rest: — "And if you say there were three angels — one fire, one water and one wind — rather, each was included in his fellow; and therefore 'they ate,' as in 'they beheld God and ate and drank' (Shemos 24:11): they were nourished from the Shechinah. So here, 'they ate' — they gave a sign that they were nourished from that side to which Avraham cleaved."

550.label: Zohar III 7b (Vayikra)
550.rest: — The fragrance of the offering rose, and therefore it is called "a pleasing aroma to Hashem"… and the King's meal waits for the meal of His servants; "and therefore Israel sustain their Father in Heaven."

551.label: Sukkah 52a
551.rest: — "Rabbi Avira — some say Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi — expounded: The evil inclination has seven names. The Holy One called it 'evil'…; Moshe called it 'uncircumcised (orel),' as it says, 'Circumcise the foreskin of your heart' (Devarim 10:16); David called it 'impure,' as it says, 'Create for me a pure heart, O God' (Tehillim 51:12) — which implies there is an impure one."

552.label: Zohar I 234b (Vayechi)
552.rest: — "'And I will tell you (ve'agidah)' (Bereishis 49:1): what is ve'agidah? It is the secret of wisdom… because it is a word that comes with gimel and dalet without separation; and this is the secret of wisdom, a word that comes in completeness in the secret of the letters." Earlier there: "'And you will say in your heart' (Yeshayahu 49:21) — a saying in silence."

553.label: Bava Metzia 33b
553.rest: — "'Declare to My people their transgression' (Yeshayahu 58:1) — these are Torah scholars, whose unintentional errors are counted as deliberate; 'and to the house of Yaakov their sins' — these are the amei ha'aretz, whose deliberate sins are counted as unintentional."

554.label: Yevamos 14b
554.rest: — "Beis Shammai did not refrain from marrying women of Beis Hillel, nor Beis Hillel from Beis Shammai, to teach you that they practiced affection and friendship toward one another, to fulfill what is said, 'Love truth and peace' (Zechariah 8:19)."

555.label: Rashi, Shemos 12:2
555.rest: — "'This month': He showed him the moon in its renewal and said to him: When it looks like this, see and sanctify."

556.label: Eruvin 41a
556.rest: — “After Rabban Gamliel died, Rabbi Yehoshua entered to overturn his ruling. Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri stood and said: I see that the body follows the head! Throughout Rabban Gamliel's life we established the law according to him; now you wish to overturn his words? Yehoshua, we do not heed you, for the law has already been established according to Rabban Gamliel, and no one disputed the matter.” The proverb occurs in a dispute about maintaining an established ruling after a leader's death. Rav Tzadok applies its image to Rosh Chodesh as the head that directs the month.

557.label: Bechoros 5b
557.rest: — "What is the meaning of Rephidim?… It is a dispute of Tannaim: Rabbi Eliezer says, Rephidim is its name; Rabbi Yehoshua says, that they slackened (rifu) themselves from words of Torah, and so it says, 'Fathers did not turn back to their children for slackness (rifyon) of hands' (Yirmeyahu 47:3)."

558.label: Mechilta, Yisro, Bachodesh 1
558.rest: — "'And they journeyed from Rephidim and came to the wilderness of Sinai' (Shemos 19:2). Was it not already said in Masei?… Why does it say it here? It compares their journeying from Rephidim to their coming to the wilderness of Sinai: just as their coming to Sinai was with teshuvah, so their journeying from Rephidim was with teshuvah."

559.label: Shabbos 86b
559.rest: — "On the sixth of the month the Ten Commandments were given to Israel; Rabbi Yosi says: on the seventh. Rava said: All agree that they came to the wilderness of Sinai on Rosh Chodesh, for it is written, 'on this day they came to the wilderness of Sinai' (Shemos 19:1), and there, 'This month (chodesh) shall be for you' (Shemos 12:2)… Rabbi Yosi holds the month was fixed on Sunday, and on Sunday he said nothing to them because of the weariness of the journey."

560.label: Mechilta, Yisro, Bachodesh 1
560.rest: — "'And Israel encamped there' (Shemos 19:2): wherever it says 'they journeyed… and they encamped,' they journeyed in dissension and encamped in dissension; but here it says 'And Israel encamped there' — they all became equal, of one heart."

561.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 3b
561.rest: — "He and His life are one in them; He and His self are one in them" — of the sefiros, with which Hashem is wholly one.

562.label: Magen Avraham, Orach Chaim 494 (introduction)
562.rest: — "The Zohar writes that the early pious ones would stay awake all night on Shavuos and occupy themselves with Torah; and the reason is, as is said in the Midrash, that Israel slept all that night and the Holy One had to wake them, as it says, 'Why did I come, and there was no man?' (Yeshayahu 50:2); therefore we must rectify this."

563.label: Zohar III 97b–98a (Emor)
563.rest: — "One must toil on this night in the Oral Torah, so that they be purified together from the spring of the deep stream; afterwards, on this day, the Written Torah comes and joins with them, and they are found together in one union above. Then they proclaim of him: 'And as for Me, this is My covenant with them… My words that I have put in your mouth' (Yeshayahu 59:21)."

564.label: Berachos 16a
564.rest: — "Tents are placed beside streams, as it is written, 'Like streams stretched out, like gardens by a river… like tents planted' (Bamidbar 24:6), to tell you: just as streams raise a person from impurity to purity, so tents [of Torah] raise a person from the scale of guilt to the scale of merit."

565.label: Berachos 63b
565.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: From where do we know that the words of Torah endure only in one who kills himself over it? For it says, 'This is the Torah: a man who dies in a tent' (Bamidbar 19:14)."

566.label: Tanchuma, Noach 3
566.rest: — "'Nor is it found in the land of the living' (Iyov 28:13) — the Oral Torah is not found with one who seeks the pleasure of the world, desire, honor and greatness in this world, but with one who kills himself over it, as it says, 'This is the Torah: a man who dies in a tent' (Bamidbar 19:14). And such is the way of Torah: bread with salt you shall eat, water in measure you shall drink, on the ground you shall sleep, a life of hardship you shall live, and in Torah you shall toil."

567.label: Rambam, Hilchos Mikvaos 11:12
567.rest: — There is an allusion in the matter: just as one who directs his heart to purify himself is pure once he immerses, though nothing new has happened in his body, so one who directs his heart to purify his soul from the impurities of the soul — wicked thoughts and bad traits — once he resolves to separate from those counsels and brings his soul into the waters of knowledge, he is pure.

568.label: Temurah 16a
568.rest: — "'If You will bless me' — with Torah; 'and enlarge my border' — with students; 'and Your hand be with me' — that my learning be not forgotten from my heart; 'and keep me from evil' — that I find companions like me; 'that it not grieve me (atzbi)' — that the evil inclination not overpower me from learning (I Divrei HaYamim 4:10)."

569.label: Zohar I 8a (Introduction)
569.rest: — "[On the night before] the next day, when she enters the chuppah with her husband… [her companions] stay with her all that night and rejoice with her in her adornments, engaging in Torah — from Torah to Prophets, from Prophets to Writings, in the expositions of the verses and the secrets of wisdom — for these are her adornments and jewels."

570.label: Berachos 11b
570.rest: — "Rav Yehudah said in the name of Shmuel: If one rose early to learn before reciting Shema, he must recite the blessing [over Torah]; after he has recited Shema, he need not bless, for he was already exempted with Ahavah Rabbah."

571.label: Avodah Zarah 9a
571.rest: — "It was taught in the school of Eliyahu: The world is to exist for six thousand years: two thousand years of tohu, two thousand years of Torah, two thousand years the days of Mashiach." The Gemara reckons the two thousand years of Torah from Avraham's time in Charan.

572.label: Sifrei, Devarim 24
572.rest: — "'Because Hashem hated us' (Devarim 1:27): is it possible that the Omnipresent hates Israel? Has it not already been said, 'I have loved you, says Hashem' (Malachi 1:2)? Rather, it is they who hated the Omnipresent. As the folk saying goes: what is in your heart about your friend is in his heart about you."

573.label: Berachos 5b
573.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

574.label: Magen Avraham, Orach Chaim 494 (introduction)
574.rest: — "The Zohar writes that the early pious ones would stay awake all night on Shavuos and occupy themselves with Torah; and the reason is, as is said in the Midrash, that Israel slept all that night and the Holy One had to wake them, as it says, 'Why did I come, and there was no man?' (Yeshayahu 50:2); therefore we must rectify this."

575.label: Chagigah 14a
575.rest: — "'The whole support of bread' (Yeshayahu 3:1) — these are the masters of Talmud, as it says, 'Come, eat of my bread and drink of the wine I have mixed' (Mishlei 9:5); 'and the whole support of water' — these are the masters of aggadah, who draw a person's heart like water."

576.label: Pesachim 119a
576.rest: — "What is 'and for covering the Ancient (mechaseh atik)' (Yeshayahu 23:18)? This is one who covers the things that the Ancient of Days covered — and what are they? The secrets of the Torah. And some say: this is one who reveals the things that the Ancient of Days covered — and what are they? The reasons of the Torah." Rashi: the secrets are Maaseh Merkavah and Maaseh Bereishis.

577.label: Tanchuma, Ki Sisa 36
577.rest: — "'And he was there with Hashem forty days and forty nights' (Shemos 34:28) — how did Moshe know when it was day? When the Holy One, blessed be He, taught him the Written Torah, he knew it was day; and when He taught him orally, Mishnah and Talmud, he knew it was night."

578.label: Zohar II 80b (Yisro)
578.rest: — "And Israel were crowned with seventy crowns on that night; and the supernal angels said, 'We have a little sister, and she has no breasts' (Shir HaShirim 8:8) — she has no merits and good deeds; 'What shall we do for our sister' — what honor and greatness shall we make for our sister on the day the Holy One is revealed on Mount Sinai to give them the Torah?"

579.label: Zohar III 97b–98a (Emor)
579.rest: — "One must toil on this night in the Oral Torah, so that they be purified together from the spring of the deep stream; afterwards, on this day, the Written Torah comes and joins with them, and they are found together in one union above. Then they proclaim of him: 'And as for Me, this is My covenant with them… My words that I have put in your mouth' (Yeshayahu 59:21)."

580.label: Zohar I 8a (Introduction)
580.rest: — "[On the night before] the next day, when she enters the chuppah with her husband… [her companions] stay with her all that night and rejoice with her in her adornments, engaging in Torah — from Torah to Prophets, from Prophets to Writings, in the expositions of the verses and the secrets of wisdom — for these are her adornments and jewels."

581.label: Raaya Mehemna, Zohar III 215b (Pinchas)
581.rest: — "'And wine that gladdens the heart of man' (Tehillim 104:15): this is the wine of Torah, for yayin (wine) has the numerical value of sod (secret)."

582.label: Zohar III 98a (Emor)
582.rest: — "[A parable of] a king who had an only son and came to marry him to a supernal Matronita. What did his mother do? All that night she went into the treasure house, brought out a supernal crown set round with seventy precious stones, and crowned him; she brought out garments of fine wool and clothed him, and arrayed him in royal adornments."

583.label: Zohar I 8a (Introduction)
583.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon said to them: My sons, fortunate is your portion, for tomorrow the bride will enter the chuppah only with you; for all who adorn her on this night and rejoice in her will be inscribed and written in the book of remembrance, and the Holy One blesses them with seventy blessings and crowns of the supernal world."

584.label: Tanchuma, Noach 3
584.rest: — "'A great light' (Yeshayahu 9:1) — the light that was created on the first day, which the Holy One, blessed be He, hid away for those who toil in the Oral Torah by day and by night, in whose merit the world stands, as it says, 'If not for My covenant day and night…' (Yirmeyahu 33:25). Which covenant is practiced by day and by night? This is Talmud."

585.label: Zohar III 98b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
585.rest: — "Afterwards she entered the bride's house and saw her maidens preparing her crowns, garments and ornaments. She said to them: I have prepared a place of immersion, a place of flowing waters, with all fragrances and spices around those waters, to purify my bride; let my bride, the Matronita of my son, and her maidens come and be purified there."

586.label: Bava Kamma 17a
586.rest: — “Rabbi Yochanan said in Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai’s name: What is meant by ‘Happy are you who sow beside all waters, sending forth the foot of the ox and the donkey’? Whoever engages in Torah and acts of kindness merits the inheritance of two tribes. ... ‘Sowing’ means charity, as it is written, ‘Sow for yourselves in righteousness and reap according to kindness’; ‘water’ means Torah, as it is written, ‘All who are thirsty, come to the water.’” The identification of water with Torah supplies the basis for Rav Tzadok’s further distinction between the visibly descending rain and the less apparent arrival of dew.

587.label: Zohar III 80b (Kedoshim)
587.rest: — "A person is never purified except through the words of Torah; therefore words of Torah do not receive impurity, for it stands to purify the impure… And purity is found in the Torah, as it is written, 'The fear of Hashem is pure, enduring forever' (Tehillim 19:10). What is 'enduring forever'? That it stands constantly in that purity and never departs from it."

588.label: Megillah 3a
588.rest: — "Rabbi Yirmeyah — some say Rabbi Chiya bar Abba — said: The translation of the Torah, Onkelos the convert said it from the mouths of Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua; the translation of the Prophets, Yonasan ben Uziel said it from the mouths of Chaggai, Zechariah and Malachi."

589.label: Midrash Tanchuma, Pinchas 15
589.rest: — “It would have been fitting for the assembly after Sukkos to be fifty days after the festival, just as the assembly after Pesach is fifty days later. But the Holy One, blessed be He, said: ‘It is winter, and they cannot leave their homes to come here. Instead, while they are with Me, let them hold the assembly.’” The Midrash explains Shemini Atzeres by the difficulty of returning in winter. Rav Tzadok invokes this as an example of the burden of travel in the present order of things.

590.label: Zohar II 170b (Terumah)
590.rest: — When Israel came to the sea, Rahav, the prince appointed over Egypt, came and sought judgment: "Master of the world, why do You judge Egypt and split the sea for Israel? All of them are guilty before You: these worship stars and constellations and those worship stars and constellations; these are immoral and those are immoral; these shed blood and those shed blood."

591.label: Zohar II 52b, Beshalach
591.rest: — “Then it is written: 'Hashem said to Moshe: Why do you cry to Me?' In the Book of Concealment it was taught: 'To Me' precisely—everything depends on Atika. At that moment the Holy Ancient One was revealed, favor was found in all the upper worlds, and the illumination of everything shone.” The source explicitly locates the sea's rescue in the revelation of Atika. Rav Tzadok takes remembrance of that disclosure into the joining of redemption with prayer.

592.label: Mechilta, Beshalach, Shirah 3
592.rest: — "'This is my God and I will glorify Him' (Shemos 15:2). Rabbi Eliezer says: From where do you say that a maidservant saw at the Sea what Yeshayahu and Yechezkel did not see? For it says, 'and through the prophets I was imaged' (Hoshea 12:11)… When the Holy One, blessed be He, was revealed at the Sea, no one needed to ask, 'Which is the King?'"

593.label: Mekhilta, Beshalach, Shirah 3; Zohar II, 64b
593.rest: — “Rabbi Eliezer says: From where do you say that a maidservant saw at the sea what Yeshayahu and Yechezkel did not see? It says: ‘Through the prophets I convey likenesses,’ and: ‘The heavens opened and I saw visions of God.’ A human king enters a city surrounded by guards, mighty men to his right and left and soldiers before and behind; people ask which one is the king. But when the Holy One, blessed be He, appeared at the sea, none needed to ask who He was. Once they saw Him, they recognized Him, and all opened their mouths and said: ‘This is my God, and I will glorify Him.’” Zohar II, 64b likewise invokes the maidservant’s vision when asking how Israel, after seeing the Divine Presence at the sea, could ask whether Hashem was in their midst. The Mekhilta’s point is immediate recognition, the aspect of zeh developed here.

594.label: Bava Kamma 82a
594.rest: — "'They went three days in the wilderness and found no water' (Shemos 15:22): the expounders of reshumos [Rashi: verses] said: Water means only Torah, as it says, 'Ho, all who thirst, go to the water.' Since they went three days without Torah they grew weary, so the prophets among them enacted that they read the Torah on Shabbos, Monday and Thursday."

595.label: Zohar II 60a (Beshalach)
595.rest: — "And we have learned that the Holy One, blessed is He, is called Torah; 'water' means only Torah, and Torah means only the Holy One, blessed is He."

596.label: Avos 6:2
596.rest: — "Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said: Every day a heavenly voice goes forth from Mount Chorev and proclaims: Woe to the creatures for the insult to the Torah… And it says, 'The writing was the writing of God, engraved (charus) on the tablets' (Shemos 32:16) — do not read charus but cheirus (freedom), for there is no free man except one who occupies himself with the study of Torah."

597.label: Pesachim 68b
597.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Both expounded one verse. One verse says, 'an assembly to Hashem your God' (Devarim 16:8), and one says, 'an assembly shall it be for you' (Bamidbar 29:35). Rabbi Eliezer holds: either all of it for Hashem or all of it for you; Rabbi Yehoshua holds: divide it — half for Hashem and half for you."

598.label: Zohar III 97b (Emor)
598.rest: — "When Israel were in Egypt they were in another domain, held in impurity like a woman sitting in her days of impurity. After they were circumcised they entered the holy portion called covenant, and impurity ceased from them. What is written? 'She shall count for herself seven days' (Vayikra 15:28); so too here… The Holy One said: From here on, the count is for purity."

599.label: Zohar I, Bereishis
599.rest: — "And so it would have been, had Israel not sinned, as it is written, 'engraved (charus) on the tablets' (Shemos 32:16) — free (cheirus) from the Angel of Death, for it was the Tree of Life."

600.label: Tanchuma, Ki Sisa 16
600.rest: — "'Engraved (charus)' (Shemos 32:16) — what is charus? Rabbi Yehudah says: free from the kingdoms; Rabbi Nechemiah says: free from the Angel of Death; and the Rabbis say: free from suffering… The Holy One says to the Angel of Death: I gave you dominion over all the nations except this nation, to whom I gave freedom on the tablets."

601.label: Zohar III 97b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
601.rest: — "Therefore it is called in this manner Atzeres, for in it is the nullification of the evil inclination; and therefore 'sin-offering' is not written of it as at the other times, where it is written 'a sin-offering to Hashem'; and then all the lights gathered to the Eishes Chayil — and therefore, Atzeres."

602.label: Zohar III, Pinchas
602.rest: — "When? 'On your Shavuos' (Bamidbar 28:26) — according to the count that you count; for whenever Israel make the reckonings of months and times, the Holy One prepares an ark in those firmaments and proclaims: My children below have sanctified the month… 'On your Shavuos' — according to the count you count, those seven Shabbasos."

603.label: Rosh Hashanah 11b
603.rest: — "Rabbi Yehoshua says: In Nissan they were redeemed, and in Nissan they are destined to be redeemed. From where? The verse says, 'It is a night of watching' (Shemos 12:42) — a night guarded and coming from the six days of Creation." Rashi: guarded for redemption.

604.label: Midrash Tanchuma, Pinchas 15
604.rest: — “It would have been fitting for the assembly after Sukkos to be fifty days after the festival, just as the assembly after Pesach is fifty days later. But the Holy One, blessed be He, said: ‘It is winter, and they cannot leave their homes to come here. Instead, while they are with Me, let them hold the assembly.’” The Midrash explains Shemini Atzeres by the difficulty of returning in winter. Rav Tzadok invokes this as an example of the burden of travel in the present order of things.

605.label: Tanchuma, Chukas 8
605.rest: — "Things that were not revealed to Moshe were revealed to Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues; 'and every precious thing his eye beheld' (Iyov 28:10) — this is Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues."

606.label: Pesachim 68b
606.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: All agree regarding Atzeres that we also require 'for you.' What is the reason? It is the day on which the Torah was given. Rabbah said: All agree regarding Shabbos… Rav Yosef said: All agree regarding Purim." Rashi: one should rejoice with food and drink, to show that this day on which the Torah was given is pleasing and welcome to Israel.

607.label: Levush, Orach Chaim 670 (quoted in Mishnah Berurah 670:6)
607.rest: — The reason Chanukah was not set for feasting and rejoicing as Purim was: on Purim the decree was to destroy and kill the bodies, not the souls (Haman would not have accepted them even had they converted), so when Hashem saved them they established praise through feasting and rejoicing. Antiochus decreed not killing but persecution to make them abandon their faith ("to make them forget Your Torah"); had Israel submitted to him he would have sought no more. Therefore Chanukah was set only for praise and thanksgiving — thanking Him for having remained our God and not abandoning us from His service.

608.label: Zohar II 88b, Yisro
608.rest: — “Because all faith is found in Shabbos, a person is given another soul, a higher soul, a soul in which all completeness is found, in the likeness of the World to Come. For this reason it is called Shabbos. What is Shabbos? The Name of the Holy One, blessed be He—a Name complete on every side.” The context discusses the spiritual completeness of Shabbos and its meals. The source directly connects the additional higher soul with the World to Come; Rav Tzadok then relates it to the restored crowns.

609.label: Zohar II 204b (Vayakhel)
609.rest: — If he cancels the delight of Shabbos and takes delight on a weekday, it is as though he esteemed something else more than the Holy One; the supernal holy spirit that rests upon him [on Shabbos] he did not delight, and he cancelled it from himself.

610.label: Zohar III 97b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
610.rest: — "Therefore it is called in this manner Atzeres, for in it is the nullification of the evil inclination; and therefore 'sin-offering' is not written of it as at the other times, where it is written 'a sin-offering to Hashem'; and then all the lights gathered to the Eishes Chayil — and therefore, Atzeres."

611.label: Avodah Zarah 5a
611.rest: — "As this Tanna taught: Rabbi Yosi says: Israel accepted the Torah only so that the Angel of Death would not rule over them, as it says, 'I said: you are angels, all of you children of the Most High' — you corrupted your deeds — 'therefore like men you shall die' (Tehillim 82:6–7)."

612.label: Bava Basra 16a
612.rest: — “Reish Lakish said: He is Satan, he is the evil inclination, and he is the Angel of Death. He is Satan, as it is written, ‘Satan went out from before Hashem.’ He is the evil inclination: there it is written, ‘Only evil all day,’ and here it is written, ‘Only do not stretch out your hand against him.’ He is the Angel of Death, as it is written, ‘Only preserve his life’—showing that it is in his power.”

613.label: Berachos 34a
613.rest: — "The Rabbis taught: Three things are harmful in large amounts and good in small amounts: leaven, salt, and refusal." [Rashi does not comment on this line.] Rav Tzadok: on Shavuos, once leaven has been refined, it is offered.

614.label: Shabbos 88a
614.rest: — "A certain Galilean expounded before Rav Chisda: Blessed is the Merciful One who gave a threefold Torah to a threefold people through a third-born, on the third day, in the third month." Rashi: Torah, Nevi'im and Kesuvim; Kohanim, Levi'im and Yisraelim; Moshe, who was third-born.

615.label: Pesikta D'Rav Kahana 12:13
615.rest: — "'In the third month' (Shemos 19:1): the Torah is threefold, the Avos are threefold, the tribe through which it was given is third, and the month is third… the Torah is threefold — Torah, Nevi'im and Kesuvim; its letters threefold — alef, beis, gimel; Israel threefold — Kohanim, Levi'im and Yisraelim."

616.label: Zohar II 78b (Yisro)
616.rest: — "Because Yaakov is Twins (te'omim), the Torah was given to his children in the month of Twins — the Torah in the secret of Twins: the Written Torah and the Oral Torah; in the third month, to a threefold people, in threefold levels; a threefold Torah — Torah, Prophets and Writings — and all is one."

617.label: Kiddushin 30a
617.rest: — "A person should always divide his years into three: a third in Mikra, a third in Mishnah, a third in Talmud. — Does he know how long he will live? — It is needed only for days."

618.label: Rashi, Shemos 24:12
618.rest: — "'The Torah and the commandment' — all 613 mitzvos are included in the Ten Commandments; and Rabbeinu Saadyah explained, in the Azharos he composed, each commandment and the mitzvos that depend on it."

619.label: Zohar III 273a (Ra'aya Meheimna, Eikev)
619.rest: — "The second: to break bread over two loaves on Shabbos, which allude to the two Tablets of the Torah that were given on Shabbos."

620.label: Berachos 61a
620.rest: — "Rav said: The evil inclination resembles a fly and sits between the two openings of the heart, as it says, 'Dead flies make the perfumer's oil putrid' (Koheles 10:1). Shmuel said: It resembles a kind of wheat (chitah), as it says, 'Sin (chatas) crouches at the door' (Bereishis 4:7)."

621.label: Bava Basra 12a
621.rest: — "Amemar said: And a sage is greater than a prophet, as it says, 'And a prophet (nevi) has a heart of wisdom' (Tehillim 90:12) — who depends on whom? The lesser on the greater." The Ramban there explains that the Sages' wisdom is a form of ruach hakodesh.

622.label: Zohar II 175b (Terumah)
622.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon said: I have seen that Chochmah includes everything: supernal Chesed issues from Chochmah, and Gevurah, which is severe judgment, issues from Binah; Yaakov completes the two sides, and the Avos include everything."

623.label: Taanis 9a
623.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi bar Yehudah says: Three good providers arose for Israel: Moshe, Aharon and Miriam; and three good gifts were given through them: the well, the cloud and the manna. The well in the merit of Miriam, the pillar of cloud in the merit of Aharon, the manna in the merit of Moshe. When Miriam died the well departed… and it returned in the merit of both."

624.label: Zohar III 271b (Ra'aya Meheimna, Eikev)
624.rest: — "Meanwhile an elder came to him and said: Faithful Shepherd, prepare a table for your Master and the Matronita with all kinds of delicacies… 'Come, eat of my bread' (Mishlei 9:5) — this is the bread of the Written Torah, and the wine of the Oral Torah; and there are many dishes, the reasons of the Torah, sweeter than all the foods and delicacies of the world."

625.label: Mechilta, Yisro (Amalek 3), on "And Yisro rejoiced" (Shemos 18:9)
625.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar HaModai says: Scripture speaks of the goodness of the well. They said to him: This well that the Omnipresent gave us — we taste in it the taste of old wine, new wine, milk, honey, the taste of every sweet thing in the world." (Rabbi Yehoshua there says the same of the manna, which tasted of every food.)

626.label: Sotah 11b
626.rest: — "'And because the midwives feared God, He made them houses' (Shemos 1:21): one says, houses of priesthood and Levites; the other says, houses of kingship. Houses of kingship — David too came from Miriam, as it is written, 'And Azuvah died, and Kalev took Efras' (I Divrei HaYamim 2:19), and it is written, 'And David was the son of an Efrasi man' (I Shmuel 17:12)." Rashi: Azuvah is Miriam.

627.label: Zohar II 81a (Yisro)
627.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon said: When the Holy One wished to reveal Himself on Mount Sinai, He called His whole household and said: Now Israel are children who do not know laws; if I reveal Myself to them with the power of Gevurah they cannot bear it, but I will reveal Myself with mercy and they will accept laws. That is, 'on the third day' — certainly, for it is mercy."

628.label: Zohar II 78b (Yisro)
628.rest: — "Yaakov takes in his secret two months, Nissan and Iyar, and he is included in the secret of Sivan, which is Twins. Esav takes in his secret two months, Tammuz and Av, and he is not found and is lost — for Elul is not his, and even of Av only nine days are his and no more."

629.label: Bava Kamma 17a
629.rest: — "He merits a canopy like Yosef, as it is written, 'Yosef is a fruitful vine… daughters walked upon the wall (shur)' (Bereishis 49:22)." Rashi: Yosef is called "ox" (shor), as it says, "His firstborn ox, majesty is his" (Devarim 33:17).

630.label: Zohar II 64b (Beshalach)
630.rest: — "'Who send forth the feet of the ox and the donkey' (Yeshayahu 32:20) — these are two crowns of the left to which the idolatrous nations hold, called ox and donkey, as it is written, 'And I have an ox and a donkey' (Bereishis 32:6)… When Israel are meritorious they send them away, and they cannot rule over them."

631.label: Berachos 61a
631.rest: — "Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak objected: If so, an animal, of which 'and He formed' is not written, has no inclination? But we see that it damages, bites and kicks!"

632.label: Magen Avraham, Orach Chaim 494 (opening)
632.rest: — "It is difficult for me: how do we say on Shavuos 'the day of the giving of our Torah,' when we rule like Rabbi Yosi that the Torah was given on the seventh of Sivan… and for us Shavuos is always on the sixth of Sivan?" He answers that our custom follows the Rambam, who rules like the Sages.

633.label: Avodah Zarah 3a
633.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: What is meant by 'And it was evening and it was morning, the sixth day' (Bereishis 1:31)? This teaches that the Holy One, blessed be He, made a condition with the work of Creation and said: If Israel accept My Torah, good; and if not, I will return you to tohu va'vohu." Rashi: the extra hei of "the sixth" alludes to the sixth of Sivan.

634.label: Zohar II 81a (Yisro)
634.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon said: When the Holy One wished to reveal Himself on Mount Sinai, He called His whole household and said: Now Israel are children who do not know laws; if I reveal Myself to them with the power of Gevurah they cannot bear it, but I will reveal Myself with mercy and they will accept laws. That is, 'on the third day' — certainly, for it is mercy."

635.label: Rosh Hashanah 32a
635.rest: — The ten verses of Malchuyos correspond to the ten utterances with which the world was created. "Those ten utterances — they are nine 'And He said' [in Bereishis]! 'In the beginning' is also an utterance, as it is written, 'By the word of Hashem the heavens were made' (Tehillim 33:6)."

636.label: Zohar III 11b (Vayikra)
636.rest: — "It is written, 'You shall not covet your fellow's wife' (Shemos 20:14), and in the work of Creation it is written, 'It is not good for man to be alone' (Bereishis 2:18): here is your mate opposite you — therefore, 'You shall not covet your fellow's wife.'"

637.label: Rosh Hashanah 27a
637.rest: — "Like whom do we pray today, 'This day is the beginning of Your works, a remembrance of the first day'? Like Rabbi Eliezer, who said the world was created in Tishrei." Tosafos there (s.v. kemaan) explain that both views are the words of the living God: in Tishrei it arose in thought to create, and it was not created until Nissan.

638.label: Zohar II 186a (Tetzaveh)
638.rest: — "Your month is ordered by the sequence of the letters: Aviv — alef, beis, gimel… but the seventh month, Mine, is from the end of the letters (tav, shin, reish). Why? You are from below upward, and I from above downward."

639.label: Chagigah 12a
639.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: The light the Holy One, blessed be He, created on the first day — Adam could gaze by it from one end of the world to the other. When the Holy One looked at the generation of the Flood and the generation of the Dispersion and saw that their deeds were corrupt, He arose and hid it from them, as it says, 'And from the wicked their light is withheld' (Iyov 38:15)."

640.label: Eruvin 18a
640.rest: — "As Rabbi Abahu contrasted: It is written, 'Male and female He created them' (Bereishis 5:2), and it is written, 'For in the image of God He made him' (Bereishis 9:6) — at first it arose in thought to create two, and in the end only one was created."

641.label: Rosh Hashanah 8a
641.rest: — "Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: [Tishrei is the new year] for judgment, as it is written, 'from the beginning of the year to the end of the year' (Devarim 11:12) — from the beginning of the year it is judged what will be at its end." Rashi: in Tishrei the Holy One judges all who enter the world.

642.label: Pesachim 118a
642.rest: — "Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said: These twenty-six 'Hodu's [of Tehillim 136] — corresponding to what? Corresponding to the twenty-six generations that the Holy One created in His world and to whom He did not give Torah, and He sustained them with His kindness."

643.label: Zohar I 142b (Toldos)
643.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi said: The beauty of Yaakov was the beauty of Adam. How is that possible? Did we not learn that the heel of Adam HaRishon dimmed the orb of the sun? Rabbi Elazar said: Certainly so it was at first: before Adam sinned, no creature could gaze upon his beauty; once he sinned, his beauty changed."

644.label: Avodah Zarah 4a
644.rest: — The heretics asked Rav Safra about "Only you have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore I will visit upon you all your iniquities" (Amos 3:2). Rabbi Abahu explained with a parable: one who lends to two people, a friend and an enemy — from his friend he collects little by little, and from his enemy all at once.

645.label: Tanchuma, Noach 3
645.rest: — "'A great light' (Yeshayahu 9:1) — the light that was created on the first day, which the Holy One, blessed be He, hid away for those who toil in the Oral Torah by day and by night, in whose merit the world stands, as it says, 'If not for My covenant day and night…' (Yirmeyahu 33:25). Which covenant is practiced by day and by night? This is Talmud."

646.label: Zohar III 117b–118a (Bamidbar)
646.rest: — "No counting of Israel blessed them like this counting… They were counted in the place from which blessings issue, as it is written, 'on the first of the second month' — which is the radiance (ziva) of the blessings of the world, from which radiance goes out to the world; therefore it is called the month of Ziv, for the radiance of all goes out from it."

647.label: Sanhedrin 24a
647.rest: — "Rabbi Oshaya said: What is meant by 'And I took for myself two staffs: one I called Noam and one I called Chovlim' (Zechariah 11:7)? Noam — these are the Torah scholars of Eretz Yisrael, who are pleasant to one another in halachah; Chovlim — the Torah scholars of Bavel, who wound one another in halachah."

648.label: Sanhedrin 88b
648.rest: — "When there multiplied the students of Shammai and Hillel who had not served [their teachers] sufficiently, disputes multiplied in Israel, and the Torah became like two Torahs."

649.label: Zohar III 80b–81a (Kedoshim)
649.rest: — "He said to him: 'The fear of Hashem' is written, not Torah! He answered: So it is indeed, for the Torah comes from the side of Gevurah… as it is written, 'The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem' (Tehillim 111:10)." Yitzchak, the "Fear of Yitzchak," is the chariot of Gevurah.

650.label: Zohar I 219a (Vayechi)
650.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon said: We have learned that the Holy One has two children, one male and one female. The male He gave to Yaakov, as it is written, 'My son, My firstborn, Israel'… The daughter He gave to Avraham, as it is written, 'And Hashem blessed Avraham with everything (bakol)' — Avraham had a daughter, and Bakol was her name."

651.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 11b
651.rest: — "When it was taken from Chesed it was called the Written Torah, given from the right, as it is written, 'From His right hand, a fiery law for them' (Devarim 33:2); and when it was taken from Gevurah it was called the Oral Torah… From there 'the mighty stand in the breach,' and none can stand in it but one mighty in the battle of Torah, mighty over his inclination."

652.label: Kiddushin 30b
652.rest: — "Rabbi Chiya bar Abba said: Even a father and his son, a teacher and his student, who engage in Torah in one gate become enemies of each other; and they do not move from there until they become beloved to each other."

653.label: Tanchuma, Noach 3
653.rest: — "The Holy One, blessed be He, brought them out twelve years before the destruction of Yerushalayim with their Torah and Talmud, as it is written, 'And he exiled all Yerushalayim… and all the mighty men of valor' (II Melachim 24:14). What might is there in people who go into exile? Rather, these are the mighty ones of Torah, as it is said of it, 'Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of Hashem' (Bamidbar 21:14)."

654.label: Berachos 30b
654.rest: — "Abaye was sitting before Rabbah, who saw that he was very merry. He said: It is written, 'and rejoice with trembling' (Tehillim 2:11)!"

655.label: Chagigah 26a
655.rest: — "Until now, the impurity of an am ha'aretz on the festival — the Torah declared it pure; but now it is impure!" — on the festival, everyone is trusted regarding purity.

656.label: Rosh Hashanah 18a
656.rest: — "Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: We too learned it: 'He Who fashions their hearts together, Who understands all their deeds' (Tehillim 33:15). What does it mean? If you say He creates everyone and unites their hearts together — but we see that it is not so! Rather, it means: the Creator sees their hearts together and understands all their deeds."

657.label: Rashi, Shemos 19:2
657.rest: — "'And Israel encamped there' — as one man with one heart; but all the other encampments were with complaints and with dissension."

658.label: Pesachim 117b
658.rest: — "Shabbos is fixed and established [and so we say] 'Who sanctifies the Shabbos'; a Yom Tov — it is Israel who fix it, for they intercalate the months and fix the years — [so we say] 'Who sanctifies Israel and the festivals.'"

659.label: Bamidbar Rabbah 2:3 (on "He brought me to the house of wine," Shir HaShirim 2:4)
659.rest: — A parable of a rich man who had a storehouse full of wine; he went in to check it and found it all vinegar. On his way out he found one good barrel of wine and said: This barrel is worth the whole storehouse to me. So the Holy One created seventy nations, and from all of them He found satisfaction only in Israel.

660.label: Avos 1:1
660.rest: — "Moshe received the Torah from Sinai and transmitted it to Yehoshua, Yehoshua to the elders, the elders to the prophets, and the prophets transmitted it to the Men of the Great Assembly. They said three things: Be deliberate in judgment, raise up many students, and make a fence for the Torah."

661.label: Sukkah 20a
661.rest: — "In the beginning, when the Torah was forgotten from Israel, Ezra came up from Bavel and established it; it was again forgotten, and Hillel the Babylonian came up and established it; again forgotten, and R. Chiya and his sons came up and established it."

662.label: Yerushalmi, Berachos 1:2
662.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai said: Had I been standing on Mount Sinai when the Torah was given to Israel, I would have asked the Merciful One to create two mouths for a person: one to toil in Torah, and one to provide all his needs."

663.label: Zohar I 27a
663.rest: — "As the masters of the Mishnah said: 'And they embittered their lives with hard labor' — with kushya [difficult questions]; 'with mortar' [chomer] — with kal vachomer; 'and with bricks' [leveinim] — with clarifying [libun] the halachah; 'and with all labor in the field' — this is Baraisa; 'all their labor' — this is Mishnah."

664.label: Zohar III 193a (Balak)
664.rest: — "Come and see: the ornaments of the Children of Israel are the gifts and presents they received, and therefore neither death nor the Other Side ruled over them. Not only did they take the Torah without any challenge — they received presents and gifts from all of them. Once they sinned, what is written? 'And the Children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments' (Shemos 33:6)."

665.label: Pesachim 87b
665.rest: — "The Holy One exiled Israel to Bavel only … Rabbi Yochanan said: because He sent them to their mother's house — a parable of a man who was angry with his wife: where does he send her? To her mother's house."

666.label: Yalkut Shimoni, Shmuel II, remez 141
666.rest: — It was said to Moshe: if one of any of the nations comes to convert, accept him; but from the seed of Amalek do not accept him. Therefore David said to the Amalekite convert, "Your blood is upon your head, for your own mouth testified against you" (Shmuel II 1:16).

667.label: Gittin 57b
667.rest: — "Some of the descendants of Haman learned Torah in Bnei Brak; some of the descendants of Sisera taught children in Yerushalayim; some of the descendants of Sancheriv taught Torah in public. Who were they? Shemayah and Avtalyon."

668.label: Pesachim 87a
668.rest: — "'Then I was in His eyes as one who finds peace (shalom)' (Shir HaShirim 8:10) — Rabbi Yochanan said: like a bride who is found perfect (sheleimah) in her father-in-law's house and is eager to go and tell her praise in her father's house." The Gemara goes on to expound this of Israel's exile to Bavel, sent like a wife to her mother's house.

669.label: Zohar III 98a (Ra'aya Meheimna)
669.rest: — "On Shavuos, the giving of the Torah, when the two Tablets were given from the side of the Tree of Life, one must offer alongside them the Two Loaves, which are the two hei's: the two days of Shavuos are Yud and Vav, and alongside them the Two Loaves of the hei's, for it is the bread of Torah, of which it is said, 'Come, eat of my bread' (Mishlei 9:5)."

670.label: Berachos 5b
670.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

671.label: Zohar III 122b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
671.rest: — "Two letters awaken a person to Torah and mitzvah. Yud is fear: it rests upon a person's head, and from it fear enters his heart to fear the Holy One, blessed be He… Hei is love… And Vav rests upon a person's head, and from it there enter into his mouth words with which to study Torah."

672.label: Zohar II 80b (Yisro)
672.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi said: At the hour that Israel approached Mount Sinai, on that night, at the dawn of the three days in which they had kept apart from their wives, the supernal angels came and received Israel in brotherhood: they are angels above and Israel are angels below; they sanctify the supernal Name above, and Israel sanctify the supernal Name below."

673.label: Bava Basra 12a
673.rest: — "Amemar said: And a sage is greater than a prophet, as it says, 'And a prophet (nevi) has a heart of wisdom' (Tehillim 90:12) — who depends on whom? The lesser on the greater." The Ramban there explains that the Sages' wisdom is a form of ruach hakodesh.

674.label: Zohar III 61a (Acharei Mos)
674.rest: — "What is Kodesh? The completeness of all, called supernal Chochmah; from this place the holy anointing oil flows along known paths to the place called supernal Binah, and from there springs and streams go forth on every side… And when this Zos is blessed from that supernal place called Kodesh… they call her Ruach HaKodesh — a spirit from that Kodesh." A parallel appears in Haazinu (Zohar III 297a).

675.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 11b
675.rest: — "When it was taken from Chesed it was called the Written Torah, given from the right, as it is written, 'From His right hand, a fiery law for them' (Devarim 33:2); and when it was taken from Gevurah it was called the Oral Torah… From there 'the mighty stand in the breach,' and none can stand in it but one mighty in the battle of Torah, mighty over his inclination."

676.label: Taanis 4a
676.rest: — “Rava said: A young Torah scholar who becomes heated—it is the Torah that makes him heated, as it is said, ‘Is not My word like fire, says Hashem?’ Rav Ashi said: Any Torah scholar who is not hard as iron is not a Torah scholar, as it is said, ‘Like a hammer that shatters rock.’ ... Ravina said: Even so, a person must train himself in gentleness, as it is said, ‘Remove anger from your heart.’” The fire describes Torah’s force. The Gemara’s concluding qualification requires gentleness; its teaching does not make ordinary anger a virtue.

677.label: Tanchuma, Noach 3
677.rest: — "The Holy One, blessed be He, brought them out twelve years before the destruction of Yerushalayim with their Torah and Talmud, as it is written, 'And he exiled all Yerushalayim… and all the mighty men of valor' (II Melachim 24:14). What might is there in people who go into exile? Rather, these are the mighty ones of Torah, as it is said of it, 'Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of Hashem' (Bamidbar 21:14)."

678.label: Zohar III 98a (Ra'aya Meheimna)
678.rest: — "And this is the food of man, which is Yud-Hei-Vav-Hei ('This is the Torah: a man' — Bamidbar 19:14); the Omer of barley is animal food, corresponding to the holy Chayos… and of them it is said, 'And you, My flock, the flock of My pasture, you are man' (Yechezkel 34:31)."

679.label: Bava Metzia 114b
679.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai says: The graves of idolaters do not defile, as it says, 'And you, My flock, the flock of My pasture, you are man (adam)' (Yechezkel 34:31) — you are called 'adam,' and idolaters are not called 'adam.'"

680.label: Zohar I 142b (Toldos)
680.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi said: The beauty of Yaakov was the beauty of Adam. How is that possible? Did we not learn that the heel of Adam HaRishon dimmed the orb of the sun? Rabbi Elazar said: Certainly so it was at first: before Adam sinned, no creature could gaze upon his beauty; once he sinned, his beauty changed."

681.label: Midrash Tehillim 23:2
681.rest: — "'Hashem is my shepherd, I shall not lack.' Rabbi Yosi bar Chanina said: You find no occupation more despised than the shepherd, who goes about all day with his staff and his pouch, yet David called the Holy One a shepherd! But David said, 'I gain understanding from the elders' (Tehillim 119:100): Yaakov called Him shepherd — 'the God who shepherded me' (Bereishis 48:15) — so I too call Him shepherd."

682.label: Shabbos 88a
682.rest: — "A certain Galilean expounded before Rav Chisda: Blessed is the Merciful One who gave a threefold Torah to a threefold people through a third-born, on the third day, in the third month." Rashi: Torah, Nevi'im and Kesuvim; Kohanim, Levi'im and Yisraelim; Moshe, who was third-born.

683.label: Pirkei Avot 4:21
683.rest: — “Rabbi Elazar HaKappar says: Jealousy, desire, and honor remove a person from the world.” Rav Tzadok maps these three root traits onto the three forms of impurity and the purifying work of the readings.

684.label: Berachos 64a
684.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said in the name of Rabbi Chanina: Torah scholars increase peace in the world, as it says, 'And all your children shall be taught of Hashem, and great shall be the peace of your children' (Yeshayahu 54:13) — do not read banayich (your children) but bonayich (your builders)."

685.label: Kiddushin 30b
685.rest: — "I created the evil inclination; I created Torah as its antidote… The school of Rabbi Yishmael taught: My son, if this repulsive one accosts you, drag him to the beis midrash: if he is stone, he will melt; if he is iron, he will shatter, as it says, 'Is not My word like fire, says Hashem, and like a hammer that shatters rock?' (Yirmeyahu 23:29)." Rashi: "this repulsive one" is the evil inclination provoking you.

686.label: Sotah 21b (cited as 21a)
686.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Words of Torah endure only in one who makes himself as one who is not, as it is said, 'And wisdom — from nothing (me-ayin) shall it be found.'" Rashi: me-ayin — from one who makes himself as nothing.

687.label: Yevamos 79a
687.rest: — “Three signs distinguish this nation: they are merciful, bashful, and doers of kindness. Merciful, as it is written, 'He will give you mercy, and have mercy upon you and multiply you'; bashful, as it is written, 'So that His fear may be upon your faces'; doers of kindness, as it is written, 'For I have known him, that he may command his children and his household after him.' Whoever has these three signs is fit to join this nation.” The Gemara lists the three traits and their scriptural supports. The assignment of kindness to Avraham, bashfulness and fear to Yitzchak, and mercy to Yaakov is Rav Tzadok's patriarchal interpretation.

688.label: Taanis 9a
688.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi bar Yehudah says: Three good providers arose for Israel: Moshe, Aharon and Miriam; and three good gifts were given through them: the well, the cloud and the manna. The well in the merit of Miriam, the pillar of cloud in the merit of Aharon, the manna in the merit of Moshe. When Miriam died the well departed… and it returned in the merit of both."

689.label: Taanis 7a
689.rest: — "Rabbi Chanina bar Idi said: Why are the words of Torah likened to water, as it is written, 'Ho, all who are thirsty, go to the water' (Yeshayahu 55:1)? To tell you: just as water leaves a high place and goes to a low place, so the words of Torah endure only in one whose mind is humble."

690.label: Sotah 3a
690.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: A person does not commit a transgression unless a spirit of folly has entered him."

691.label: Shabbos 89b
