691.rest: — "They opened and said, 'For You are our Father' (Yeshayahu 63:16). Yitzchak said to them: Rather than praising me, praise the Holy One, blessed be He — and Yitzchak shows them the Holy One with their own eyes. Immediately they lifted their eyes on high."

692.label: Shabbos 87a
692.rest: — "Come and hear: 'And be ready for the third day' (Shemos 19:11) — this is difficult for Rabbi Yosi! — We have said: Moshe added one day on his own."

693.label: Magen Avraham, Orach Chaim 494 (opening)
693.rest: — "It is difficult for me: how do we say on Shavuos 'the day of the giving of our Torah,' when we rule like Rabbi Yosi that the Torah was given on the seventh of Sivan… and for us Shavuos is always on the sixth of Sivan?" He answers that our custom follows the Rambam, who rules like the Sages.

694.label: Shabbos 88a
694.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: What is meant by 'And it was evening and it was morning, the sixth day' (Bereishis 1:31)? Why the extra hei? This teaches that the Holy One made a condition with the works of Creation: If Israel accept the Torah, you will endure; and if not, I will return you to tohu va'vohu."

695.label: Rosh Hashanah 6b
695.rest: — "As Rav Shmaya taught: Atzeres is sometimes on the fifth [of Sivan], sometimes on the sixth, sometimes on the seventh. How so? If both [Nissan and Iyar] are full — the fifth; if both are deficient — the seventh; if one is full and one deficient — the sixth."

696.label: Sanhedrin 56b
696.rest: — "Ten mitzvos Israel were commanded at Marah: seven that the sons of Noach accepted, and added to them laws (dinim), Shabbos and honoring father and mother."

697.label: Rosh Hashanah 25a
697.rest: — "'Which you shall proclaim, osam' (Vayikra 23:2) — read it atem, 'you': you, even if you erred unwittingly; you, even if deliberately; you, even if misled." Rashi: unwittingly — they themselves thought the month should be extended, and erred; misled — through false witnesses.

698.label: Shabbos 86b
698.rest: — “All agree that the Torah was given to Israel on Shabbos.”

699.label: Zohar III 98a (Ra'aya Meheimna)
699.rest: — "On Shavuos, the giving of the Torah, when the two Tablets were given from the side of the Tree of Life, one must offer alongside them the Two Loaves, which are the two hei's: the two days of Shavuos are Yud and Vav, and alongside them the Two Loaves of the hei's, for it is the bread of Torah, of which it is said, 'Come, eat of my bread' (Mishlei 9:5)."

700.label: Zohar III 123b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
700.rest: — "'The hidden things' (Devarim 29:28) — fear and love, which are in the brain and the heart, within the body and the head; 'and the revealed things' — Torah and mitzvah, which are in the body and the head outwardly. For whether a person fears the Holy One or loves Him, no one else knows; it is revealed only between him and his Maker."

701.label: Pesachim 68b
701.rest: — "One verse says, 'an assembly to Hashem your God,' and one verse says, 'an assembly shall it be to you.' Rabbi Eliezer holds: either all of it for Hashem or all of it for you; Rabbi Yehoshua holds: divide it — half for Hashem and half for you." The Gemara continues: all agree that on Atzeres (Shavuos) "for you" is also needed. Rashi: that one rejoices on it with food and drink.

702.label: Chullin 7a
702.rest: — "He said to the river Ginai: Ginai, divide your waters for me and I will pass through you. It said: You go to do the will of your Maker, and I go to do the will of my Maker; you may or may not accomplish it, while I certainly accomplish it. He said: If you do not divide, I decree that water never pass through you again. It divided for him."

703.label: Pesachim 68b
703.rest: — "Mar the son of Ravina would sit in fasting the whole year except on Atzeres, Purim and Erev Yom Kippur: Atzeres — the day the Torah was given; Purim — 'days of feasting and joy' is written; Erev Yom Kippur — as Chiya bar Rav of Difti taught: whoever eats and drinks on the ninth is regarded as though he fasted on the ninth and the tenth."

704.label: Tosafos, Berachos 49b (s.v. i ba'i achil)
704.rest: — As for what is said (Pesachim 68b), that Mar the son of Ravina would sit in fast all year, implying that he fasted even on Yom Tov: the Ri explains that this refers to a fast over a dream, but other fasts are forbidden [on Yom Tov].

705.label: Yoma 81b
705.rest: — "Chiya bar Rav of Difti taught: 'And you shall afflict your souls on the ninth' (Vayikra 23:32) — do they fast on the ninth? Do they not fast on the tenth? Rather, to tell you: whoever eats and drinks on the ninth, Scripture regards him as though he fasted on the ninth and the tenth." Rashi: prepare yourself on the ninth so that you will be able to fast on the tenth.

706.label: Berachos 17a
706.rest: — "When Rav Sheshes sat in a fast, after praying he would say: Master of the worlds, it is revealed before You that when the Beis HaMikdash stood, a person who sinned brought an offering, and only its fat and blood were offered, and he was atoned. Now I have sat in a fast and my fat and blood have diminished; may it be Your will that my diminished fat and blood be as though I had offered them before You on the altar."

707.label: Kesubos 105b
707.rest: — "'And a man came from Baal Shalishah and brought the man of God bread of the first fruits' (II Melachim 4:42) — did Elisha eat first fruits? Rather, to tell you: whoever brings a gift to a Torah scholar is as though he offered first fruits."

708.label: Yoma 71a
708.rest: — "'To you, O men (ishim), I call' (Mishlei 8:4). Rabbi Berechyah said: These are Torah scholars, who are like women yet do mighty deeds like men. And Rabbi Berechyah said: One who wishes to pour a libation of wine upon the altar should fill the throats of Torah scholars with wine." Rashi: ishim recalls the fire-offerings (ishim).

709.label: Berachos 10b
709.rest: — "'[A holy man of God] passes by us continually' (II Melachim 4:9): Rabbi Yosi bar Chanina said in the name of Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov: Whoever hosts a Torah scholar in his home and lets him benefit from his possessions, Scripture regards him as though he offered the daily offerings."

710.label: Pesachim 68b
710.rest: — "Rav Yosef, on the day of Atzeres, would say: Prepare for me a choice third-grown calf. He said: Were it not for this day that brought it about, how many Yosefs are there in the marketplace!"

711.label: Sotah 49b
711.rest: — "When Rebbi died, humility and fear of sin ceased. Rav Yosef said to the reciter: Do not teach 'humility,' for there is I. Rav Nachman said to the reciter: Do not teach 'fear of sin,' for there is I." Rashi: for I am humble.

712.label: Avodah Zarah 5a
712.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi said: Ben David will not come until all the souls in the Guf are used up, as it says, 'For the spirit before Me wraps itself, and the souls I have made' (Yeshayahu 57:16)."

713.label: Shabbos 88b
713.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Each and every utterance that went forth from the mouth of the Almighty divided into seventy languages. The school of Rabbi Yishmael taught: 'And like a hammer that shatters rock' (Yirmeyahu 23:29) — just as a hammer splits [the rock] into many sparks… Rav Chananel bar Pappa said: What is meant by 'Hear, for I will speak noble things (negidim)' (Mishlei 8:6)? Why are words of Torah likened to a prince (nagid)?"

714.label: Rashi, Shabbos 88b (s.v. korin lo shnei kesarim)
714.rest: — "To the utterance, which had substance and was visible, as it is written, 'And all the people saw the sounds' (Shemos 20:15)."

715.label: Zohar Chadash, Yisro
715.rest: — "Because they all were in a whisper and were not heard, it is written, 'And all the people saw' (Shemos 20:15), and not 'all the people heard'; for they were not heard at all — rather each one came, and each one kissed this utterance in a whisper, as one kisses with the affection of love; and afterward that utterance went forth and proclaimed its word."

716.label: Zohar II 83b (Yisro)
716.rest: — "When that word went forth it appeared as one; and when it was engraved in its place there appeared in that word seventy branches rising within it, and fifty crowns less one on this side and fifty less one on the other side — like a hammer striking the rock, as you say, 'and like a hammer that shatters rock' (Yirmeyahu 23:29); and all Israel saw eye to eye and rejoiced."

717.label: Zohar III 98a (Ra'aya Meheimna)
717.rest: — "The masters of Kabbalah and the masters of measures are from the side of the Tree of Life; the rest of the people from the side of the Tree of Good and Evil, prohibited and permitted… Their food is the Omer, barley bread — the Oral Torah of the six orders of Mishnah; but those of the Tree of Life, who are 'adam,' their Torah is the bread of the Holy One: 'Come, eat of my bread' (Mishlei 9:5) — the Two Loaves."

718.label: Taanis 5b
718.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Yaakov Avinu did not die. He was asked: Was it for nothing that the eulogizers eulogized, the embalmers embalmed and the buriers buried? He answered: I am expounding a verse, as it says, 'And you, fear not, My servant Yaakov… for behold, I save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity' (Yirmeyahu 30:10) — it compares him to his seed: just as his seed is alive, so too he is alive." Rashi: he lives forever; they embalmed him because they thought he had died.

719.label: Megillah 28b
719.rest: — "We learned there: 'And one who makes use of the crown (taga) passes away.' Reish Lakish taught: This is one who makes use of one who studies halachos, the crown of the Torah."

720.label: Menachos 29b
720.rest: — "Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav: When Moshe ascended on high, he found the Holy One, blessed be He, sitting and tying crowns to the letters. He said: Master of the world, who holds You back? He said: There is a man who will be at the end of many generations, Akiva ben Yosef is his name, who will expound upon each and every crownlet heaps upon heaps of halachos."

721.label: Shabbos 88a
721.rest: — "A certain Galilean expounded before Rav Chisda: Blessed is the Merciful One who gave a threefold Torah to a threefold people through a third-born, on the third day, in the third month." Rashi: Torah, Nevi'im and Kesuvim; Kohanim, Levi'im and Yisraelim; Moshe, who was third-born.

722.label: Nedarim 22b
722.rest: — "Rav Ada son of Rabbi Chanina said: Had Israel not sinned, they would have been given only the five books of the Torah and the book of Yehoshua alone, which contains the apportioning of Eretz Yisrael. What is the reason? 'For in much wisdom is much anger' (Koheles 1:18)." Rashi: because they rebelled, much wisdom — the other books — was added, to burden them further.

723.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13, 29a
723.rest: — "When the sukkah is complete, it is said of Yaakov, 'And Yaakov came whole' (Bereishis 33:18); and Yaakov is certainly the image of the middle pillar from the outside. But was not Moshe there? Rather, he was there from the inside: this one from the body, and that one from the soul."

724.label: Nedarim 38a
724.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi son of Rabbi Chanina said: The Torah was given only to Moshe and his seed, as it says, 'Write for yourself' (Shemos 34:27), 'Carve for yourself' (34:1) — just as the chips are yours, so is the writing yours; but Moshe dealt generously with it and gave it to Israel… Rather, it was only the pilpul [the dialectic] that was given to him."

725.label: Zohar II 81a (Yisro)
725.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon said: When the Holy One wished to reveal Himself on Mount Sinai, He called His whole household and said: Now Israel are children who do not know laws; if I reveal Myself to them with the power of Gevurah they cannot bear it, but I will reveal Myself with mercy and they will accept laws. That is, 'on the third day' — certainly, for it is mercy."

726.label: Zohar I (Vayeitzei)
726.rest: — "Yaakov is the glory of the Avos, and he is the totality of them all; and because he is the totality of all, he stands to give light to the moon."

727.label: Zohar II 11b (Shemos)
727.rest: — "'She hid him three months' (Shemos 2:2). Rabbi Yehudah said: It is an allusion that Moshe was not recognized in the supernal radiance until three months, as it is written, 'In the third month' (Shemos 19:1), for then the Torah was given through him and the Shechinah was revealed and rested upon him before the eyes of all."

728.label: Berachos 58a
728.rest: — "It was taught in a baraisa in the name of Rabbi Akiva: 'Yours, Hashem, is the greatness' (I Divrei HaYamim 29:11) — this is the splitting of the Sea; 'and the might' — the plague of the firstborn; 'and the tiferes' — the giving of the Torah; 'and the netzach' — Yerushalayim; 'and the hod' — the Beis HaMikdash."

729.label: Berachos 5b
729.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

730.label: Tanchuma, Pinchas 15
730.rest: — "'It shall be an Atzeres for you' (Bamidbar 29:35): it should properly have been fifty days after the festival, just as Atzeres is fifty days after Pesach."

731.label: Sefer Yetzirah 5
731.rest: — "He made the letter vav king over thought (hirhur)… and formed with it Shor (Taurus) in the world, Iyar in the year."

732.label: Bava Basra 164b
732.rest: — "Rav Amram said in the name of Rav: Three transgressions no person escapes each day: thoughts of sin, iyun tefillah [expecting one's prayer to be answered], and lashon hara."

733.label: Zohar II 81b (Yisro)
733.rest: — "'And the torches (lapidim)' — at first 'lightnings' and now 'torches': it is all one; but once they were set in their arrangements to be seen, they were called thus."

734.label: Zohar II 81a (Yisro)
734.rest: — "Rabbi Yehudah said: There were three darknesses, as it is written, 'darkness, cloud and thick mist' (Devarim 4:11), and that voice came forth from the innermost of them all. Rabbi Yosi said: From the innermost of all, of which it is written, 'a great voice that did not cease' (Devarim 5:19)."

735.label: Zohar II 81a (Yisro)
735.rest: — "'And a heavy cloud upon the mountain' — a strong cloud sunk in its place, not moving; 'and the sound of the shofar exceedingly strong' — from within the strong cloud that voice came forth, as you say, 'And it was when you heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness' (Devarim 5:20)."

736.label: Nedarim 20a
736.rest: — "'So that His fear may be upon your faces' (Shemos 20:17) — this is shame; 'that you not sin' — this teaches that shame leads to fear of sin. From here they said: It is a good sign in a person that he is bashful. Others say: Whoever is ashamed will not quickly sin, and one who has no shamefacedness — it is certain that his forefathers did not stand at Mount Sinai."

737.label: Shabbos 89b
737.rest: — "They opened and said, 'For You are our Father' (Yeshayahu 63:16). Yitzchak said to them: Rather than praising me, praise the Holy One, blessed be He — and Yitzchak shows them the Holy One with their own eyes. Immediately they lifted their eyes on high."

738.label: Zohar III 193a (Balak)
738.rest: — "Come and see: the ornaments of the Children of Israel are the gifts and presents they received, and therefore neither death nor the Other Side ruled over them. Not only did they take the Torah without any challenge — they received presents and gifts from all of them. Once they sinned, what is written? 'And the Children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments' (Shemos 33:6)."

739.label: Shabbos 88a
739.rest: — “Rabbi Simai expounded: When Israel placed 'We will do' before 'We will hear,' six hundred thousand ministering angels came, and tied two crowns to each individual of Israel, one corresponding to 'We will do' and one to 'We will hear.' When Israel sinned, twelve hundred thousand destructive angels descended and removed them, as it says: 'The children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments from Mount Chorev.' Rabbi Yochanan said: Moshe merited them all and took them. Reish Lakish said: In the future the Holy One, blessed be He, will return them to us, as it says: 'Those redeemed by Hashem will return and come to Zion with song, with everlasting joy upon their heads'—the joy that had been upon their heads from of old. Rabbi Elazar said: When Israel placed 'We will do' before 'We will hear,' a heavenly voice went forth: 'Who revealed to My children this secret used by the ministering angels?' For it is written: 'Bless Hashem, His angels, mighty in strength, who perform His word, to hear the voice of His word'—first performing, and afterward hearing.” This is the source both for the two crowns and for the angelic precedence of doing over hearing. Its account of Moshe receiving the lost crowns and their eventual restoration also underlies the ensuing discussion.

740.label: Zohar I 133b (Chayei Sarah)
740.rest: — "'And Avraham gave all that he had to Yitzchak' (Bereishis 25:5)… Here water was included in fire, and fire in water. At first fire was included in water — when? At the time he bound Yitzchak to execute judgment upon him; and now water was included in fire, so that all be the secret of supernal faith."

741.label: Avodah Zarah 5a
741.rest: — "As this Tanna taught: Rabbi Yosi says: Israel accepted the Torah only so that the Angel of Death would not rule over them, as it says, 'I said: you are angels, all of you children of the Most High' — you corrupted your deeds — 'therefore like men you shall die' (Tehillim 82:6–7)."

742.label: Bava Basra 16a
742.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: He is the Satan, he is the evil inclination, he is the Angel of Death. He is the Satan, as it is written, 'And the Satan went out from before Hashem' (Iyov 2:7); he is the evil inclination, as it is written there, 'only evil all day' (Bereishis 6:5)…; he is the Angel of Death, as it is written, 'only guard his soul' (Iyov 2:6)."

743.label: Pesachim 87b
743.rest: — “Rabbi Elazar said: The Holy One, blessed be He, exiled Israel among the nations only so that converts might be added to them, as it says, ‘I shall sow her for Myself in the land.’ Does a person sow a se’ah except to bring in many kor?” The Gemara expressly speaks of converts and compares exile with sowing. The extension to holy sparks within the nations belongs to the mystical explanation cited by Rav Tzadok.

744.label: Zohar III 160a, Shelach
744.rest: — “Furthermore, ‘Amalek dwells in the land of the Negev.’ If a person says that despite all this he will attain it: ‘Amalek dwells in the land of the Negev’—this is the evil inclination, the accuser, who accuses a person and is constantly found in the body. ‘The Hittite and the Amorite’—how many accusers are found there, so that a person cannot enter that world at all. Who will merit it, and who will enter it? With these words ‘they disheartened the children of Israel,’ for they brought out an evil report about it.” The Zohar first portrays the discouraging accusation, then answers it with sincere will and guarding the covenant. This exact context supports Rav Tzadok's identification of Amalek as the accusing root of the inclination.

745.label: Rashi, Bamidbar 21:1
745.rest: — "'The Canaanite' — this is Amalek… and they changed their language to speak in the language of Canaan, so that Israel would pray to the Holy One to give Canaanites into their hand, and they were not Canaanites."

746.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 48, 85a
746.rest: — "Fortunate is he who makes them a dwelling on Shabbos in the two chambers of the heart, so that the evil inclination, which is the desecration of Shabbos, is cleared out from there."

747.label: Shabbos 88a
747.rest: — “Rabbi Simai expounded: When Israel placed 'We will do' before 'We will hear,' six hundred thousand ministering angels came, and tied two crowns to each individual of Israel, one corresponding to 'We will do' and one to 'We will hear.' When Israel sinned, twelve hundred thousand destructive angels descended and removed them, as it says: 'The children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments from Mount Chorev.' Rabbi Yochanan said: Moshe merited them all and took them. Reish Lakish said: In the future the Holy One, blessed be He, will return them to us, as it says: 'Those redeemed by Hashem will return and come to Zion with song, with everlasting joy upon their heads'—the joy that had been upon their heads from of old. Rabbi Elazar said: When Israel placed 'We will do' before 'We will hear,' a heavenly voice went forth: 'Who revealed to My children this secret used by the ministering angels?' For it is written: 'Bless Hashem, His angels, mighty in strength, who perform His word, to hear the voice of His word'—first performing, and afterward hearing.” This is the source both for the two crowns and for the angelic precedence of doing over hearing. Its account of Moshe receiving the lost crowns and their eventual restoration also underlies the ensuing discussion.

748.label: Shabbos 89a
748.rest: — Moshe answered the angels: "What else is written in it? 'Remember the Shabbos day to sanctify it' — do you do work, that you need rest?… 'You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal' — is there jealousy among you? Is there an evil inclination among you? Immediately they conceded to the Holy One."

749.label: Mechilta, Yisro, Bachodesh 2
749.rest: — "'And now, if you will surely hearken' (Shemos 19:5) — 'and now': accept it upon yourselves now, for all beginnings are hard. 'If you will surely hearken' — from here they said: if a person hearkens to one mitzvah, they cause him to hearken to many mitzvos."

750.label: Berachos 40a
750.rest: — "Rabbi Zeira said: Come and see that the way of the Holy One is not like that of flesh and blood: an empty vessel of flesh and blood holds, a full one does not; but with the Holy One a full one holds and an empty one does not, as it says, 'If you will surely hearken' (Shemos 15:26) — if you hearken, you will hearken… If you hearken to the old, you will hearken to the new."

751.label: Zohar II 82b (Yisro)
751.rest: — "For we learned: six hundred and thirteen kinds of counsel (eitin) the Torah gave to a person, to be whole with his Master, for his Master wishes to do him good in this world and in the World to Come."

752.label: Zohar III 97b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
752.rest: — "Therefore it is called in this manner Atzeres, for in it is the nullification of the evil inclination; and therefore 'sin-offering' is not written of it as at the other times, where it is written 'a sin-offering to Hashem'; and then all the lights gathered to the Eishes Chayil — and therefore, Atzeres."

753.label: Tanchuma, Ki Sisa 16
753.rest: — "'Engraved (charus)' (Shemos 32:16) — what is charus? Rabbi Yehudah says: free from the kingdoms; Rabbi Nechemiah says: free from the Angel of Death; and the Rabbis say: free from suffering… The Holy One says to the Angel of Death: I gave you dominion over all the nations except this nation, to whom I gave freedom on the tablets."

754.label: Bava Basra 16a
754.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: He is the Satan, he is the evil inclination, he is the Angel of Death. He is the Satan, as it is written, 'And the Satan went out from before Hashem' (Iyov 2:7); he is the evil inclination, as it is written there, 'only evil all day' (Bereishis 6:5)…; he is the Angel of Death, as it is written, 'only guard his soul' (Iyov 2:6)."

755.label: Avodah Zarah 2b
755.rest: — "The Holy One says to them: With what did you occupy yourselves? They say before Him: Master of the world, we established many marketplaces, built many bathhouses, amassed much silver and gold — and we did it all only for the sake of Israel, so that they could occupy themselves with Torah."

756.label: Pesachim 87b
756.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: The Holy One, blessed be He, exiled Israel among the nations only so that converts would be added to them, as it says, 'And I will sow her for Me in the land' (Hoshea 2:25) — does a person sow a se'ah except to bring in many kor?"

757.label: Tanchuma, Beshalach 1
757.rest: — The Holy One said: If I lead them by the direct route, each will at once take hold of his field and vineyard and neglect the Torah; rather, I will lead them by way of the wilderness, "and they will eat the manna and drink the water of the well, and the Torah will settle into their bodies."

758.label: Tanchuma, Beshalach 20
758.rest: — "From here Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai said: The Torah was given to be expounded only to those who ate the manna, who had no need for work or trade… and second to them are those who eat terumah."

759.label: Tanchuma, Korach 4
759.rest: — "Korach said to them: 'It is enough for you, for the whole congregation, all of them are holy' (Bamidbar 16:3) — all of them heard at Sinai, 'I am Hashem your God.'"

760.label: Zohar III 98a (Ra'aya Meheimna)
760.rest: — "On Shavuos, the giving of the Torah, when the two Tablets were given from the side of the Tree of Life, one must offer alongside them the Two Loaves, which are the two hei's: the two days of Shavuos are Yud and Vav, and alongside them the Two Loaves of the hei's, for it is the bread of Torah, of which it is said, 'Come, eat of my bread' (Mishlei 9:5)."

761.label: Moed Katan 16b
761.rest: — "Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonasan: What is meant by 'The word of David son of Yishai, and the word of the man who was raised on high (hukam al)' (II Shmuel 23:1)? The word of David son of Yishai, who raised up the yoke (ullah) of teshuvah." Rashi: he repented first and opened the way for penitents.

762.label: Mechilta, Yisro, Bachodesh 5
762.rest: — "'I am Hashem your God' (Shemos 20:2) — why is it said? Because He revealed Himself at the Sea as a mighty warrior making war, as it says, 'Hashem is a man of war' (Shemos 15:3), and He revealed Himself at Mount Sinai as an elder full of compassion, as it says, 'And they saw the God of Israel, and under His feet as it were a work of sapphire brick' (Shemos 24:10)."

763.label: Zohar III 98a (Ra'aya Meheimna)
763.rest: — "On Shavuos, the giving of the Torah, when the two Tablets were given from the side of the Tree of Life, one must offer alongside them the Two Loaves, which are the two hei's: the two days of Shavuos are Yud and Vav, and alongside them the Two Loaves of the hei's, for it is the bread of Torah, of which it is said, 'Come, eat of my bread' (Mishlei 9:5)."

764.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 40, 80b
764.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: Father, one day we were in the study hall and the companions asked: What is it that Rabbi Akiva said to his students, 'When you reach the stones of pure marble, do not say "Water, water," lest you endanger yourselves, as it says, "He who speaks falsehood shall not be established before My eyes" (Tehillim 101:7)'?"

765.label: Chagigah 14b
765.rest: — "Our Rabbis taught: Four entered the Pardes: Ben Azzai, Ben Zoma, Acher and Rabbi Akiva. Rabbi Akiva said to them: When you reach the stones of pure marble, do not say 'Water, water,' for it says, 'He who speaks falsehood shall not be established before My eyes' (Tehillim 101:7)."

766.label: Zohar III 273a (Ra'aya Meheimna, Eikev)
766.rest: — "The second: to break bread over two loaves on Shabbos, which allude to the two Tablets of the Torah that were given on Shabbos."

767.label: Bava Kamma 17a
767.rest: — "And water means only Torah, as it says, 'Ho, all who are thirsty, go to the water' (Yeshayahu 55:1)."

768.label: Zohar III 80b (Kedoshim)
768.rest: — "A person is never purified except through the words of Torah; therefore words of Torah do not receive impurity, for it stands to purify the impure… And purity is found in the Torah, as it is written, 'The fear of Hashem is pure, enduring forever' (Tehillim 19:10). What is 'enduring forever'? That it stands constantly in that purity and never departs from it."

769.label: Tanchuma, Ki Sisa 16
769.rest: — "'Engraved (charus)' (Shemos 32:16) — what is charus? Rabbi Yehudah says: free from the kingdoms; Rabbi Nechemiah says: free from the Angel of Death; and the Rabbis say: free from suffering… The Holy One says to the Angel of Death: I gave you dominion over all the nations except this nation, to whom I gave freedom on the tablets."

770.label: Shabbos 105b
770.rest: — "R. Avin said: What is the verse? 'There shall be no strange god (el zar) within you, and you shall not bow to a foreign god.' Which is the strange god inside a person's body? Say: it is the evil inclination."

771.label: Sukkah 52a
771.rest: — "Rabbi Avira — some say Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi — expounded: The evil inclination has seven names. The Holy One called it 'evil'…; Moshe called it 'uncircumcised (orel),' as it says, 'Circumcise the foreskin of your heart' (Devarim 10:16); David called it 'impure,' as it says, 'Create for me a pure heart, O God' (Tehillim 51:12) — which implies there is an impure one."

772.label: Avos 6:2
772.rest: — "Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said: Every day a heavenly voice goes forth from Mount Chorev and proclaims: Woe to the creatures for the insult to the Torah… And it says, 'The writing was the writing of God, engraved (charus) on the tablets' (Shemos 32:16) — do not read charus but cheirus (freedom), for there is no free man except one who occupies himself with the study of Torah."

773.label: Chagigah 12a
773.rest: — "It was taught: Tohu is a green line that surrounds the whole world, from which darkness emerged…; Bohu — these are the slimy stones sunk in the depths, from which water issues, as it says, 'He shall stretch over it the line of tohu and the stones of bohu' (Yeshayahu 34:11)."

774.label: Zohar I 117a (Vayera)
774.rest: — "In the six hundredth year of the sixth millennium the gates of wisdom above and the springs of wisdom below will open, and the world will be prepared to enter the seventh… And your sign: 'In the six hundredth year of Noach's life… all the fountains of the great deep burst forth' (Bereishis 7:11)."

775.label: Chagigah 14b
775.rest: — "Ben Azzai gazed and died; of him the verse says, 'Precious in the eyes of Hashem is the death of His pious ones' (Tehillim 116:15). Ben Zoma gazed and was harmed; of him the verse says, 'Have you found honey? Eat what suffices you, lest you be sated with it and vomit it' (Mishlei 25:16). Acher cut the shoots. Rabbi Akiva came out in peace."

776.label: Zohar III, 12b
776.rest: — “‘Dominion and fear are with Him; He makes peace in His heights.’ Dominion is Avraham; fear is Yitzchak. ‘He makes peace in His heights’ is Yaakov, as it says, ‘Give truth to Yaakov,’ and, ‘Love truth and peace.’ Truth and peace are bound to one another. Therefore he is the perfection of all.” Truth does not remain detached from relationship. Yaakov’s truth is the harmonizing middle that unites both sides, clarifying why the maamar joins Yaakov’s truth with Yosef’s peace in the exchange of gifts.

777.label: Bava Basra 14b
777.rest: — In reckoning the space within the Ark, the Gemara includes "the broken pieces of the Tablets, which were placed in the Ark."

778.label: Shabbos 89a
778.rest: — "One of the Rabbis asked Rav Kahana: Have you heard what 'Mount Sinai' means? He said: A mountain on which miracles (nisim) were done for Israel. — Then it should be called Mount Nisai! — Rather, a mountain on which a good sign (siman) was made for Israel. — Then it should be called Mount Simanai!… Rav Chisda and Rabbah son of Rav Huna said: It is the mountain from which hatred (sinah) descended upon the idolaters."

779.label: Zohar II 54a (Beshalach)
779.rest: — "Rather, thus we learned: all the miracles and all the mighty deeds that were done for Israel — when the light of the Holy Atika shines in its crowns, engraved and inscribed… then it performs miracles and mighty deeds."

780.label: Niddah 31a
780.rest: — "This is what Rabbi Elazar said: What is meant by 'Who does great wonders alone' (Tehillim 72:18)? Even the beneficiary of a miracle does not recognize his miracle."

781.label: Zohar II 29a (Vaera)
781.rest: — "Come and see: He struck first at the lowest of all the levels. Rabbi Shimon said: The Holy One began from below, and His hand struck with each and every finger; and when it reached the highest level of all, He did His own deed — He passed through the land of Egypt and slew all; therefore He slew all the firstborn in Egypt, for it is the highest level, the firstborn of all."

782.label: Zohar II 36a (Bo)
782.rest: — "'And Hashem will strike Egypt, striking and healing' (Yeshayahu 19:22): striking for Egypt and healing for Israel. What healing? Since they were circumcised, they needed healing."

783.label: Zohar II (Beshalach)
783.rest: — "They would not journey until Moshe took hold of them and showed them the radiance of the glory of the Holy One in the wilderness; from their great longing and desire to gaze at it, Moshe led them away… 'And they went out to the wilderness of Shur' (Shemos 15:22) — what is the wilderness of Shur? The wilderness where they longed to gaze."

784.label: Shabbos 67a
784.rest: — "And let him say thus: O bush, O bush — not because you are taller than all trees did the Holy One rest His Shechinah upon you, but because you are lower than all trees did the Holy One rest His Shechinah upon you."

785.label: Sotah 21a
785.rest: — “‘When you lie down it shall guard you’—this is death; ‘and when you awake it shall speak with you’—in the World to Come.”

786.label: Magen Avraham, Orach Chaim 490:8, citing the Yalkut on Rus
786.rest: — "What does Rus have to do with Atzeres, that it is read at the time of the giving of the Torah? To teach you that the Torah was given only through suffering and poverty."

787.label: Nedarim 81a
787.rest: — "They sent from there: Be careful with the children of the poor, for from them Torah goes forth, as it says, 'Water shall flow from his buckets (midalyav)' (Bamidbar 24:7) — from the poor (dalim) among them Torah goes forth." Rashi: let them not be light in your eyes when teaching them Torah.

788.label: Sotah 21b (cited as 21a)
788.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Words of Torah endure only in one who makes himself as one who is not, as it is said, 'And wisdom — from nothing (me-ayin) shall it be found.'" Rashi: me-ayin — from one who makes himself as nothing.

789.label: Taanis 7a
789.rest: — "Rabbi Chanina bar Idi said: Why are the words of Torah likened to water, as it is written, 'Ho, all who are thirsty, go to the water' (Yeshayahu 55:1)? To tell you: just as water leaves a high place and goes to a low place, so the words of Torah endure only in one whose mind is humble."

790.label: Kiddushin 66a
790.rest: — "'And the Torah — what will become of it?' 'Behold, it is wrapped and set down in a corner; whoever wishes to learn, let him come and learn.'" Rashi: the sefer Torah lies wrapped with the mitzvos in it, and they will not be forgotten.

791.label: Bava Basra 91b
791.rest: — "'They dwelt there with the king in his work' (I Divrei HaYamim 4:23) — this is Rus the Moabite, who saw the kingship of Shlomo, the grandson of her grandson, as it says, 'And he placed a throne for the king's mother' (I Melachim 2:19); and Rabbi Elazar said: for the mother of kingship."

792.label: Bava Basra 12a
792.rest: — "From the day the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed, prophecy was taken from the prophets and given to the Sages… Abaye said: Know that this is so, for a great man says something, and the same is then reported in the name of another great man." The Ramban there infers that the Sages' teaching comes through a form of ruach hakodesh.

793.label: Zohar I 27a
793.rest: — "An old man rose and said: Rebbi, Rebbi, so it certainly is, but it is not called the Tree of Life. Rather, this is the secret: 'and He formed (vayitzer)' — one formation of good and one of evil: this is the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil… it has two formations, which are prohibited and permitted."

794.label: Rosh Hashanah 25a
794.rest: — "Rabbi Chiya saw the old moon still standing on the morning of the twenty-ninth. He threw a clod at it and said: Tonight we are to sanctify you, and you stand here?! Go, hide! Rebbi said to Rabbi Chiya: Go to Ein Tov, sanctify the month, and send me the sign: 'David, King of Israel, lives and endures.'"

795.label: Taanis 5b
795.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Yaakov Avinu did not die. He was asked: Was it for nothing that the eulogizers eulogized, the embalmers embalmed and the buriers buried? He answered: I am expounding a verse, as it says, 'And you, fear not, My servant Yaakov… for behold, I save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity' (Yirmeyahu 30:10) — it compares him to his seed: just as his seed is alive, so too he is alive." Rashi: he lives forever; they embalmed him because they thought he had died.

796.label: Shabbos 88a
796.rest: — "One hundred twenty myriads of destroying angels came down and removed [the crowns] from them, as it says, 'And the Children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments from Mount Chorev' (Shemos 33:6)… Rabbi Yochanan said: Moshe merited all of them and took them, as the next verse says, 'And Moshe would take the tent.'" Rashi: the two crowns were of the radiance of the Shechinah.

797.label: Zohar III 253a (Pinchas)
797.rest: — "'And on the day of the first fruits, when you bring a new meal-offering' (Bamidbar 28:26). Rabbi Abba said: The day of the first fruits — which day is it? The river that goes out of Eden, which is the day of those supernal first fruits; on it the Torah depends, and it brings forth all the secrets of the Torah; and because it is the Tree of Life, the fruit of trees had to be brought."

798.label: Zohar I 26a (Bereishis)
798.rest: — "At that time it will be said of Moshe and Israel, 'Then you shall delight (tisaneg) upon Hashem' (Yeshayahu 58:14) — with oneg, which is ayin, Eden; nun, nahar (river); gimel, gan (garden)… and it will be turned for the Erev Rav, from oneg (delight) to nega (plague)."

799.label: Kiddushin 38a
799.rest: — "From where do we know that Moshe was born on the seventh of Adar? For it says, 'I am a hundred and twenty years old today' (Devarim 31:2): 'today' teaches that the Holy One, blessed be He, sits and fills the years of the righteous from day to day and from month to month, as it says, 'The number of your days I will fill' (Shemos 23:26)."

800.label: Moed Katan 16b
800.rest: — "Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonasan: What is meant by 'The word of David son of Yishai, and the word of the man who was raised on high (hukam al)' (II Shmuel 23:1)? The word of David son of Yishai, who raised up the yoke (ullah) of teshuvah." Rashi: he repented first and opened the way for penitents.

801.label: Sotah 21a
801.rest: — "'And Torah is light' (Mishlei 6:23) — to tell you: just as light protects forever, so Torah protects forever. And it says, 'When you walk it shall lead you' — this is this world; 'when you lie down it shall guard you' — this is death; 'and when you awake it shall converse with you' — in the time to come." Rashi: it will plead your merit.

802.label: Magen Avraham, Orach Chaim 494 (opening)
802.rest: — "And the further difficulty — that the Torah was given on the fifty-first day of the Omer, since they left Egypt on Thursday and the Torah was given on Shabbos — the Yefeh Mar'eh already answered: it comes to allude to us the second Yom Tov of the Diaspora; and perhaps this is what is meant by 'Moshe added one day on his own.'"

803.label: Beitzah 4b
803.rest: — "And now that we know the fixing of the month, why do we keep two days? Because they sent from there: Be careful with the custom of your fathers in your hands, for at times the government may issue a decree and it will lead to error."

804.label: Sukkah 20a
804.rest: — "At first, when the Torah was forgotten from Israel, Ezra came up from Bavel and established it; it was again forgotten, and Hillel the Babylonian came up and established it; it was again forgotten, and Rabbi Chiya and his sons came up and established it."

805.label: Chullin 91a
805.rest: — "'And a man wrestled with him' (Bereishis 32:25) … Shmuel said: He appeared to him as a Torah scholar."

806.label: Berachos 61a
806.rest: — "Rav said: The evil inclination resembles a fly and sits between the two openings of the heart, as it says, 'Dead flies make the perfumer's oil putrid' (Koheles 10:1). Shmuel said: It resembles a kind of wheat (chitah), as it says, 'Sin (chatas) crouches at the door' (Bereishis 4:7)."

807.label: Kiddushin 30b
807.rest: — "Our Rabbis taught: There are three partners in a person: the Holy One, blessed be He, his father and his mother."

808.label: Zohar III 61a (Acharei Mos)
808.rest: — "What is Kodesh? The completeness of all, called supernal Chochmah; from this place the holy anointing oil flows along known paths to the place called supernal Binah, and from there springs and streams go forth on every side… And when this Zos is blessed from that supernal place called Kodesh… they call her Ruach HaKodesh — a spirit from that Kodesh." A parallel appears in Haazinu (Zohar III 297a).

809.label: Pesachim 68b
809.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: All agree regarding Atzeres that we also require 'for you.' What is the reason? It is the day on which the Torah was given. Rabbah said: All agree regarding Shabbos… Rav Yosef said: All agree regarding Purim." Rashi: one should rejoice with food and drink, to show that this day on which the Torah was given is pleasing and welcome to Israel.

810.label: Avos 3:5
810.rest: — "R. Nechunya b. HaKanah says: Whoever accepts upon himself the yoke of Torah, the yoke of government and the yoke of worldly affairs are removed from him; whoever casts off the yoke of Torah, the yoke of government and worldly affairs are placed upon him."

811.label: Berachos 13a
811.rest: — "Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korchah said: Why does the portion of Shema precede 'And it shall be if you hearken'? So that one first accepts upon himself the yoke of the Kingship of Heaven, and afterwards accepts upon himself the yoke of mitzvos."

812.label: Berachos 17a
812.rest: — "'Our leaders are laden' (Tehillim 144:14): one said, 'our leaders' in Torah and 'laden' with mitzvos; the other said, 'our leaders' in Torah and mitzvos, and 'laden' with suffering."

813.label: Taanis 30a
813.rest: — On Tisha B'Av one may not read or learn Torah, "because it says, 'The precepts of Hashem are upright, gladdening the heart' (Tehillim 19:9)"; but one may read Iyov, Kinos and the harsh parts of Yirmeyahu.

814.label: Berachos 17a
814.rest: — "Master of the worlds, it is revealed and known before You that our will is to do Your will. And who prevents us? The leaven in the dough and the subjugation to the kingdoms." Rashi: the leaven in the dough is the evil inclination in our hearts, which sours us.

815.label: Tanchuma, Tetzaveh 1
815.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai said: Come and see: nothing is dearer to a person than his son, yet he circumcises him. Why? Rav Nachman bar Shmuel said: To do the will of his Creator; he sees his son shedding blood from his milah and accepts it upon himself with joy. Rabbi Chanina said: And not only that, but he spends money and makes it a day of joy."

816.label: Gittin 57b
816.rest: — "'For Your sake we are killed all the day' (Tehillim 44:23). Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said: This is milah, which was given for the eighth day." Rashi: "killed," for at times the child dies of it.

817.label: Zohar II 23a (Vaera)
817.rest: — "'I also established My covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan': because they were circumcised. Whoever is circumcised inherits the land, for only a tzaddik inherits the land, and whoever is circumcised is called a tzaddik, as it says, 'Your people are all righteous; they shall inherit the land forever.'"

818.label: Berachos 21a
818.rest: — "From where is the blessing over the Torah before it from the Torah? For it says, 'When I call the Name of Hashem, ascribe greatness to our God' (Devarim 32:3)."

819.label: Zohar II 60a (Beshalach)
819.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: They went out to the wilderness to gaze upon the Holy One, and He removed His glorious radiance from there; they went to look for the Holy One and did not find Him. And we learned that the Holy One is called Torah, and water means only Torah, and Torah is none other than the Holy One, blessed be He."

820.label: Kesubos 67b
820.rest: — "A certain man came before Rava. He asked: On what do you dine? He said: On fattened chicken and aged wine. He said: Are you not concerned about the burden on the community? He said: Do I eat of theirs? I eat of the Merciful One's, as we learned: 'You give them their food in his time' (Tehillim 145:15) — it does not say 'in their time' but 'in his time': to each one the Holy One gives his sustenance in his time."

821.label: Yerushalmi, Berachos 7:3
821.rest: — Shmuel said: I do not exclude myself from the community. Rabbi Avin said: Since he says "hamevorach" (who is blessed), he too does not exclude himself from the community.

822.label: Zohar III 93a (Ra'aya Meheimna)
822.rest: — "'And you shall not profane My holy Name, and I shall be sanctified among the Children of Israel' (Vayikra 22:32): this mitzvah is to sanctify Him every day, to raise His holiness from below to above, just as He is holy above… 'I shall be sanctified among the Children of Israel' — above and below: above in three levels, below in three levels."

823.label: Zohar II 135b (Terumah)
823.rest: — "'Blessed is Hashem, the Blessed One' — this is the drawing forth of blessings from the source of life, the place from which all watering goes forth; and because it is the source, in the secret of the sign of the covenant, we call it 'the Blessed One' (hamevorach) — the spring of the well; once they reach there, the well is surely filled, and its waters never cease."

824.label: Pesachim 68b
824.rest: — "Rav Yosef, on the day of Atzeres, would say: Prepare for me a choice third-grown calf. He said: Were it not for this day that brought it about, how many Yosefs are there in the marketplace!"

825.label: Sotah 49b
825.rest: — "When Rebbi died, humility and fear of sin ceased. Rav Yosef said to the reciter: Do not teach 'humility,' for there is I. Rav Nachman said to the reciter: Do not teach 'fear of sin,' for there is I." Rashi: for I am humble.

826.label: Berachos 64a
826.rest: — "Rav Yosef was 'Sinai' and Rabbah 'an uprooter of mountains.' The hour required them. They sent there: 'Sinai' and 'an uprooter of mountains' — which takes precedence? They sent back: Sinai takes precedence, for all need the owner of the wheat. Even so, Rav Yosef did not accept, for the astrologers had told him: You will reign two years."

827.label: Taanis 20a
827.rest: — "A person should always be soft like a reed and not hard like a cedar. Once Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon was coming from Migdal Gedor, from the house of his teacher, riding on a donkey along the riverbank, and he was greatly joyful, and his mind was proud, because he had learned much Torah."

828.label: Avodah Zarah 5a
828.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi said: Ben David will not come until all the souls in the Guf are used up, as it says, 'For the spirit before Me wraps itself, and the souls I have made' (Yeshayahu 57:16)."

829.label: Tosafos, Avodah Zarah 5a (s.v. ein ben David)
829.rest: — "'The son of David will not come until all the souls in the guf are finished.' And if you ask: they could be finished through the gentiles who give birth — Rabbi Elchanan says that the souls of Israel and of the gentiles are not in one guf."

830.label: Sefer Yetzirah 4:12
830.rest: — "These are the seven planets in the world…; these are the seven days in the year, the seven days of Creation; and the seven gates in the soul: two eyes, two ears, two nostrils and the mouth."

831.label: Zohar III, Pinchas (Ra'aya Meheimna)
831.rest: — "'Men of valor, God-fearing, men of truth' (Shemos 18:21): 'men of valor' — from the side of the right of Avraham, where there is the seeing of Torah; 'God-fearing' — from the side of Yitzchak, where there is hearing, as Chavakuk the prophet said, 'Hashem, I have heard Your report and I was afraid' (Chavakuk 3:2); 'men of truth' — from the side of Yaakov, where there is smell."

832.label: Gittin 60b
832.rest: — "Rabbi Yehudah bar Nachmani, the interpreter of Reish Lakish, expounded: It is written, 'Write for yourself these words' (Shemos 34:27), and it is written, 'for according to (al pi) these words' — how so? Words that are written you may not say by heart; words that are oral you may not say in writing."

833.label: Bava Kamma 55a
833.rest: — "Rather, because Scripture opened with it for good at first: from 'Bereishis' until 'And God saw the light, that it was good (tov)' (Bereishis 1:4), no tes is written." Rashi: the first tes written in the Torah was said for good.

834.label: Berachos 5a
834.rest: — “Rabbi Yochanan said: ... Whoever can occupy himself with Torah but does not do so, the Holy One, blessed be He, brings ugly sufferings upon him and troubles him, as it is said, I became mute in silence; I was silent from good, and my pain was stirred up. Good means nothing other than Torah, as it is said, For I have given you a good teaching; do not abandon My Torah.” Rav Tzadok draws on the identification of good with Torah when reading a good heart as a heart shaped by Torah.

835.label: Shabbos 27b
835.rest: — "Why do you include a blind man's garment and exclude a night garment? I include a blind man's garment, which is seen by others, and exclude a night garment, which is not seen by others."

836.label: Menachos 29b
836.rest: — "[The scribes] make a bump (chotrei) on the roof of the Ches, as if to say: He lives (chai) in the heights of the world." Rashi: the roof of the Ches is made with a raised point above, meaning that the Holy One, blessed is He, Who lives forever, dwells in the heights of the world.

837.label: Zohar II 60a (Beshalach)
837.rest: — “We have learned that the Holy One, blessed be He, is called Torah… and Torah is none other than the Holy One, blessed be He.”

838.label: Yoma 86b
838.rest: — "Rabbi Meir used to say: Great is teshuvah, for on account of one individual who repents the whole world is forgiven, as it says, 'I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely, for My anger has turned away from him' (Hoshea 14:5) — it does not say 'from them' but 'from him.'"

839.label: Shabbos 89b
839.rest: — “If your sins are like these years, which are arranged and come from the six days of creation until now, they will be made white as snow.”

840.label: Shabbos 77b
840.rest: — “He said to him: ‘Why do the goats go first, and afterward the sheep?’ He answered: ‘Like the creation of the world: first darkness, and afterward light.’” Rabbi Zeira’s question to Rav Yehudah supplies the expression quoted here. Rav Tzadok applies the sequence of darkness and light to the purification that brings the future world out of the present one.

841.label: Zohar II 184a, Tetzaveh
841.rest: — “There is no light except that which emerges from within darkness; for when this side is subdued, the Holy One, blessed be He, is exalted above.”

842.label: Yoma 28b
842.rest: — "Rav said: Avraham Avinu fulfilled the entire Torah, as it says, 'Because Avraham listened to My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes and My Torahs' (Bereishis 26:5). Rav Shimi bar Chiya said to Rav: Perhaps only the seven mitzvos? — There was milah too! — Perhaps seven and milah? — If so, why 'My commandments and My Torahs'?"

843.label: Berachos 6b
843.rest: — "What is 'For this is all of man' (Koheles 12:13)? Rabbi Elazar said: The Holy One said, the entire world was created only for the sake of this one." Rashi: "for the sake of this one" — so that this one would be created.

844.label: Zohar II, Terumah
844.rest: — "When [the lamp] receives from between the two arms, the 248 upper limbs, she opens her two arms toward them… And Torah is light from the side of the primordial light, which is the right; for the Torah was given from that side of the right, as it is written, 'From His right hand, a fiery law for them' (Devarim 33:2), though the left was included in it."

845.label: Zohar III, Pinchas (Ra'aya Meheimna)
845.rest: — "'Men of valor, God-fearing, men of truth' (Shemos 18:21): 'men of valor' — from the side of the right of Avraham, where there is the seeing of Torah; 'God-fearing' — from the side of Yitzchak, where there is hearing, as Chavakuk the prophet said, 'Hashem, I have heard Your report and I was afraid' (Chavakuk 3:2); 'men of truth' — from the side of Yaakov, where there is smell."

846.label: Berachos 6a
846.rest: — "From where do we know that the Holy One, blessed is He, puts on tefillin? As it says, 'Hashem has sworn by His right hand and by the arm of His strength' (Yeshayahu 62:8): 'His right hand' — this is Torah… 'the arm of His strength' — these are tefillin, as it says, 'Hashem will give strength (oz) to His people' (Tehillim 29:11)."

847.label: Nedarim 22b
847.rest: — “Had Israel not sinned, they would have been given only the five books of the Torah and the book of Yehoshua.”

848.label: Zohar I 27a (Bereishis)
848.rest: — "In the lower tree there are certainly foreign husks… and its husks are from this side good and from that side evil; and this is prohibited and permitted, kosher and invalid, impurity and purity."

849.label: Tanchuma, Noach 3
849.rest: — "'A great light' (Yeshayahu 9:1) — the light that was created on the first day, which the Holy One, blessed be He, hid away for those who toil in the Oral Torah by day and by night, in whose merit the world stands, as it says, 'If not for My covenant day and night…' (Yirmeyahu 33:25). Which covenant is practiced by day and by night? This is Talmud."

850.label: Zohar III 11b (Vayikra)
850.rest: — "Come and see: ten utterances for the work of Creation, as we learned, 'With ten utterances the world was created'; ten utterances for the giving of the Torah — the Ten Commandments. It is written, 'I am Hashem your God' (Shemos 20:2), and in the work of Creation, 'Let there be light, and there was light' (Bereishis 1:3) — this is the faith of the Holy One, blessed be He, who is called 'light.'"

851.label: Zohar III, Pinchas (Ra'aya Meheimna)
851.rest: — "'Men of valor, God-fearing, men of truth' (Shemos 18:21): 'men of valor' — from the side of the right of Avraham, where there is the seeing of Torah; 'God-fearing' — from the side of Yitzchak, where there is hearing, as Chavakuk the prophet said, 'Hashem, I have heard Your report and I was afraid' (Chavakuk 3:2); 'men of truth' — from the side of Yaakov, where there is smell."

852.label: Berachos 64a
852.rest: — "R. Chiya bar Ashi said in the name of Rav: Torah scholars have no rest, neither in this world nor in the World to Come, as it says, 'They go from strength to strength; [each] appears before God in Tzion.'" Rashi: they go from yeshivah to yeshivah and from midrash to midrash.

853.label: Berachos 64a
853.rest: — "Torah scholars have no rest, neither in this world nor in the World to Come, as it says, 'They go from strength to strength; each one appears before God in Tziyon' (Tehillim 84:8)." Rashi: from yeshivah to yeshivah and from beis midrash to beis midrash.

854.label: Tanchuma, Balak 17
854.rest: — "'And the people began to commit harlotry' (Bamidbar 25:1): there are springs that raise mighty men and some that raise weaklings; some raise handsome people and some ugly; some raise modest people and some steeped in lewdness — and the spring of Shittim was one of harlotry, and it watered Sedom."

855.label: Chullin 91a
855.rest: — "'And a man wrestled with him' (Bereishis 32:25) … Shmuel said: He appeared to him as a Torah scholar."

856.label: Sanhedrin 103b
856.rest: — "Our Rabbis taught: Menasheh would study fifty-five facets in Toras Kohanim, corresponding to the years of his reign; Achav, eighty-five; Yeravam, one hundred and three." Rashi: every year he would innovate in the book of Vayikra and expound it with his dialectic.

857.label: Zohar III 272b (Ra'aya Meheimna)
857.rest: — "Just as one must receive the mistress with many lights of lamps on Shabbos, with many delights and fine garments and a house set in order…, through this joy and arrangement the evil maidservant is left in darkness, in hunger, in weeping and mourning, in black garments like a widow — for if this one is full, that one is desolate."

858.label: Kesubos 104a
858.rest: — "At the time of Rebbi's passing he raised his ten fingers upward and said: Master of the world, it is revealed and known before You that I toiled with my ten fingers in Torah and did not benefit even with my little finger; may it be Your will that there be peace in my repose. A heavenly voice went forth: 'He shall come in peace; they shall rest on their beds' (Yeshayahu 57:2)."

859.label: Zohar II 186a (Tetzaveh)
859.rest: — "'This month shall be for you' (Shemos 12:2): it is Mine, but I have handed it to you, so it is yours openly; but the seventh is Mine, therefore it is concealed. Your month follows the order of the letters — Aviv, which is Alef-Beis-Gimmel in order; but the seventh month, which is Mine, is from the end of the letters — Tishrei. Why? You from below to above, and I from above to below."

860.label: Tikkunei Zohar (77b)
860.rest: — "'Let there be light' — this is Pesach, the night of the fourteenth; 'and there was light' — Rosh Hashanah, of which it says 'and it was the day.'" These words stand in Tikkun 36 (77b); the printed reference says Tikkun 30.

861.label: Pri Etz Chaim, Shaar Rosh Chodesh 3
861.rest: — The Name Havayah brings all being into existence, and nothing in the world lacks light from this Name; it has twelve permutations, divided among the twelve months of the year, and the four letters of Havayah — one letter per month — return each year.

862.label: Zohar II 52a (Beshalach)
862.rest: — On the Name of Seventy-Two: the verse "Vayisa" is written in order, each letter in its row, "and thus the rows were arranged in order, in the secret of Chesed"; the verse "Vayavo" is written in reverse, "and thus the rows were arranged in reverse, in the secret of Gevurah, all of them to the left."

863.label: Zohar III 150b (Behaaloscha)
863.rest: — "The second, of Yitzchak, is likewise found in seventy-two letters, to be in judgment toward the Egyptians and in mercy toward Israel… and therefore the order of the letters is in reverse, in a crooked way and not straight."

864.label: Zohar II 186a (Tetzaveh)
864.rest: — "'This month shall be for you' (Shemos 12:2): it is Mine, but I have handed it to you, so it is yours openly; but the seventh is Mine, therefore it is concealed. Your month follows the order of the letters — Aviv, which is Alef-Beis-Gimmel in order; but the seventh month, which is Mine, is from the end of the letters — Tishrei. Why? You from below to above, and I from above to below."

865.label: Rosh Hashanah 27a
865.rest: — "Like whom do we pray today, 'This day is the beginning of Your works, a remembrance of the first day'? Like Rabbi Eliezer, who said the world was created in Tishrei." Tosafos there (s.v. kemaan) explain that both views are the words of the living God: in Tishrei it arose in thought to create, and it was not created until Nissan.

866.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 41, 81a
866.rest: — In "Bereishis" are the letters of Tishrei, and this is the second arm, the second day; "He made (yashes) darkness His hiding place" (Tehillim 18:12): remove yashes from bereishis and reish remains — Rosh Hashanah.

867.label: Rema, Orach Chaim 1:1
867.rest: — "When a person takes to heart that the great King, the Holy One, blessed be He, whose glory fills the whole earth, stands over him and sees his deeds, as it says, 'Can a man hide in secret places that I shall not see him? says Hashem' (Yirmeyahu 23:24) — immediately awe and submission will come upon him, in dread of Hashem Yisbarach, and he will be ashamed before Him constantly."

868.label: Berachos 28b
868.rest: — "They said to him: Our master, bless us. He said to them: May it be His will that the fear of Heaven be upon you like the fear of flesh and blood. His students said: Only so far? He said to them: Would that it were so! Know that when a person commits a transgression, he says: Let no person see me."

869.label: Nedarim 8b
869.rest: — "There is no Gehinnom in the World to Come; rather, the Holy One, blessed be He, takes the sun out of its sheath: the righteous are healed by it and the wicked are judged by it, as it says, 'And for you who fear My Name a sun of righteousness shall shine, with healing in its wings' (Malachi 3:20)."

870.label: Zohar I 137a–138a (Midrash HaNe'elam, Toldos)
870.rest: — In the future, when the evil inclination is no longer soiled as before, it will be called Lavan (white); what remains of it is the desire for the delight of Torah — "for were it not for the evil inclination, the joy of learning would not exist" (138a).

871.label: Zohar II 36a (Bo)
871.rest: — "Rabbi Chizkiyah taught: It is written, 'And Hashem will strike Egypt, striking and healing' (Yeshayahu 19:22) — striking for Egypt and healing for Israel. What is the healing? That they were circumcised and needed healing."

872.label: Shabbos 89b
872.rest: — “If your sins are like these years, which are arranged and come from the six days of creation until now, they will be made white as snow.”

873.label: Zohar II 229b–230a (Pekudei)
873.rest: — [The letter tes was not engraved among the names of the tribes,] "for the letter tes is hidden and concealed, and it shines the light of all… as it is written, 'And God saw the light, that it was good (tov)' (Bereishis 1:4) — it is the radiance of that hidden and concealed light."

874.label: Yoma 73b
874.rest: — On the stones of the Urim VeTumim: "But tzadi is not written in them! Rav Shmuel bar Yitzchak said: 'Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov' was written there. But tes is not written! Rav Acha bar Yaakov said: 'Shivtei Yeshurun' was written there."

875.label: Shabbos 89b
875.rest: — "They opened and said, 'For You are our Father' (Yeshayahu 63:16). Yitzchak said to them: Rather than praising me, praise the Holy One, blessed be He — and Yitzchak shows them the Holy One with their own eyes. Immediately they lifted their eyes on high."

876.label: Bava Kamma 55a
876.rest: — "Rather, because Scripture opened with it for good at first: from 'Bereishis' until 'And God saw the light, that it was good (tov)' (Bereishis 1:4), no tes is written." Rashi: the first tes written in the Torah was said for good.

877.label: Zohar II 184a, Tetzaveh
877.rest: — “There is no good except that which emerges from within evil.”

878.label: Shabbos 77b
878.rest: — “He said to him: ‘Why do the goats go first, and afterward the sheep?’ He answered: ‘Like the creation of the world: first darkness, and afterward light.’” Rabbi Zeira’s question to Rav Yehudah supplies the expression quoted here. Rav Tzadok applies the sequence of darkness and light to the purification that brings the future world out of the present one.

879.label: Rosh Hashanah 18a
879.rest: — "'Seek Hashem while He may be found' (Yeshayahu 55:6) — for an individual, when? Rabbah bar Avuha said: These are the ten days between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur."

880.label: Zohar II 180b (Tetzaveh)
880.rest: — These two letters [ches and kuf] are better known to [the forces of falsehood]; "and therefore in 'Tehillah LeDavid' (Tehillim 145) a vav is written in every verse, letter by letter, except in these two, where vav is not written, for vav is the Name of the Holy One."

881.label: Zohar II 148b (Terumah)
881.rest: — "The woman of valor — that mark, and her letter is hei… The woman of harlotry — that mark, and her letter is in the color that was needed but was not set right to be so: her letter is kuf. The letter kuf is in the form of hei, but was not set right to be so — like a monkey beside people, which goes after people but is not fit to do as they do."

882.label: Shabbos 104a
882.rest: — "Kuf — kadosh (holy); reish — rasha (wicked). Why is the face of the kuf turned away from the reish? The Holy One, blessed be He, said: I cannot look upon the wicked."

883.label: Menachos 29b
883.rest: — "And why is the roof of the ches given a peak? As if to say: He lives (chai) in the heights of the world."

884.label: Shabbos 87a
884.rest: — "He broke the Tablets. What did he expound? He said: If of the Pesach offering, which is one of the 613 mitzvos, the Torah said, 'No foreigner shall eat of it' (Shemos 12:43) — here is the whole Torah, and Israel are apostates; how much more so! And from where do we know that the Holy One agreed with him? As it says, 'which you broke' (Shemos 34:1) — and Reish Lakish said: Yishar kochacha that you broke them." Rashi: "asher" — an affirmation (ishur), that He praised him for breaking them.

885.label: Zohar I 1b–2a (Introduction)
885.rest: — The hidden beginning is called only Mi (Who); it wished to be revealed and called by name, clothed itself in a precious garment and created Eleh (these); Eleh rose in name, these letters joined with those, and it was completed in the Name Elokim.

886.label: Zohar III 159b (Shelach)
886.rest: — "And the ruach enters the Garden of Eden on earth, and a garment of light is prepared for it in the very form of the body of this world, and it is clothed and arrayed in it, and there is its constant dwelling; and on Roshei Chodashim and Shabbosos it is bound to the neshamah, and ascends and is crowned higher and higher, as it is written, 'And it shall be, from one month to its month' (Yeshayahu 66:23)."

887.label: Zohar II, 88a
887.rest: — “Rabbi Abba said: Blessing is prepared for those supernal days, which are blessed from this day. On this day the head of Zeir Anpin is filled with dew descending from Atika Kadisha, the most concealed of all. He pours it upon the field of holy apples three times from the entrance of Shabbos, so that all will be blessed together.” The threefold flow of dew is the specific basis for linking the three Shabbos meals to the upper and lower modes of receiving blessing.

888.label: Zohar III 79b (Acharei Mos)
888.rest: — "So too at the renewal of the moon, for the sun shines upon it in the joy of the light of Atika above; therefore this offering is for above, so that all be sweetened and joy be found in the world; and therefore, 'bring for Me an atonement.'"

889.label: Zohar III 148b (Behaaloscha)
889.rest: — "'Like a groom coming out of his chuppah' (Tehillim 19:6) — what is his chuppah? 'The crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding' (Shir HaShirim 3:11)… 'From the end of the heavens is his going forth' — this is the beginning of all, called 'the end of the heavens.'"

890.label: Zohar III 65b (Acharei Mos)
890.rest: — "The Yud at first is the totality of all, hidden on every side... The upper tip of the Yud alludes to Ayin (Nothingness)." Zohar III 10b (Vayikra): "The Yud of the holy Name is tied with three knots: one tip above, one below and one in the middle. The tip above is Kesser Elyon, highest of all the highest, head of all heads."

891.label: Zohar II, Beshalach 64b
891.rest: — “Rabbi Abba said: What is meant by ‘Is the Lord in our midst, or nothing?’ Were Israel fools who did not know this matter? Had they not seen the Divine Presence before them and the clouds of glory surrounding them? ... Rather, Rabbi Shimon said this: They wished to know the difference between the Ancient One, concealed beyond all concealment, who is called Nothing, and Zeir Anpin, who is called the Lord. ... Why, then, were they punished? Because they made a separation and put it to a test. They said: If it is this One, we will ask in one manner; if it is this One, we will ask in another manner. Therefore, immediately, ‘Amalek came.’” The Zohar interprets Israel's question at Massah as a question about the degree from which Divine governance was being revealed. It explicitly names the concealed Atika as Ayin.

892.label: Zohar III 170b (Shelach)
892.rest: — "And if you say, it is written, 'And Avraham was old, advanced in days' (Bereishis 24:1) — rather, 'advanced in days' means in those supernal days that renew worlds like an eagle."

893.label: Bava Metzia 38a
893.rest: — "Rav Kahana said: A person prefers one kav of his own to nine kavin of his fellow's."

894.label: Zevachim 91a
894.rest: — "Come and hear: the mussafin of Shabbos precede the mussafin of Rosh Chodesh. — Is it so that [the sanctity of] Rosh Chodesh is effective for its own mussafin, but not effective for the mussafin of Shabbos?" The Gemara thus weighs the view that the Rosh Chodesh mussafin are more sanctified than those of Shabbos.

895.label: Zohar III (Shelach)
895.rest: — "On every Rosh Chodesh, Shabbos, festival and appointed time, when all the members of the Academy wish to ascend to the Heavenly Academy, all of them gather before the King."

896.label: Zohar III 164b (Shelach)
896.rest: — "On every Rosh Chodesh and Shabbos, festivals and appointed times, when all the members of the yeshivos wish to ascend to the heavenly yeshivah, they all gather to King Mashiach, and he expounds words, and from the sweetness of his words they all ascend in longing."

897.label: Zohar III 168a (Shelach)
897.rest: — "On every Rosh Chodesh and Shabbos, festivals and appointed times, those males ascend to appear before the holy King — males and not females, as it says, 'all your males shall appear' (Shemos 23:17); and when they return, they return with many new words, and repeat the words before the head of the yeshivah."

898.label: Rashi, Bereishis 1:1
898.rest: — "Rabbi Yitzchak said: The Torah should have begun only from 'This month shall be for you' (Shemos 12:2), which is the first mitzvah that Israel were commanded."

899.label: Megillah 16b
899.rest: — “'And honor'—these are tefillin, as it is said: 'All the peoples of the earth shall see that the Name of Hashem is called upon you, and they shall fear you.' Rabbi Eliezer the Great says: These are the tefillin of the head.” The maamar now develops the 'honor' clause, beyond its earlier treatment of light and joy. The head-tefillin image permits Rav Tzadok's association with the supernal crown.

900.label: Zohar I 48b (Bereishis)
900.rest: — "That additional soul, from the secret of 'Remember,' comes upon this sukkah of peace, taken from the World to Come… and with that addition they rejoice, and all weekday matters, all sorrows and troubles, are forgotten, as you say, 'On the day that Hashem gives you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard labor' (Yeshayahu 14:3)."

901.label: Shabbos 55b
901.rest: — "Four died through the counsel of the serpent: Binyamin son of Yaakov, Amram the father of Moshe, Yishai the father of David, and Kilav son of David. All of them are known by tradition, except Yishai the father of David, of whom the verse is explicit." Rashi: through the counsel the serpent gave Chavah, and not through any sin of their own.

902.label: Yalkut Shimoni, Tehillim 765
902.rest: — "Rabbi Acha said: 'In iniquity' — full; even the most pious of the pious cannot be without some side of iniquity. David said: Did Yishai intend to bring me into being? He intended only for his own need."

903.label: Shabbos 89b
903.rest: — "'If your sins be like scarlet (kashanim)' (Yeshayahu 1:18) — it should have said kashani! Rabbi Yitzchak said: The Holy One said to Israel: If your sins be like these years (shanim), which are arranged and come from the six days of Creation until now, they shall be white as snow."

904.label: Shabbos 77b
904.rest: — "Why do the goats go at the head [of the flock], and then the sheep? Like the creation of the world: first darkness and then light."

905.label: Kiddushin 30b
905.rest: — "So the Holy One, blessed be He, said to Israel: My children, I created the evil inclination and I created Torah as its antidote; if you occupy yourselves with Torah you will not be delivered into its hand, as it says, 'If you do good, you shall be lifted up' (Bereishis 4:7)." Rashi: lifted above your inclination.

906.label: Chullin 60b
906.rest: — “Seeing that the moon was not comforted, the Holy One, blessed be He, said: Bring an atonement for Me because I diminished the moon. This is what Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish said: Why is the Rosh Chodesh goat different, that Scripture calls it For Hashem? The Holy One, blessed be He, said: Let this goat be an atonement because I diminished the moon.”

907.label: Rosh Hashanah 20b
907.rest: — "Rabbi Zeira said in the name of Rav Nachman: For twenty-four hours the moon is covered: for us, six hours of the old and eighteen of the new; for them, six of the new and eighteen of the old."

908.label: Zohar III 129a (Idra Rabba)
908.rest: — When is it revealed? At the time of the Minchah prayer on Shabbos. Why? Because on weekdays at that hour judgment hangs below in Ze'eir Anpin, but on Shabbos the Forehead called "favor" (ratzon) is revealed; at that hour anger subsides, favor is found and prayer is accepted, as it is written, "And as for me, my prayer is to You, Hashem, at a time of favor" (Tehillim 69:14).

909.label: Chagigah 13b
909.rest: — "It was taught: Sandalfon is his name; he is taller than his fellow by a journey of five hundred years, and he stands behind the Chariot and ties crowns for his Maker."

910.label: Tosafos, Chagigah 13b (s.v. vekosher)
910.rest: — "'And he ties crowns for his Maker': from the prayer of the tzaddikim he makes crowns."

911.label: Zohar I 132a (Chayei Sarah)
911.rest: — "'Hear my prayer, Hashem' (Tehillim 39:13) — for this is the level that receives all the prayers of the world; and we learned that it makes of them a crown and places it on the head of the Tzaddik, the Life of the Worlds, as it is written, 'Blessings are upon the head of the righteous' (Mishlei 10:6)."

912.label: Berachos 5a
912.rest: — "Rabbi Levi bar Chama said in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish: A person should always incite the good inclination against the evil inclination, as it says, 'Tremble and do not sin' (Tehillim 4:5). If he defeats it, good; if not, let him occupy himself with Torah…; if not, let him recite Shema…; if not, let him remember the day of death."

913.label: Sukkah 52a
913.rest: — "Rabbi Yitzchak said: A person's inclination renews itself against him every day, as it says, 'only evil all the day' (Bereishis 6:5). And Reish Lakish said: A person's inclination overpowers him every day and seeks to kill him… and were it not that the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him, he could not withstand it."

914.label: Sukkah 52a
914.rest: — “Shlomo called it ‘enemy,’ as it says: If your enemy is hungry, feed him bread.” This is one of the seven names of the evil inclination.

915.label: Zohar II 163a (Terumah)
915.rest: — A parable: a king had an only son, and wished to test his loyalty. He called a harlot, beautiful in appearance, and said: Go and entice my son. If the son is worthy and obeys his father's command, he rebukes her and pushes her away; then the father rejoices in his son, brings him into the inner chamber of his palace and gives him gifts. And that harlot too has praise in this, for she fulfilled the king's command and brought the son all that good.

916.label: Bereishis Rabbah 54:1
916.rest: — "'When a man's ways please Hashem, even his enemies He makes at peace with him' (Mishlei 16:7). Rabbi Yochanan said: this is the evil inclination… 'If your enemy is hungry, feed him bread' (Mishlei 25:21) — the bread of Torah; 'and if he is thirsty, give him water to drink' — the water of Torah."

917.label: Pesachim 50b
917.rest: — "Rava contrasted: It is written, 'For Your kindness is great unto the heavens' (Tehillim 57:11), and it is written, 'great above the heavens' (Tehillim 108:5). Here, for those who do it lishmah; there, for those who do it not lishmah — as Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav: A person should always occupy himself with Torah and mitzvos even not lishmah, for from not lishmah he comes to lishmah."

918.label: Eichah Rabbah, Pesichta 2
918.rest: — "'Ve'osi azavu, ve'es Torasi lo shamaru' (Yirmeyahu 16:11) — would that they had forsaken Me and kept My Torah, for since they would be occupied with it, the light within it would bring them back to the good. Rav Huna said: Learn Torah even not for its own sake, for from not for its own sake one comes to for its own sake."

919.label: Taanis 7a
919.rest: — "Rabbi Chanina bar Pappa contrasted: It is written, 'Bring water toward the thirsty' (Yeshayahu 21:14), and it is written, 'Ho, all who are thirsty, go to the water' (Yeshayahu 55:1). If the student is worthy — 'bring water toward the thirsty'; and if not — 'all who are thirsty, go to the water.'"

920.label: Sukkah 52a
920.rest: — "'If your enemy (sona'acha) is hungry, feed him bread… for you heap coals upon his head, and Hashem will repay you (yeshalem lach)' (Mishlei 25:21–22) — do not read yeshalem lach but yashlimenu lach: He will make it at peace with you." Rashi: so that it no longer entices you to sin.

921.label: Pesachim 109a
921.rest: — "Rabbi Yehudah ben Beseira says: When the Beis HaMikdash stood, there was no rejoicing except with meat, as it says, 'And you shall slaughter peace-offerings and eat there and rejoice' (Devarim 27:7); and now that the Beis HaMikdash does not stand, there is no rejoicing except with wine, as it says, 'And wine gladdens the heart of man' (Tehillim 104:15)."

922.label: Zohar III 158b (Shelach)
922.rest: — "'And the days were the days of the first ripe grapes' (Bamidbar 13:20) — what does 'and the days' add? 'The first ripe grapes' would have sufficed! Rather, 'the days' are those that are known: at that time all of them were joined to that tree with which Adam HaRishon sinned, for we learned: it was grapes."

923.label: Zohar III 94b (Emor)
923.rest: — "'Six days shall work be done' — what is the work of the six days? Rabbi Yosi said: It is written, 'For six days Hashem made the heavens and the earth' (Shemos 31:17), and it is not written 'in six days'; each and every day does its work, and they are called days of work."

924.label: Zohar Chadash, Toldos
924.rest: — Corresponding to the seven supernal days, He created on earth seven true tzaddikim, each corresponding to his day, the fathers of the world: Avraham, Yitzchak, Yaakov, Yosef, Moshe, Aharon and David; they are called "the ancient mountains," for they depend on those seven supernal days — the six days of Bereishis and the seventh that stands before them; as it says, "And the house of David shall be like God" (Zecharyah 12:8).

925.label: Sanhedrin 70b
925.rest: — "Rabbi Meir says: The tree from which Adam ate was a vine, for there is nothing that brings wailing to a person except wine."

926.label: Sanhedrin 70a
926.rest: — "Rabbi Chanan said: Wine was created in the world only to comfort mourners and to pay the reward of the wicked, as it says, 'Give strong drink to one who is perishing, and wine to the embittered of soul' (Mishlei 31:6)."

927.label: Zohar II 184a, Tetzaveh
927.rest: — “There is no good except that which emerges from within evil.”

928.label: Pri Etz Chaim, Shaar Rosh Chodesh 3
928.rest: — The Name Havayah brings all being into existence, and nothing in the world lacks light from this Name; it has twelve permutations, divided among the twelve months of the year, and the four letters of Havayah — one letter per month — return each year.

929.label: Taanis 29a
